title.zh: 卷三百十一 列傳第一百九十九 四川土司一
title.raw: 卷三百十一 列傳第一百九十九 四川土司一 Volume 311 Biographies 199: Sichuan Tribal Headmen 1

sentences.zh: 四川土司諸境，多有去蜀遠，去滇、黔近者。

translations.literal: Of the various territories of the Sichuan tribal headmen, many are far from Shu yet close to Yunnan and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Many of the Sichuan tribal domains lay far from the Sichuan heartland but close to Yunnan and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 如烏蒙、東川近於滇，烏撒、鎮雄、播州近於黔。

translations.literal: For example, Wumeng and Dongchuan were close to Yunnan; Wusa, Zhenxiong, and Bozhou were close to Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wumeng and Dongchuan lay near Yunnan, while Wusa, Zhenxiong, and Bozhou lay near Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 明太祖略定邊方，首平蜀夏，置四川布政司，使招諭諸蠻，次第歸附。

translations.literal: When the Hongwu Emperor had broadly pacified the frontier, he first subdued the Xia regime in Shu, established the Sichuan Provincial Administration Commission, and sent envoys to summon and instruct the various barbarian peoples to submit in turn.
translations.idiomatic: After the Hongwu Emperor had broadly secured the borderlands, he first conquered the Xia regime in Shu, set up the Sichuan Provincial Administration Commission, and sent envoys to summon the various tribes to submit one after another.

sentences.zh: 故烏蒙、烏撒、東川、芒部舊屬雲南者，皆隸於四川，不過歲輸貢賦，示以羈縻。

translations.literal: Therefore Wumeng, Wusa, Dongchuan, and Mangbu, which had formerly belonged to Yunnan, were all placed under Sichuan—nothing more than annual tribute payments to display loose reins.
translations.idiomatic: Thus Wumeng, Wusa, Dongchuan, and Mangbu, formerly part of Yunnan, were all placed under Sichuan jurisdiction, paying only annual tribute as a token of loose imperial control.

sentences.zh: 然夷性獷悍，嗜利好殺，爭相競尚，焚燒劫掠，習以為恒。

translations.literal: Yet the barbarians were by nature fierce and violent, greedy for gain and fond of killing; they vied with one another in emulation, burning, plundering, and raiding as a constant practice.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the tribes were fierce by nature, greedy for profit and quick to kill; they competed in prestige, and burning, looting, and raiding had become their habitual way of life.

sentences.zh: 去省窎遠，莫能控制，附近邊民，鹹被其毒。

translations.literal: Being far from the provincial capital, they could not be controlled, and neighboring border people all suffered their harm.
translations.idiomatic: So remote from the provincial seat that the government could not restrain them, they poisoned the lives of nearby border populations.

sentences.zh: 皆由規模草創，未嘗設立文武為之鈐轄，聽其自相雄長。

translations.literal: All this was because the framework was newly established and no civil or military officials had been set up to exercise control, leaving them to contend among themselves for supremacy.
translations.idiomatic: This arose because the system was still rudimentary: no civil or military officials had been stationed to keep them in check, and they were left to vie among themselves for dominance.

sentences.zh: 雖受天朝爵號，實自王其地。

translations.literal: Although they received titles from the Celestial Court, in truth they were kings of their own lands.
translations.idiomatic: Though they bore titles granted by the dynasty, in practice they ruled their own territories like kings.

sentences.zh: 以故終明之世，常煩撻伐。

translations.literal: For this reason, throughout the Ming dynasty campaigns of suppression were constantly required.
translations.idiomatic: Hence throughout the Ming period the court was repeatedly obliged to launch punitive expeditions against them.

sentences.zh: 唯建昌、松、茂等處設立衛所，播州改遵義、平越二府以後，稍安戢雲。

translations.literal: Only after guard posts were established at Jianchang, Songpan, Maozhou, and elsewhere, and after Bozhou was reorganized into the two prefectures of Zunyi and Pingyue, did the region grow somewhat more tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Only after guard posts were set up at Jianchang, Songpan, Maozhou, and elsewhere, and Bozhou was reorganized into the prefectures of Zunyi and Pingyue, did the region grow somewhat calmer.

sentences.zh: ○四川土司一

translations.literal: ○ Sichuan Tribal Headmen 1
translations.idiomatic: ○ Sichuan Tribal Headmen I

sentences.zh: 烏蒙烏撒東川鎮雄四軍民府馬湖建昌衛

translations.literal: Wumeng, Wusa, Dongchuan, and Zhenxiong—four military-civilian prefectures; Mapu; Jianchang Guard
translations.idiomatic: Wumeng, Wusa, Dongchuan, and Zhenxiong—four military-civilian prefectures; Mapu; Jianchang Guard

translations.literal: 〈 (opening editorial parenthesis)
translations.idiomatic: (begin parenthetical note)

sentences.zh: （寧番衛越巂衛鹽井衛會川衛）〉

translations.literal: (Ningfan Guard, Yuexi Guard, Yanjing Guard, Huichuan Guard)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Ningfan Guard, Yuexi Guard, Yanjing Guard, Huichuan Guard)〉

sentences.zh: 茂州衛松潘衛天全六番招討司黎州安撫司

translations.literal: Maozhou Guard, Songpan Guard, Tianquan Liufan Pacification Commissioner, Lizhou Pacification Commissioner
translations.idiomatic: Maozhou Guard, Songpan Guard, Tianquan Liufan Pacification Commissioner, Lizhou Pacification Commissioner

sentences.zh: 烏蒙 烏撒 東川 鎮雄 四軍民府

translations.literal: Wumeng, Wusa, Dongchuan, Zhenxiong—four military-civilian prefectures
translations.idiomatic: Wumeng, Wusa, Dongchuan, Zhenxiong—four military-civilian prefectures

sentences.zh: 烏蒙、烏撒、東川、芒部，古為竇地、的巴、東川、大雄諸甸，皆唐烏蒙裔也。

translations.literal: Wumeng, Wusa, Dongchuan, and Mangbu were anciently the lands of Dou, Diba, Dongchuan, and the Daxiong circuits—all descendants of the Tang Wumeng line.
translations.idiomatic: Wumeng, Wusa, Dongchuan, and Mangbu had anciently been the territories of Dou, Diba, Dongchuan, and the Daxiong circuits, all descended from the Tang Wumeng lineage.

sentences.zh: 宋有封烏蒙王者。

translations.literal: In the Song there were kings enfeoffed over Wumeng.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song, rulers of Wumeng received royal enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 元初置烏蒙路，遂以東川、芒部皆隸於烏蒙、烏撒等處宣慰司。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Yuan the Wumeng Circuit was established, and Dongchuan and Mangbu were both placed under the Xuanwei Commission of Wumeng, Wusa, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yuan, the Wumeng Circuit was established, and Dongchuan and Mangbu were both subordinated to the Xuanwei Commission of Wumeng, Wusa, and related territories.

sentences.zh: 烏撒富盛甲諸部，元時嘗置軍民總管府，而於東川置萬戶府。

translations.literal: Wusa was the wealthiest and most powerful of all the departments; in Yuan times a military-civilian general administration office was once established there, while a wanhu office was set up at Dongchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Wusa was the richest and strongest of all the regions; under the Yuan a military-civilian general administration had once been placed there, while Dongchuan had a wanhu office.

sentences.zh: 地勢並在蜀之東南，與滇、黔壤土相接，皆據險阻深，與中土聲教隔離。

translations.literal: Their terrain all lay southeast of Shu, adjoining the soil of Yunnan and Guizhou; all occupied steep passes and deep defiles, cut off from the civilizing influence of the central lands.
translations.idiomatic: Geographically they lay southeast of Shu, bordering Yunnan and Guizhou, all holding perilous terrain in deep mountains, isolated from the cultural reach of the interior.

sentences.zh: 明太祖既平蜀，規取雲南，大師皆集於辰、沅，欲並剪諸蠻以通蜀道。

translations.literal: After the Hongwu Emperor had pacified Shu, he planned to take Yunnan; the main armies were assembled at Chen and Yuan, intending to cut down the various barbarians together to open the road to Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Once the Hongwu Emperor had pacified Shu, he aimed to seize Yunnan; the main forces gathered at Chen and Yuan, intending to subdue the tribes in one stroke and open the route into Shu.

sentences.zh: 洪武十四年遣內臣賫敕諭烏蒙、烏撒諸部長曰：「西南諸部，自古及今，莫不朝貢中國。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Hongwu an inner eunuch was sent bearing an imperial edict to address the chiefs of Wumeng, Wusa, and the other departments, saying: "The southwestern departments, from antiquity to the present, have none failed to pay court to China.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 14 an imperial eunuch was dispatched with an edict to the chiefs of Wumeng, Wusa, and the other departments: "The southwestern tribes, from ancient times to the present, have all paid court to China.

sentences.zh: 朕受天命為天下主十有五年，而烏蒙、烏撒、東川、芒部、建昌諸部長猶桀驁不朝。

translations.literal: I have received Heaven's mandate and been lord of all under Heaven for fifteen years, yet the chiefs of Wumeng, Wusa, Dongchuan, Mangbu, Jianchang, and the other departments remain defiant and have not come to court.
translations.idiomatic: I have received Heaven's mandate and ruled the realm for fifteen years, yet the chiefs of Wumeng, Wusa, Dongchuan, Mangbu, Jianchang, and the rest remain arrogant and have not presented themselves at court.

sentences.zh: 朕已遣征南將軍潁川侯、左副將軍永昌侯、右副將軍西平侯率師往征。

translations.literal: I have already dispatched the Pacification-General of the South, the Marquis of Yingchuan, the Left Deputy General the Marquis of Yongchang, and the Right Deputy General the Marquis of Xiping to lead armies on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: I have already sent the Pacification-General of the South, the Marquis of Yingchuan, the Left Deputy General the Marquis of Yongchang, and the Right Deputy General the Marquis of Xiping to march against you with their forces.

sentences.zh: 猶恐諸部長未喻朕意，故復遣內臣往諭。

translations.literal: Fearing that the various chiefs may not yet understand my intent, I again send an inner eunuch to instruct you.
translations.idiomatic: Lest the chiefs still fail to grasp my meaning, I send an inner eunuch once more to make it clear.

sentences.zh: 如悔罪向義，當即躬親來朝，或遣人入貢，亟攄誠款，朕當罷兵，以安黎庶。

translations.literal: If you repent your crimes and turn toward righteousness, you should come in person to court at once, or send men to present tribute and swiftly lay bare your sincere submission—I shall then halt the armies and bring peace to the people.
translations.idiomatic: If you repent and submit, come yourself to court at once, or send envoys with tribute and declare your loyalty without delay; I shall then withdraw the armies and let the people live in peace.

sentences.zh: 爾共省之。

translations.literal: You should all reflect on this together.
translations.idiomatic: Consider this carefully, every one of you.

sentences.zh: 」時征南將軍傅友德已分遣都督胡海洋等帥師五萬，由永寧趨烏撒，復自率師由曲靖循格孤山而南，以通永寧之兵，搗烏撒。

translations.literal: " At that time the Pacification-General Fu Youde had already detached the commander Hu Haiyang and others to lead fifty thousand troops from Yongning toward Wusa; he himself led his army from Qujing along Mount Gegu southward to link with the Yongning force and strike Wusa.
translations.idiomatic: " By then Pacification-General Fu Youde had already sent Commander Hu Haiyang and others with fifty thousand men from Yongning toward Wusa, while he himself marched from Qujing along Mount Gegu to the south to join the Yongning column and drive on Wusa.

sentences.zh: 時元右丞實卜聞海洋兵至，乃聚兵赤水河以拒之。

translations.literal: At that time the Yuan Right Chancellor Shibu, hearing that Haiyang's army had arrived, gathered troops at the Chishui River to resist.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan Right Chancellor Shibu, learning that Haiyang's force was approaching, massed his troops on the Chishui River to block them.

sentences.zh: 及聞大軍繼進，皆遁。

translations.literal: When he heard that the main army was advancing in succession, they all fled.
translations.idiomatic: When word came that the main force was pressing on behind, they all fled.

sentences.zh: 友德令諸軍築城，版閘方具，蠻寇大集。

translations.literal: Youde ordered the armies to build a walled city; the boards and gates were scarcely in place when barbarian raiders gathered in great numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Youde ordered his troops to build fortifications; the ramparts and gates were barely ready when barbarian forces swarmed in.

sentences.zh: 友德屯兵山岡，持重以待。

translations.literal: Youde stationed his troops on a hill, holding his position and waiting.
translations.idiomatic: Youde held the hilltop with his men, keeping a steady front and biding his time.

sentences.zh: 既知士勇可用，乃縱兵接戰。

translations.literal: Once he knew the soldiers' courage could be relied upon, he unleashed them to join battle.
translations.idiomatic: When he was satisfied that his troops would fight well, he let them charge into battle.

sentences.zh: 有芒部土酋率眾來援，實卜兵與合，鋒甚銳。

translations.literal: A Mangbu tribal chief led his followers to reinforce Shibu; their combined forces were very sharp in the assault.
translations.idiomatic: A Mangbu chieftain came with his followers to aid Shibu; the allied host struck with fierce momentum.

sentences.zh: 大軍鼓噪而前，其酋長多中槊墜馬死。

translations.literal: The great army advanced with war drums and shouting; many chiefs were pierced by spears and fell from their horses dead.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial host advanced with drums and battle cries; many chieftains were speared and fell dead from their horses.

sentences.zh: 大軍益奮，蠻眾力不支，大潰，斬首三千，獲馬六百，實卜率眾遁。

translations.literal: The great army fought all the harder; the barbarian masses could not hold and broke in complete rout—three thousand heads were cut off, six hundred horses captured, and Shibu fled with his followers.
translations.idiomatic: The troops fought with redoubled fury; the tribes could not stand and were utterly routed. Three thousand heads were taken, six hundred horses seized, and Shibu fled with what remained of his force.

sentences.zh: 遂城烏撒，克七星關以通畢節，又克可渡河，於是東川、烏蒙、芒部諸蠻震詟，皆望風降附。

translations.literal: They then fortified Wusa, took the Qixing Pass to open communication with Bijie, and also seized the Keduo River crossing; thereupon the tribes of Dongchuan, Wumeng, and Mangbu were shaken with terror and submitted at the first wind.
translations.idiomatic: They walled Wusa, captured Qixing Pass to link with Bijie, and took the Keduo River crossing as well. The tribes of Dongchuan, Wumeng, and Mangbu were struck with awe and surrendered as the army approached.

sentences.zh: 十五年置東川、烏撒、烏蒙、芒部諸衛指揮使司，詔諭諸部人民。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year guard command offices were established for Dongchuan, Wusa, Wumeng, and Mangbu, and the peoples of the various departments were instructed by edict.
translations.idiomatic: In year 15 command offices were set up for Dongchuan, Wusa, Wumeng, and Mangbu, and edicts were issued to the peoples of those departments.

sentences.zh: 以雲南已降附，宜益效順中國，以享升平。

translations.literal: Because Yunnan had already submitted, they should all the more loyally serve China and enjoy an age of peace.
translations.idiomatic: Since Yunnan had already submitted, they should prove still more loyal to the dynasty and enjoy the blessings of peace.

sentences.zh: 復諭諸部長曰：「今置郵傳通雲南，宣率土人，隨其疆界遠邇，開築道路，各廣十丈，準古法，以六十里為一驛。

translations.literal: The chiefs were again instructed: "Now that postal relays are being opened to Yunnan, you should lead your native peoples, according to whether your borders are near or far, to open and build roads, each ten zhang wide, following the ancient standard of one relay station every sixty li.
translations.idiomatic: The chiefs were told again: "Postal routes to Yunnan are now being established. Lead your people, according to the distance of your borders, to open roads ten zhang wide, with relay stations every sixty li as in the ancient rule.

sentences.zh: 符至奉行。

translations.literal: When the order arrives, carry it out.
translations.idiomatic: When this order reaches you, obey it without delay.

sentences.zh: 」又敕征南將軍友德等曰：「烏蒙、烏撒、東川、芒部諸酋長雖已降，恐大軍一還，仍復嘯聚。

translations.literal: " An edict was also sent to the Pacification-General Youde and others: "Although the chiefs of Wumeng, Wusa, Dongchuan, and Mangbu have already submitted, I fear that once the main army withdraws they will gather again in revolt.
translations.idiomatic: " Another edict went to Youde and his colleagues: "The chiefs of Wumeng, Wusa, Dongchuan, and Mangbu have surrendered, but once the main army leaves they may rally again.

sentences.zh: 符到日，悉送其酋長入朝。

translations.literal: On the day the order arrives, send all their chiefs to court.
translations.idiomatic: When this order arrives, send every one of their chiefs to the capital.

sentences.zh: 」又諭以貴州已設都指揮使，然地勢偏東，今宜於實卜所居之地立司，以便控制，卿其審之。

translations.literal: " It was further explained that a regional commander-in-chief had been set up in Guizhou, but the terrain lay too far east; a commission should now be established at the place where Shibu dwelt for easier control—you should consider this carefully.
translations.idiomatic: " They were also told that Guizhou already had a regional military commission, but its position was too far east; an office should be established where Shibu had ruled for easier control—consider this carefully.

sentences.zh: 」已，烏撒諸蠻復叛，帝諭友德曰：「烏撒諸蠻伺官軍散處，即有此變，朕前已慮之，今果然。

translations.literal: " Before long the tribes of Wusa rebelled again; the Emperor told Youde: "The tribes of Wusa waited until government troops were scattered and then made this move—I had foreseen it, and now it has indeed come to pass.
translations.idiomatic: " Soon the Wusa tribes rebelled again. The Emperor wrote to Youde: "The Wusa tribes waited until our troops were dispersed, then rose—exactly as I foresaw.

sentences.zh: 然雲南之地如曲靖、普安、烏撒、建昌，勢在必守，其東川、芒部、烏蒙，未可遽守也。

translations.literal: Yet the lands of Yunnan such as Qujing, Pu'an, Wusa, and Jianchang must certainly be held; as for Dongchuan, Mangbu, and Wumeng, they cannot yet be garrisoned in haste.
translations.idiomatic: "Yet places in Yunnan such as Qujing, Pu'an, Wusa, and Jianchang must be held at all costs; Dongchuan, Mangbu, and Wumeng cannot be garrisoned too hastily.

sentences.zh: 且留屯大軍蕩埽諸蠻，戮其渠長，方可分兵守禦耳。

translations.literal: For the present leave the main army stationed to sweep the various barbarians clean and execute their ringleaders; only then may troops be divided for defense.
translations.idiomatic: "For now keep the main force in the field to crush the tribes and kill their leaders; only then may you divide troops for garrison duty.

sentences.zh: 」乃命安陸侯吳復為總兵，平涼侯費聚副之，征烏撒、烏蒙諸叛蠻。

translations.literal: " The Marquis of Anlu, Wu Fu, was appointed overall commander, with the Marquis of Pingliang, Fei Ju, as his deputy, to campaign against the rebellious tribes of Wusa, Wumeng, and the rest.
translations.idiomatic: " Wu Fu, Marquis of Anlu, was made overall commander, with Fei Ju, Marquis of Pingliang, as deputy, to suppress the rebellious tribes of Wusa and Wumeng.

sentences.zh: 並諭勿與蠻戰於關索嶺上，當分兵掩襲，直搗其巢，使彼各奔救其家之不暇，必不敢出以抗大師。

translations.literal: They were also instructed not to fight the barbarians on Guansuo Ridge but to divide forces for a concealed strike straight at their nests, so that each would rush to save his own home and have no leisure to come out against the main army.
translations.idiomatic: They were warned not to engage the tribes on Guansuo Ridge but to detach columns for a surprise thrust into their strongholds, so that each clan would scramble to defend its own home and dare not face the main army in the field.

sentences.zh: 俟三將軍至，破擒之。

translations.literal: Wait until the three generals arrive, then break them and capture them.
translations.idiomatic: When the three generals arrive, destroy them and take their leaders prisoner.

sentences.zh: 是月，副將軍西平侯沐英自大理還軍，會友德擊烏撒，大敗其眾，斬首三萬余級，獲馬牛羊萬計，余眾悉遁，復追擊破之。

translations.literal: That month the Deputy General, the Marquis of Xiping Mu Ying, returned from Dali and joined Youde in attacking Wusa; the enemy host was utterly defeated—more than thirty thousand heads were cut off, and tens of thousands of horses, cattle, and sheep were taken; the remainder all fled, and pursuing troops broke them again.
translations.idiomatic: That month Deputy General Mu Ying, Marquis of Xiping, marched back from Dali and joined Youde against Wusa. The enemy was crushed: more than thirty thousand heads were taken, and countless horses, cattle, and sheep; the survivors fled, and pursuit columns routed them again.

sentences.zh: 帝諭友德等，師捷後，必戮其渠魁，使之畏懼。

translations.literal: The Emperor instructed Youde and the others that after victory they must execute the ringleaders to inspire fear.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor told Youde and his colleagues that after victory they must kill the chieftains to instill terror.

sentences.zh: 搜其余黨，絕其根株，使彼智窮力屈，誠心款附，方可留兵鎮守。

translations.literal: Search out the remaining partisans, cut off their roots, and only when they are exhausted in wit and strength and submit in sincere good faith may troops be left to garrison the region.
translations.idiomatic: Hunt down the remaining followers, uproot them entirely, and only when they are broken in will and submit in good faith may garrisons remain.

sentences.zh: 又諭宜乘兵勢修治道途，令土酋諭其民，各輸糧一石以給軍，為持久計。

translations.literal: They were further told to take advantage of military momentum to repair the roads, and to have the tribal chiefs instruct their people each to contribute one shi of grain for the army as a plan for a prolonged campaign.
translations.idiomatic: They were also ordered to repair roads while the army still held the field, and to have tribal chiefs tell their people to furnish one shi of grain per household to sustain a long campaign.

sentences.zh: 十六年以雲南所屬烏撒、烏蒙、芒部三府隸四川布政使司。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year the three prefectures of Wusa, Wumeng, and Mangbu, formerly belonging to Yunnan, were placed under the Sichuan Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In year 16 the three prefectures of Wusa, Wumeng, and Mangbu, formerly under Yunnan, were assigned to the Sichuan Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 烏蒙、烏撒、東川、芒部諸部長百二十人來朝，貢方物。

translations.literal: One hundred twenty chiefs of Wumeng, Wusa, Dongchuan, Mangbu, and the other departments came to court and presented local products as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred twenty chiefs from Wumeng, Wusa, Dongchuan, Mangbu, and other departments came to court bearing local tribute.

sentences.zh: 詔各授以官，賜朝服、冠帶、錦騎、鈔錠有差。

translations.literal: An edict appointed each to office and bestowed court robes, caps and belts, brocade steeds, and paper money in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict invested each with office and granted court dress, caps and belts, brocade mounts, and paper money in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 其烏撒女酋實卜，加賜珠翠。

translations.literal: The Wusa female chief Shibu was given an additional gift of pearls and kingfisher feathers.
translations.idiomatic: Shibu, the female chief of Wusa, received an extra gift of pearls and kingfisher ornaments.

sentences.zh: 芒部知府發紹、烏蒙知府阿普病卒，詔賜綺衣並棺殮之具，遣官致祭，歸其柩於家。

translations.literal: Mangbu Prefect Fa Shao and Wumeng Prefect Apu died of illness; the court ordered brocade robes and coffin fittings bestowed, officials sent to perform the rites, and their coffins returned to their homes.
translations.idiomatic: Mangbu Prefect Fa Shao and Wumeng Prefect Apu died; the court granted brocade robes and coffin fittings, sent officials to conduct the funeral rites, and had their remains returned home.

sentences.zh: 十七年割雲南東川府隸四川布政府司，並烏撒、烏蒙、芒部皆改為軍民府，而定其賦稅。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year the Dongchuan Prefecture of Yunnan was detached to the Sichuan Provincial Administration Commission; Wusa, Wumeng, and Mangbu were all changed to military-civilian prefectures and their taxes and levies fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In year 17 Dongchuan Prefecture was transferred from Yunnan to Sichuan; Wusa, Wumeng, and Mangbu were all redesignated military-civilian prefectures and their tax obligations fixed.

sentences.zh: 烏撒歲輸二萬石，氈衫一千五百領；

translations.literal: Wusa was to deliver twenty thousand shi annually and fifteen hundred felt coats;
translations.idiomatic: Wusa owed twenty thousand shi of grain per year and fifteen hundred felt coats;

sentences.zh: 烏蒙、東川、芒部皆歲輸八千石，氈衫八百領。

translations.literal: Wumeng, Dongchuan, and Mangbu were each to deliver eight thousand shi annually and eight hundred felt coats.
translations.idiomatic: Wumeng, Dongchuan, and Mangbu each owed eight thousand shi per year and eight hundred felt coats.

sentences.zh: 又定茶鹽布疋易馬之數，烏撒歲易馬六千五百匹，烏蒙、東川、芒部皆四千匹。

translations.literal: The quotas for tea, salt, cloth, and horse barter were also fixed: Wusa was to trade six thousand five hundred horses annually; Wumeng, Dongchuan, and Mangbu four thousand each.
translations.idiomatic: Quotas for bartering tea, salt, and cloth for horses were set: Wusa six thousand five hundred horses per year; Wumeng, Dongchuan, and Mangbu four thousand each.

sentences.zh: 凡馬一匹，給布三十疋，或茶一百斤，鹽如之。

translations.literal: For each horse, thirty bolts of cloth were given, or one hundred jin of tea, or an equivalent in salt.
translations.idiomatic: For each horse, thirty bolts of cloth, or one hundred jin of tea, or the same measure of salt, was offered in exchange.

sentences.zh: 實卜復貢馬，賜綺鈔。

translations.literal: Shibu again presented horses and received brocade and paper money.
translations.idiomatic: Shibu presented horses again and was rewarded with brocade and paper money.

sentences.zh: 十八年，烏蒙知府亦德言，蠻地刀耕火種，比年霜旱疾疫，民饑窘，歲輸之糧無從徵納。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Wumeng Prefect Yide reported that in the barbarian lands they plowed with knife and burned fields; in recent years frost, drought, and pestilence had left the people hungry and destitute, and the annual grain levy could not be collected.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 Wumeng Prefect Yide reported that the tribes farmed by slash-and-burn; frost, drought, and plague in recent years had left the people starving, and the annual grain tribute could not be raised.

sentences.zh: 詔悉免之。

translations.literal: An edict wholly exempted them.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered full exemption.

sentences.zh: 二十年徵烏撒知府阿能赴京。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Wusa Prefect A Neng was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In year 20 Wusa Prefect A Neng was summoned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 二十一年命西平侯沐英南征。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year the Marquis of Xiping, Mu Ying, was ordered on a southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In year 21 Mu Ying, Marquis of Xiping, was ordered south on campaign.

sentences.zh: 英言，東川強盛，據烏山路作亂，罪狀已著，必先加兵。

translations.literal: Ying reported that Dongchuan was powerful and had seized the Wushan road in rebellion; its guilt was already clear and troops must strike it first.
translations.idiomatic: Ying reported that Dongchuan was strong and had blocked the Wushan route in revolt; its guilt was established and it must be attacked first.

sentences.zh: 但其地重關復嶺，上下三百餘里，人跡阻絕，須以大兵臨之。

translations.literal: Yet its terrain had layer upon layer of passes and ridges, more than three hundred li up and down where human tracks were cut off; a large army must press in upon it.
translations.idiomatic: But the country was a maze of passes and ridges, more than three hundred li of trackless heights; only a major force could subdue it.

sentences.zh: 帝命潁國公傅友德仍為征南將軍，英與陳桓為左桓副將軍，率諸軍進討。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered the Duke of Ying, Fu Youde, to serve again as Pacification-General of the South, with Ying and Chen Huan as left and right deputy generals, to lead the armies forward in punitive expedition.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor appointed Fu Youde, Duke of Ying, again as Pacification-General of the South, with Ying and Chen Huan as left and right deputies, to lead the expedition.

sentences.zh: 敕友德等曰：「東川、芒部諸夷，種類皆出於羅羅。

translations.literal: An edict to Youde and the others read: "The tribes of Dongchuan, Mangbu, and the rest are all of the Luoluo race.
translations.idiomatic: An edict to Youde and his colleagues said: "The peoples of Dongchuan, Mangbu, and the rest all spring from the Luoluo stock.

sentences.zh: 厥後子姓蕃衍，各立疆場，乃異其名曰東川、烏撒、烏蒙、芒部、祿肇、水西。

translations.literal: Later their descendants multiplied and each established his own domain, and they took different names: Dongchuan, Wusa, Wumeng, Mangbu, Luzhao, and Shuixi.
translations.idiomatic: Their descendants later multiplied, each carving out a territory and taking a separate name—Dongchuan, Wusa, Wumeng, Mangbu, Luzhao, and Shuixi.

sentences.zh: 無事則互起爭端，有事則相為救援。

translations.literal: In peace they raised disputes among themselves; in crisis they rescued one another.
translations.idiomatic: In quiet times they quarreled among themselves; in danger they came to one another's aid.

sentences.zh: 若唐時閣羅鳳亡居大理，唐兵追捕，道經芒部諸境，君蠻聚眾據險設伏。

translations.literal: In Tang times when Nanzhao's Geluofeng fled to Dali and Tang troops pursued, passing through the Mangbu territories, the tribal chiefs gathered their followers, held the passes, and laid ambushes.
translations.idiomatic: In Tang times, when Nanzhao's Geluofeng fled to Dali and Tang forces pursued him through Mangbu lands, the tribal chiefs massed their followers, seized the defiles, and set ambushes.

sentences.zh: 唐將不備，遂墮其計，喪師二十萬，皆將帥無謀故也。

translations.literal: The Tang generals were unprepared and fell into their trap, losing two hundred thousand men—all because their commanders lacked foresight.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang commanders were caught unawares, fell into the trap, and lost two hundred thousand men—a disaster born of commanders' lack of planning.

sentences.zh: 今須預加防閑，嚴為之備。

translations.literal: Now you must take precautions in advance and make strict preparations.
translations.idiomatic: You must take precautions now and prepare with the utmost rigor.

sentences.zh: 」烏撒軍民府葉原常獻馬三百匹、米四百石於征南將軍，以資軍用，且願收集土兵從征。

translations.literal: " Ye Yuanchang of the Wusa military-civilian prefecture presented three hundred horses and four hundred shi of grain to the Pacification-General for army use, and wished to gather native troops for the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: " Ye Yuanchang of Wusa presented three hundred horses and four hundred shi of grain to the Pacification-General for the campaign and offered to raise native levies to march with the army.

sentences.zh: 英等以聞，從之。

translations.literal: Ying and the others reported this and permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Ying and his colleagues reported this, and the court approved.

sentences.zh: 復命景川侯曹震、靖寧侯葉升等分討東川，平之，捕獲叛蠻五千五百三十八人。

translations.literal: The Marquis of Jingchuan, Cao Zhen, and the Marquis of Jingning, Ye Sheng, and others were again ordered to campaign separately against Dongchuan; it was pacified and five thousand five hundred thirty-eight rebellious tribesmen were captured.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Zhen, Marquis of Jingchuan, Ye Sheng, Marquis of Jingning, and others were sent to attack Dongchuan separately; the region was pacified and five thousand five hundred thirty-eight rebels taken.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，烏撒土知府阿能，烏蒙、芒部土官，各遣子弟入監讀書。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year Wusa native prefect A Neng, and the native officials of Wumeng and Mangbu, each sent sons to enter the Imperial College for study.
translations.idiomatic: In year 23 Wusa native prefect A Neng and the native officials of Wumeng and Mangbu each sent sons to study in the Imperial College.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，烏撒知府卜穆奏，沾益州屢侵其地，命沐春諭之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year Wusa Prefect Bu Mu memorialized that Qiyi Prefecture had repeatedly encroached on his territory; Mu Chun was ordered to instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: In year 27 Wusa Prefect Bu Mu reported repeated encroachments by Qiyi Prefecture; Mu Chun was ordered to admonish the offenders.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，戶部言：「烏撒、烏蒙、芒部、東川歲賦氈衫不如數，詔已免徵。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year the Ministry of Revenue reported: "The annual felt-coat levies of Wusa, Wumeng, Mangbu, and Dongchuan fall short of the quota, though an edict has already exempted collection.
translations.idiomatic: In year 28 the Ministry of Revenue reported: "Wusa, Wumeng, Mangbu, and Dongchuan have not met their annual felt-coat quotas, though collection was already waived by edict.

sentences.zh: 今有司仍追之，宜申明。

translations.literal: The local officials still press for payment; this should be made clear.
translations.idiomatic: "Local authorities are still pressing for payment; the exemption should be reaffirmed.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The court approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，烏蒙軍民府知府實哲貢馬及氈衫。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year Wumeng military-civilian prefect Shizhe presented horses and felt coats.
translations.idiomatic: In year 29 Wumeng military-civilian prefect Shizhe presented horses and felt coats.

sentences.zh: 自是，諸土知府三年一入貢，以為常，或有恩賜，則進馬及方物謝恩。

translations.literal: Henceforth the native prefects of the various departments came to court once every three years as a fixed rule; when special favors were granted they would present horses and local products in thanks.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the native prefects paid court once every three years as a standing rule; when the throne granted special favors they would present horses and local products in gratitude.

sentences.zh: 宣德七年，兵部侍郎王驥言，烏蒙、烏撒土官祿昭、尼祿等，爭地仇殺，宜遣官按問。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Xuande, Vice Minister of War Wang Ji reported that the native officials of Wumeng and Wusa, Lu Zhao and Ni Lu, were killing one another over disputed territory and that officials should be sent to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande year 7 Wang Ji, Vice Minister of War, reported that the Wumeng and Wusa chiefs Lu Zhao and Ni Lu were feuding over land and killing one another; officials should be dispatched to investigate.

sentences.zh: 八年遣行人章聰、侯璉賫敕往諭，仍敕巡按與三司官往平之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the envoys Zhang Cong and Hou Lian were sent bearing edicts to instruct them; the touring censor and the three commissions were also ordered to go and settle the affair.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 the envoys Zhang Cong and Hou Lian were sent with edicts; the touring censor and the three provincial commissions were also ordered to pacify the dispute.

sentences.zh: 設烏蒙儒學教授、訓導各一員。

translations.literal: A Confucian director and instructor were established for the Wumeng school.
translations.idiomatic: A professor and instructor were appointed for the Wumeng Confucian school.

sentences.zh: 以通判黃甫越言，元時本府向有學校，今文廟雖存，師儒未建。

translations.literal: On the recommendation of Assistant Prefect Huangfu Yue: "In Yuan times this prefecture had a school; though the temple remains, no teachers have been appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On the petition of Assistant Prefect Huangfu Yue: "Under the Yuan this prefecture had a school; the temple still stands, but no teachers have been installed.

sentences.zh: 乞除教官，選俊秀子弟入學讀書，以廣文治，從之。

translations.literal: I beg that instructors be appointed and promising youths chosen to study, to extend civil culture—the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: "I ask that instructors be appointed and talented youths enrolled to spread civil learning." The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 成化十二年，烏撒知府隴舊等奏，同知剛正撫字有方，蠻民信服，今九年秩滿，乞再任三年，以慰群望。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Chenghua Wusa Prefect Long Jiu and others memorialized that Vice Commissioner Gang Zheng had governed well and won the tribes' trust; his nine-year term was complete and they begged three more years to satisfy the people's wishes.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua year 12 Wusa Prefect Long Jiu reported that Vice Commissioner Gang Zheng had governed effectively and won the tribes' trust; his nine-year term had ended and they begged three more years to satisfy popular expectation.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The court approved.
translations.idiomatic: Permission was granted.

sentences.zh: 弘治十四年，烏撒所轄可渡河巡檢司言：「自閏七月二十七日，大雷雨不止，至二十九日，水漲山崩地裂，山鳴如牛吼，地陷湧出清泉數十派，沖壞廬舍橋梁及壓死人口牲畜無算。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Hongzhi the Keduo River inspection office under Wusa reported: "From the twenty-seventh day of the seventh month great thunder and rain did not cease until the twenty-ninth; the waters rose, mountains collapsed and the earth split, the mountains roared like cattle, the ground sank and dozens of springs gushed forth, destroying houses, bridges, and crushing people and livestock beyond count.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongzhi year 14 the Keduo River inspection office under Wusa reported: "From the twenty-seventh of the seventh month unceasing thunder and rain lasted until the twenty-ninth. Floods rose, mountains collapsed, the earth split with a roar like cattle, the ground gave way and dozens of springs burst forth, destroying houses and bridges and crushing people and livestock beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 又本府阿都地方，八月亦暴風雨，田土渰沒二百余處，死者三百余人。」

translations.literal: " In the Adi district of this prefecture, in the eighth month, violent wind and rain likewise inundated more than two hundred plots and killed more than three hundred people.
translations.idiomatic: " In the Adi district of the same prefecture, violent storms in the eighth month flooded more than two hundred fields and killed more than three hundred people.

sentences.zh: 正德十五年討斬芒部僰蠻阿又磉等。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Zhengde a campaign was launched to behead the Mangbu Bo tribesman A Yousang and others.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengde year 15 a punitive expedition was launched to execute A Yousang and other Mangbu Bo tribesmen.

sentences.zh: 初，芒部土舍隴壽，與庶弟隴政及兄妻支祿爭襲仇殺。

translations.literal: Initially the Mangbu native clerk Long Shou and his younger brother by a concubine, Long Zheng, and his elder brother's wife Zhi Lu fought over succession and killed one another in feud.
translations.idiomatic: At first the Mangbu native clerk Long Shou, his younger half-brother Long Zheng, and his elder brother's wife Zhi Lu had fought over the succession and slaughtered one another in the feud.

sentences.zh: 所部僰蠻阿又磉等乘機倡亂流劫。

translations.literal: The Bo tribesmen A Yousang and others under his command seized the opportunity to stir rebellion and roam in plunder.
translations.idiomatic: The Bo tribesman A Yousang and his followers seized the moment to rise in revolt and raid the countryside.

sentences.zh: 事聞，命鎮守中官會撫按官捕治。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, the court ordered the garrison eunuch to join the grand coordinator and surveillance commissioner in arresting and punishing them.
translations.idiomatic: On report, the court ordered the garrison eunuch to work with the grand coordinator and surveillance commissioner to capture and punish them.

sentences.zh: 至是，貴州參政傅習、都指揮許詔，督永寧宣撫司女土官奢爵等，討擒阿又磉等四十三人，斬一百十九級，事乃定。

translations.literal: By then Guizhou Vice Commissioner Fu Xi and Regional Commander Xu Zhao, supervising the Yongning Pacification Commissioner the female native official She Jue and others, campaigned and captured forty-three men including A Yousang; one hundred nineteen heads were cut off, and the affair was settled.
translations.idiomatic: By then Fu Xi, Guizhou Vice Commissioner, and Xu Zhao, Regional Commander, directing She Jue of Yongning and others, captured forty-three rebels including A Yousang and took one hundred nineteen heads; order was restored.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖元年命芒部護印土舍隴壽襲知府，免赴京。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiajing an order appointed Long Shou, Mangbu clerk guarding the seal, to succeed as prefect, exempted from going to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing year 1 Long Shou, Mangbu clerk who held the seal, was appointed to succeed as prefect without traveling to the capital.

sentences.zh: 故事，土官九品以上，皆保送至京乃襲。

translations.literal: By precedent, native officials of the ninth rank and above were all escorted to the capital before investiture.
translations.idiomatic: By custom, native officials of ninth rank and above had to be escorted to the capital before receiving office.

sentences.zh: 時壽、政等爭襲，不敢離任。

translations.literal: At that time Shou, Zheng, and the others were contending for succession and dared not leave their posts.
translations.idiomatic: Shou, Zheng, and the others were fighting over the succession and could not leave their territories.

sentences.zh: 朝廷以嫡故立壽，恐壽赴京而政等乘隙為亂，故有是命。

translations.literal: The court established Shou because he was the legitimate heir, fearing that if Shou went to the capital Zheng and the others would seize the chance to rebel—hence this order.
translations.idiomatic: The court named Shou as heir, fearing that if he went to the capital Zheng and the others would rebel in his absence—hence the exemption.

sentences.zh: 然政與支祿倚烏撒土舍安寧等兵力，仇殺如故。

translations.literal: Yet Zheng and Zhi Lu relied on the military strength of the Wusa clerk An Ning and continued their feud of mutual killing as before.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Zheng and Zhi Lu, backed by Wusa clerk An Ning's troops, went on killing one another as before.

sentences.zh: 壩底參將何卿請於巡撫許廷光，發土兵二萬五千人，命貴州參將楊仁等將之，受何卿節制，相機進剿政、祿佯聽撫，乞緩師，而令賊黨阿黑等掠周泥站、七星關，復遣阿核等糾集諸苗，剽掠畢節諸處，殺傷官軍，毀官民房屋甚眾。

translations.literal: Badi Assistant Commander He Qing requested of Grand Coordinator Xu Tingguang that twenty-five thousand native troops be sent, with Guizhou Assistant Commander Yang Ren and others commanding under He Qing's direction to advance as circumstances allowed against Zheng and Lu, who feigned acceptance of pacification and begged to delay the army while their partisans A Hei and others raided Zhou Station and Qixing Pass, and A He again gathered various Miao to plunder around Bijie, killing government troops and destroying many official and private buildings.
translations.idiomatic: He Qing, Badi Assistant Commander, asked Xu Tingguang to mobilize twenty-five thousand native troops under Yang Ren and others, subject to He Qing's command, to suppress Zheng and Lu. The rebels pretended to submit and begged for delay, while A Hei raided Zhou Station and Qixing Pass and A He rallied tribes to loot Bijie, killing soldiers and destroying countless buildings.

sentences.zh: 兵部言賊勢猖獗，宜速征。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War reported that the rebels were rampant and should be attacked at once.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War urged rapid campaign, saying the rebels had grown uncontrollable.

sentences.zh: 於是可卿等進剿，斬首二百余級，俘二十余人，降其眾數百，政敗奔烏撒，卿檄烏撒土舍安寧、土婦奢勿擒之。

translations.literal: Thereupon He Qing and others advanced in suppression, cutting off more than two hundred heads, taking more than twenty prisoners, and accepting the surrender of several hundred followers; Zheng was defeated and fled to Wusa, and He Qing ordered the Wusa clerk An Ning and the native woman She Wu to capture him.
translations.idiomatic: He Qing advanced, took more than two hundred heads and twenty prisoners, and accepted several hundred surrenders. Zheng fled to Wusa; He Qing ordered An Ning and She Wu to seize him.

sentences.zh: 安寧佯許諾，僅以阿核等屍獻，竟不出政，兵久不解。

translations.literal: An Ning pretended to agree but presented only the corpses of A He and others, and in the end did not hand over Zheng; the campaign dragged on without resolution.
translations.idiomatic: An Ning feigned compliance, offering only the bodies of A He and others, and never produced Zheng; the army remained stuck in the field.

sentences.zh: 都御史湯沐以聞，詔切責諸將及守巡官罪，而革何卿冠帶，令剿賊自贖。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Tang Mu reported this; an edict sharply rebuked the generals and local defense officials, stripped He Qing of his cap and belt, and ordered him to suppress the rebels to redeem his fault.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Mu, Censor-in-Chief, memorialized; the court rebuked the commanders and local officials, removed He Qing's rank insignia, and ordered him to crush the rebels as penance.

sentences.zh: 四年，政誘殺壽，奪其印。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Zheng lured and killed Shou and seized his seal.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 Zheng ambushed and killed Shou and took the prefectural seal.

sentences.zh: 巡撫王軏、巡按劉黻各上其事。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Wang Gui and Surveillance Commissioner Liu Fu each memorialized the affair.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Wang Gui and Surveillance Commissioner Liu Fu each reported the case.

sentences.zh: 黻言從蠻情，立支祿便。

translations.literal: Fu said that following tribal custom, establishing Zhi Lu would be convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Fu argued that tribal sentiment favored installing Zhi Lu.

sentences.zh: 軏以隴政、支祿怙終稔惡，戕朝廷命吏，罪不可赦。

translations.literal: Gui held that Long Zheng and Zhi Lu had persisted in evil to the end and had murdered officials appointed by the court—crimes that could not be pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Gui maintained that Long Zheng and Zhi Lu were incorrigible and had killed imperial appointees—unforgivable crimes.

sentences.zh: 乃命鎮巡官諭安寧，縛政、祿及諸助惡者。

translations.literal: An order was then issued for the frontier officials to instruct An Ning to bind Zheng, Lu, and all who had aided their crimes.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered frontier officials to tell An Ning to arrest Zheng, Lu, and their accomplices.

sentences.zh: 時政已為官軍擒於水西，追獲芒部印信，前後斬首六百七十四級，生擒一百六十七人，招撫白烏石等四十九寨，以捷聞。

translations.literal: By then Zheng had already been captured by government troops in Shuixi; the Mangbu seal was recovered; in all six hundred seventy-four heads were cut off before and after, one hundred sixty-seven taken alive, and forty-nine stockades including Baiwushi were pacified—the victory was reported.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng was already taken in Shuixi, the Mangbu seal recovered; six hundred seventy-four heads were taken, one hundred sixty-seven captives, and forty-nine stockades pacified—the victory was announced.

sentences.zh: 貴州巡按劉廷簠言：「烏撒所獻阿核等屍，及水西所縛隴政，真偽未可信，恐首惡尚在，不無後慮，請核實。

translations.literal: Guizhou Surveillance Commissioner Liu Tingfan said: "The corpses of A He and others presented by Wusa, and Long Zheng bound by Shuixi—their authenticity is not yet credible; I fear the chief culprits remain and there may be trouble later; please verify.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Tingfan, Guizhou Surveillance Commissioner, wrote: "The bodies from Wusa and Long Zheng from Shuixi may be false; the ringleaders may still be at large. Please investigate.

sentences.zh: 」五年，兵部奏：「芒部隴氏，釁起蕭墻，騷動兩省，王師大舉，始克蕩平。

translations.literal: " In the fifth year the Ministry of War memorialized: "The Long clan of Mangbu raised trouble within their own walls and disturbed two provinces; only after a major imperial campaign was the region swept clean.
translations.idiomatic: " In year 5 the Ministry reported: "The Longs of Mangbu rebelled at home and troubled two provinces; only a major campaign pacified them.

sentences.zh: 今其本屬親支已盡，無人承襲，請改為鎮雄府，設流官知府統之。

translations.literal: Now their direct line is extinct and no one can inherit; it is requested that Mangbu be changed to Zhenxiong Prefecture with a circulating official prefect to govern.
translations.idiomatic: "Their direct line is extinct. Convert Mangbu to Zhenxiong Prefecture under a regular official prefect.

sentences.zh: 分屬夷良、毋響、落角利之地，為懷德、歸化、威信、安靜四長官司，使隴氏疏屬阿濟、白壽、祖保、阿萬四人統之。

translations.literal: The lands of Yiliang, Wuxiang, and Luojiaoli were divided into the four long-chief offices of Huaide, Guihua, Weixin, and Anjing, to be ruled by the distant Long clansmen A Ji, Bai Shou, Zu Bao, and A Wan.
translations.idiomatic: "Divide Yiliang, Wuxiang, and Luojiaoli into four long-chief offices—Huaide, Guihua, Weixin, Anjing—under distant Long kinsmen A Ji, Bai Shou, Zu Bao, and A Wan.

sentences.zh: 如程番府例，令三年一入朝，貢馬十二匹，而以通判程洸為試知府。」

translations.literal: Following the Chenfan Prefecture precedent, they were to come to court once every three years, present twelve horses as tribute, and Assistant Prefect Cheng Guang was appointed acting prefect."
translations.idiomatic: "As at Chenfan, court every three years with twelve horses; appoint Assistant Prefect Cheng Guang acting prefect."

sentences.zh: 六年，芒部賊沙保等謀復隴氏，擁隴壽子勝糾眾攻陷鎮雄城，執程洸，奪其印，殺傷數百人，洸奔畢節。

translations.literal: In the sixth year the Mangbu rebel Sha Bao and others plotted to restore the Long clan, rallied Long Shou's son Sheng, attacked and took Zhenxiong city, seized Cheng Guang, stole his seal, killed and wounded several hundred people, and Guang fled to Bijie.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 Sha Bao and other Mangbu rebels sought to restore the Longs, rallied Shou's purported son Sheng, stormed Zhenxiong, seized Cheng Guang and his seal, killed hundreds, and Guang fled to Bijie.

sentences.zh: 事聞，兵科給事中鄭自壁等言：「鎮雄初設流官，蠻情未服，而有司失先事之防，不亟收遣裔隴勝，而令沙保得擁孺子，致煽禍一方。

translations.literal: When reported, Supervising Secretary Zheng Zibi and others said: "Zhenxiong had only just received a circulating official and tribal sentiment was not yet subdued; the authorities failed to take precautions beforehand, did not promptly detain the Long heir Sheng, and let Sha Bao rally a child to inflame trouble in the region.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Zibi reported: "Zhenxiong had just been placed under a regular prefect and the tribes were unsettled. Officials failed to detain the Long heir Sheng, allowing Sha Bao to raise a child rebel and ignite the region.

sentences.zh: 宜速遣總兵何卿並力剿寇。

translations.literal: The overall commander He Qing should be sent at once to join forces in suppressing the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: "Send He Qing immediately to join the suppression.

sentences.zh: 」於是兵部覆言：「隴勝非真隴壽子，故議設流官，有司撫循失策，遂生叛亂。

translations.literal: " The Ministry replied: "Sheng is not truly Long Shou's son—hence the plan for a circulating official; the authorities' failure in pacification produced rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: " The Ministry replied: "Sheng is not Shou's true son—hence the circulating prefect plan. Poor governance bred rebellion.

sentences.zh: 沙保罪不容誅，當剿。

translations.literal: Sha Bao's crime admits no pardon and should be suppressed.
translations.idiomatic: "Sha Bao must be destroyed.

sentences.zh: 何卿方守松潘，勢難相援，宜亟趣都御史王廷相之任，並敕總兵牛桓調兵速進。

translations.literal: He Qing is holding Songpan and cannot easily assist; Wang Tingxiang, Censor-in-Chief, should be urged to take up his post quickly, and Overall Commander Niu Huan ordered to advance with troops in haste.
translations.idiomatic: "He Qing holds Songpan and cannot help; hurry Wang Tingxiang to his post and order Niu Huan forward.

sentences.zh: 」時沙保出鎮雄府印乞降，然尚持兩端，欲立土官如故。

translations.literal: At that time Sha Bao produced the Zhenxiong seal to beg surrender, yet still wavered, wishing to restore a native official as before.
translations.idiomatic: Sha Bao then offered the seal to surrender but still hedged, wanting a native prefect restored.

sentences.zh: 四川撫按以保狡悍不可馴，檄瀘州守備丁勇擊之。

translations.literal: The Sichuan grand coordinator and surveillance commissioner, judging Sha Bao cunning and untamable, ordered Luzhou garrison commander Ding Yong to attack.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan officials, deeming Sha Bao too crafty to tame, ordered Ding Yong of Luzhou to strike.

sentences.zh: 又遣使勞賜芒部撫夷郤良佐，使計擒沙保。

translations.literal: Envoys were also sent to reward Mangbu pacification officer Xi Liangzuo and have him devise Sha Bao's capture.
translations.idiomatic: They also rewarded Mangbu pacifier Xi Liangzuo and tasked him with capturing Sha Bao.

sentences.zh: 保怒，復叛。

translations.literal: Sha Bao grew angry and rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: Enraged, Sha Bao rebelled again.

sentences.zh: 七年，川、貴諸軍會剿，敗沙保等，擒斬三百余級，招撫蠻羅男婦以千計。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Sichuan and Guizhou armies campaigned jointly, defeated Sha Bao and others, cut off more than three hundred heads, and pacified more than a thousand barbarian men and women.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 joint Sichuan and Guizhou forces defeated Sha Bao, took three hundred heads, and pacified over a thousand tribespeople.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，設鎮雄流官如舊。

translations.literal: Victory was reported and the circulating official system at Zhenxiong was restored as before.
translations.idiomatic: Victory was announced and Zhenxiong's circulating prefect was restored.

sentences.zh: 而芒部、烏撒、毋響苗蠻隴革等復起，攻劫畢節屯堡，殺掠士民，紛紛見告。

translations.literal: Yet the Mangbu, Wusa, and Wuxiang Miao rebels Long Ge and others rose again, attacked Bijie garrisons, killed and plundered subjects, and complaints poured in.
translations.idiomatic: But Long Ge and other Mangbu, Wusa, and Wuxiang rebels attacked Bijie posts, killing and looting; petitions flooded in.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書李承勛以伍文定專主用兵為失計，疏及之。

translations.literal: Minister of War Li Chengxun criticized Wu Wending's exclusive reliance on force as misguided and memorialized accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Li Chengxun criticized Wu Wending for relying solely on arms and memorialized against it.

sentences.zh: 而御史楊彜復言芒部改土易流非長策，又時值荒饉，小民救死不贍，何能趣戰。

translations.literal: Censor Yang Yi also said that replacing natives with circulating officials at Mangbu was no long-term policy, and that amid famine the common people could scarcely feed themselves—how could they be driven to war.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Yang Yi argued that converting Mangbu from native to regular rule was unwise; in famine peasants could not feed themselves, let alone fight.

sentences.zh: 時帝亦軫念災傷，令罷芒部兵，俟有秋再議征討。

translations.literal: The Emperor, mindful of disaster and hardship, ordered the Mangbu campaign halted until autumn, when suppression might be reconsidered.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor, moved by suffering, halted the Mangbu campaign until autumn.

sentences.zh: 於是四川巡撫唐鳳儀言：「烏蒙、烏撒、東川諸土官，故與芒部為唇齒。

translations.literal: Thereupon Sichuan Grand Coordinator Tang Fengyi said: "The native officials of Wumeng, Wusa, and Dongchuan were formerly lip and teeth with Mangbu.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Fengyi wrote: "Wumeng, Wusa, and Dongchuan chiefs were once allies of Mangbu.

sentences.zh: 自芒部改流，諸部內懷不安，以是反者數起。

translations.literal: Since Mangbu was converted to circulating rule, the various departments inwardly felt insecure, and for this reason rebels have risen repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: "Since Mangbu went regular, the others grew uneasy and rebellions multiplied.

sentences.zh: 今懷德長官阿濟等雖自詭擒賊，其心固望隴勝得一職，以存隴後。

translations.literal: Now although Huaide Long Chief A Ji pretends to have captured rebels, in his heart he surely hopes Sheng may gain a post to preserve the Long line.
translations.idiomatic: "Though A Ji of Huaide claims captures, he surely hopes Sheng will keep the Long line alive.

sentences.zh: 臣請如宣德中復安南故事，俯順輿情，則不假兵而禍源自塞。

translations.literal: I beg, as when Annam was restored in Xuande, to bow to popular sentiment—then without troops the source of trouble will be blocked.
translations.idiomatic: "I ask, as in the Xuande restoration of Annam, to follow popular will—then trouble will cease without armies.

sentences.zh: 」川、貴巡按戴金、陳講等奏如鳳儀言。

translations.literal: The Sichuan and Guizhou surveillance commissioners Dai Jin and Chen Jiang memorialized as Fengyi proposed.
translations.idiomatic: Surveillance commissioners Dai Jin and Chen Jiang agreed with Fengyi.

sentences.zh: 金又以首惡如毋響、祖保等，宜剿誅以折其驕氣，始下撫處之令，許生獻沙保等，待阿濟以不死，然後復隴勝故職，或降為知州。

translations.literal: Jin also said that ringleaders such as Wuxiang and Zu Bao should be executed to break their arrogance; only then should pacification orders be issued, allowing A Ji to deliver Sha Bao alive and sparing him death, then restoring Sheng to his former office or reducing him to prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Jin added that ringleaders like Wuxiang and Zu Bao should be killed to humble them; then offer pacification—A Ji to capture Sha Bao alive, spare A Ji, restore or reduce Sheng's rank.

sentences.zh: 其長官或因或革，或分隸，庶操縱得宜，恩威並著。

translations.literal: The long-chief offices might be retained or abolished or placed under other jurisdictions, so that control would be proper and grace and awe both displayed.
translations.idiomatic: "Long-chief posts could be kept, abolished, or reassigned so grace and terror both applied.

sentences.zh: 章下部覆，乃革鎮雄流官知府，而以隴勝為通判，署鎮雄府事。

translations.literal: The memorial went to the ministry for reply; the circulating prefect of Zhenxiong was abolished and Long Sheng made assistant prefect in charge of Zhenxiong affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry approved: Zhenxiong's circulating prefect was removed and Long Sheng made acting assistant prefect.

sentences.zh: 令三年後果能率職奉貢，準復知府舊銜。

translations.literal: If after three years he truly performed his duties and presented tribute, he might recover his former prefectural title.
translations.idiomatic: "If in three years he governed well and paid tribute, he could regain the prefectural title.

sentences.zh: 時嘉靖九年四月也。

translations.literal: This was in the fourth month of the ninth year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: This was Jiajing year 9, fourth month.

sentences.zh: 三十九年命勘東川阿堂之亂。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year an order was issued to investigate the Dongchuan turmoil of A Tang.
translations.idiomatic: In year 39 the court ordered an inquiry into Dongchuan's A Tang rebellion.

sentences.zh: 初，東川土知府祿慶死，子位幼，妻安氏攝府事。

translations.literal: Initially Dongchuan native prefect Lu Qing died; his son Wei was young and his wife Lady An governed the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Dongchuan Prefect Lu Qing had died; his young son Wei left Lady An as regent.

sentences.zh: 有營長阿得革頗擅權，謀奪其官。

translations.literal: A camp chief, A Dege, was quite powerful and plotted to seize the office.
translations.idiomatic: Camp chief A Dege grew powerful and plotted to seize the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 因先求烝安氏不得，乃縱火焚府治，走武定州，為土官所殺。

translations.literal: Having first sought to take Lady An in levirate marriage and failed, he set fire to the prefectural compound and fled to Wuding Prefecture, where the native official killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Denied levirate marriage with Lady An, he burned the yamen and fled to Wuding, where the native chief killed him.

sentences.zh: 得革子堂奔水西，賄結烏撒土官安泰，入東川，囚安氏，奪其印。

translations.literal: Dege's son Tang fled to Shuixi, bribed Wusa chief An Tai, entered Dongchuan, imprisoned Lady An, and seized the seal.
translations.idiomatic: Dege's son Tang fled to Shuixi, bribed Wusa's An Tai, entered Dongchuan, imprisoned Lady An, and took the seal.

sentences.zh: 貴州宣慰安萬銓故與祿氏姻連，乃起兵攻阿堂所居寨，破之。

translations.literal: Guizhou Pacification Commissioner An Wanchuan was allied by marriage with the Lu clan and raised troops to attack Tang's stockade and break it.
translations.idiomatic: An Wanchuan of Guizhou, tied to the Lu clan by marriage, attacked Tang's fort and destroyed it.

sentences.zh: 堂妻阿聚攜幼子奔沾益州土官安九鼎。

translations.literal: Tang's wife A Ju fled with her young son to Qiyi Prefecture native official An Jiuding.
translations.idiomatic: Tang's wife A Ju fled with their child to Qiyi chief An Jiuding.

sentences.zh: 萬銓脅九鼎，取阿聚及幼子殺之。

translations.literal: Wanchuan coerced Jiuding, took A Ju and the child, and killed them.
translations.idiomatic: Wanchuan forced Jiuding to hand over A Ju and the child and killed them.

sentences.zh: 堂以是怨九鼎，時相攻擊。

translations.literal: Tang therefore resented Jiuding, and at times they attacked each other.
translations.idiomatic: Tang then hated Jiuding and they raided each other.

sentences.zh: 堂兵侵羅雄州境，九鼎及祿位與羅雄土官者浚等，各上書訟堂罪。

translations.literal: Tang's troops encroached on Luoxiong Prefecture; Jiuding, Lu Wei, and the Luoxiong native official Zhe Jun each memorialized Tang's crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Tang invaded Luoxiong; Jiuding, Lu Wei, and Luoxiong chief Zhe Jun all accused him.

sentences.zh: 詔下雲、貴、四川撫按官會勘。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the grand coordinators and surveillance commissioners of Yunnan, Guizhou, and Sichuan to investigate jointly.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Yunnan, Guizhou, and Sichuan officials to investigate together.

sentences.zh: 堂聽勘於車洪江，具服罪，願獻所劫府印並沾益、羅雄人口牲畜及侵地，乞貸死。

translations.literal: Tang submitted to investigation at Chehong River, confessed guilt, and offered the stolen seal with the people, livestock, and seized lands of Qiyi and Luoxiong, begging for his life.
translations.idiomatic: Tang submitted at Chehong River, confessed, offered the seal and seized people, livestock, and lands of Qiyi and Luoxiong, and begged for life.

sentences.zh: 時位及弟僎已前歿，官府因訊祿氏所當襲者，堂以己幼子詭名祿哲以報。

translations.literal: Wei and his younger brother Zhuan had already died earlier; the government inquired who should inherit the Lu clan; Tang reported his own young son under the false name Lu Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: Wei and brother Zhuan were dead; asked who should inherit, Tang named his own son falsely as Lu Zhe.

sentences.zh: 據府印如故，復與九鼎治兵相攻。

translations.literal: He held the prefectural seal as before and again raised troops against Jiuding.
translations.idiomatic: He kept the seal and again fought Jiuding.

sentences.zh: 九鼎訴之雲南巡撫遊居敬，謂堂怙亂，請致討，且自詭當率所部為前鋒，必擒堂以獻。

translations.literal: Jiuding complained to Yunnan Grand Coordinator You Jujing, saying Tang relied on chaos and should be punished, and falsely claimed he would lead his own followers as vanguard and surely capture Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Jiuding told You Jujing that Tang remained defiant and should be attacked, boasting he would lead the vanguard and capture Tang.

sentences.zh: 居敬信之，遂上疏言堂念惡不悛，請專意進剿，為地方除害。

translations.literal: Jujing believed him and memorialized that Tang's evil heart was unrepentant and a dedicated campaign should eliminate this harm to the region.
translations.idiomatic: Jujing believed him and urged a dedicated campaign to remove this scourge.

sentences.zh: 帝允部議，行川、貴撫按會勘具奏。

translations.literal: The Emperor approved the ministry's deliberation and ordered the Sichuan and Guizhou grand coordinators to investigate jointly and report.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor approved and ordered joint investigation by Sichuan and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 居敬遽調土漢兵五萬余進剿。

translations.literal: Jujing hastily mobilized more than fifty thousand native and Han troops for punitive expedition.
translations.idiomatic: Jujing rashly mobilized over fifty thousand troops.

sentences.zh: 雲南承平久，一旦兵動，費用不貲，賦斂百出，諸軍衛及有司土官舍等乘之為奸利，遠近騷動。

translations.literal: Yunnan had long been at peace; suddenly war broke out, expenses were boundless, levies multiplied, military guards and native clerks profited corruptly, and the region was thrown into turmoil far and near.
translations.idiomatic: Long peaceful, Yunnan now faced endless expense, multiplying levies, corrupt profiteering by guards and native clerks, and turmoil everywhere.

sentences.zh: 巡按王大任言：「逆堂奪印謀官，法所必誅。

translations.literal: Surveillance Commissioner Wang Daren said: "The rebel Tang seized the seal and plotted for office—by law he must be executed.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Daren wrote: "Tang stole the seal and sought office—he must die by law.

sentences.zh: 第彼猶借朝廷之印以約土蠻，冒祿氏之宗以圖世職，而四川之差稅辦納以時，雲、貴之鄰壤未見侵越，此其非叛明矣。

translations.literal: Yet he still borrows the court's seal to bind the tribes and usurps the Lu clan name to seek hereditary office; Sichuan's levies are paid on time and Yunnan and Guizhou neighbors have not been invaded—this shows he is not in open rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: "Yet he still uses the court seal to command tribes and the Lu name for hereditary office; Sichuan taxes are paid and neighbors unharmed—this is not open rebellion.

sentences.zh: 其與九鼎治兵相攻，彼此俱屬有罪。

translations.literal: His raising troops against Jiuding—both sides are guilty.
translations.idiomatic: "His war with Jiuding makes both sides guilty.

sentences.zh: 居敬乃信一偏之詭辭，違會勘之明旨，輕動大眾，恐生意外患。

translations.literal: Jujing trusted one-sided deceit, violated the joint-investigation edict, and lightly moved a great host—I fear unexpected trouble will arise.
translations.idiomatic: "Jujing trusted deceit, defied joint investigation, and moved a huge army—I fear worse trouble.

sentences.zh: 且外議籍籍，謂居敬入九鼎重賄，欲為雪怨，及受各土官賂，攘盜帑積，皆有實跡。

translations.literal: Moreover public talk holds that Jujing took heavy bribes from Jiuding to avenge a grudge and accepted bribes from various chiefs, plundering the treasury—all with solid evidence.
translations.idiomatic: "Rumor says Jujing took Jiuding's heavy bribes for revenge and chiefs' bribes, looting the treasury—with evidence.

sentences.zh: 請亟罷居敬，暫停征剿為便。

translations.literal: I beg that Jujing be removed at once and the campaign suspended for the present.
translations.idiomatic: "Remove Jujing immediately and halt the campaign.

sentences.zh: 」乃命逮居敬。

translations.literal: " An order was issued to arrest Jujing.
translations.idiomatic: " Jujing was ordered arrested.

sentences.zh: 時堂聞大兵至東川，逃深箐，諸將分兵於新舊諸城，窮搜不獲，地方民夷大遭屠掠。

translations.literal: By then Tang, hearing the great army had reached Dongchuan, fled into deep ravines; the generals divided troops among old and new cities and searched exhaustively without finding him; local tribes and subjects suffered great slaughter.
translations.idiomatic: Tang fled to deep ravines; generals searched old and new cities in vain; tribes and civilians suffered massacre.

sentences.zh: 四十年，營長者阿易謀於堂之心腹母勒阿濟等，掩殺堂於戛來矣石之地，其子阿哲就擒，哲時年八歲。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year camp chief A Yi plotted with Tang's confidants Mule A Ji and others to ambush and kill Tang at Galai Shishi; his son Azhe was captured—Azhe was then eight years old.
translations.idiomatic: In year 40 camp chief A Yi and Tang's confidants ambushed and killed Tang at Galai Shishi; son Azhe, eight years old, was taken.

sentences.zh: 事雖定，而府印不知所在。

translations.literal: Though the affair was settled, the prefectural seal could not be found.
translations.idiomatic: The case ended but the prefectural seal was lost.

sentences.zh: 於是安萬銓取東川府經歷印，畀祿位妻寧著署之，以照磨印畀羅雄土官者浚，而以寧著女妻者浚子。

translations.literal: Thereupon An Wanchuan took the Dongchuan prefectural experience seal and gave it to Lu Wei's wife Ning Zhu to act as regent, gave the registrar seal to Luoxiong chief Zhe Jun, and married Ning Zhu's daughter to Jun's son.
translations.idiomatic: An Wanchuan gave the experience seal to Ning Zhu, Wei's wife, as regent, the registrar seal to Zhe Jun of Luoxiong, and married Ning Zhu's daughter to Jun's son.

sentences.zh: 仍留水西兵三千於東川，為寧著防衛。

translations.literal: He still left three thousand Shuixi troops in Dongchuan to guard Ning Zhu.
translations.idiomatic: Three thousand Shuixi troops remained in Dongchuan to guard Ning Zhu.

sentences.zh: 水西與東川鄰，萬銓本水西土官，故議者謂其有陰據東川之誌。

translations.literal: Shuixi bordered Dongchuan; Wanchuan was originally a Shuixi native official—commentators said he harbored a secret design to hold Dongchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Shuixi bordered Dongchuan; Wanchuan was a Shuixi chief—observers said he meant to control Dongchuan.

sentences.zh: 巡按王大任以誅阿堂聞，因言：「東川地方殘傷，該府三印悉為土官部置，請通敕川、貴總督及鎮巡官，按究各土官私擅標署之罪。

translations.literal: Surveillance Commissioner Wang Daren reported Tang's execution and said: "Dongchuan's land is ravaged; all three prefectural seals are deployed by native chiefs; I beg a general edict to the Sichuan and Guizhou governors and frontier officials to investigate the crime of chiefs privately issuing seals.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Daren reported Tang's death: "Dongchuan is ruined; three seals are held by chiefs. Order governors to punish private seals.

sentences.zh: 並訪祿氏支派之宜立，與所以處阿哲者。

translations.literal: And inquire whom among the Lu clan should be established and how Azhe should be dealt with.
translations.idiomatic: "Also find the right Lu heir and decide Azhe's fate.

sentences.zh: 」部覆報可。

translations.literal: " The ministry replied that it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The ministry agreed.

sentences.zh: 四十一年鑄給四川東川府印。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year a new seal was cast for Sichuan's Dongchuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In year 41 a new seal was cast for Dongchuan Prefecture in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 初，阿堂既誅，索府印不獲，人疑為安萬銓所匿，及是屢勘，印實亡失。

translations.literal: Initially after Tang was executed the seal could not be found; people suspected An Wanchuan had hidden it; repeated investigations proved it was truly lost.
translations.idiomatic: After Tang's death the seal was missing; many suspected Wanchuan; investigations proved it lost.

sentences.zh: 而祿位近派悉絕，惟同六世祖有幼男阿采。

translations.literal: The near line of Lu Wei was extinct; only a young boy A Cai remained from the same sixth-generation ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Wei's direct line was gone; only young A Cai of the same sixth-generation branch remained.

sentences.zh: 撫按官雷賀、陳瓚請以采襲祿氏職，姑予同知銜，令寧著署掌，後果能撫輯其眾，仍進襲知府。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Lei He and Surveillance Commissioner Chen Zan requested that Cai inherit the Lu office, first with assistant-prefect rank and Ning Zhu acting in charge; if he later could pacify the people, he might advance to full prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Lei He and Chen Zan asked that Cai inherit with assistant-prefect rank under Ning Zhu; if he governed well, promote to prefect.

sentences.zh: 其新印請更名，以防奸偽。

translations.literal: They asked that the new seal be renamed to guard against fraud.
translations.idiomatic: They asked to rename the new seal against forgery.

sentences.zh: 有旨不必更，余如議。

translations.literal: An edict said renaming was unnecessary; the rest as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: The throne declined renaming; otherwise as proposed.

sentences.zh: 先是，烏撒與永寧、烏蒙、沾益、水西諸土官，境土相連，世戚親厚，既而以各私所親，彼此構禍，奏訐紛紜，詳四川《永寧土司傳》中，當事者頗厭苦之。

translations.literal: Earlier Wusa, Yongning, Wumeng, Qiyi, Shuixi, and other native officials had adjoining territories and were kin for generations; later each favored his own allies and brought lawsuits and mutual attacks—detailed in the Sichuan "Yongning Tribal Headmen" biography—and the authorities grew weary of it.
translations.idiomatic: Wusa, Yongning, Wumeng, Qiyi, and Shuixi had long been neighbors and kin; later they feuded through favoritism—see the Yongning biography—and officials wearied of it.

sentences.zh: 萬歷六年乃令照蠻俗罰牛例處分，務悔禍息爭，以保境安民，然終不能靖也。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Wanli an order followed the barbarian custom of fining cattle to settle disputes, urging repentance and peace to secure the borders—yet tranquility was never achieved.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli year 6 the court applied the tribal cattle-fine custom to end feuds and keep peace—yet calm never came.

sentences.zh: 三十八年詔東川土司並聽雲南節制。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year an edict placed Dongchuan native officials under Yunnan's jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In year 38 Dongchuan chiefs were placed under Yunnan's authority.

sentences.zh: 時巡按鄧氵美疏稱：「蜀之東川逼處武定、尋甸諸郡，只隔一嶺，出沒無時，朝發夕至。

translations.literal: At that time Surveillance Commissioner Deng Mei memorialized: "Sichuan's Dongchuan presses against Wuding and Xundian prefectures, separated by only one ridge; raids come and go overnight.
translations.idiomatic: Surveillance Commissioner Deng Mei wrote: "Dongchuan borders Wuding and Xundian—a single ridge away; raids strike overnight.

sentences.zh: 其酋長祿壽、祿哲兄弟，安忍無親，日尋幹戈。

translations.literal: Its chiefs Lu Shou and Lu Zhe, brothers cruel and kinless, daily seek battle.
translations.idiomatic: "Chiefs Lu Shou and Lu Zhe, cruel brothers, fight daily.

sentences.zh: 其部落以劫殺為生，不事耕作。

translations.literal: Their followers live by raiding and killing and do not farm.
translations.idiomatic: "Their people raid rather than farm.

sentences.zh: 蜀轄遼遠，法紀易疏。

translations.literal: Sichuan's rule is distant and discipline grows lax.
translations.idiomatic: "Sichuan is too distant; law grows slack.

sentences.zh: 滇以非我屬內，號令不行。

translations.literal: Yunnan does not count them as subjects, so orders do not reach them.
translations.idiomatic: "Yunnan does not treat them as subjects, so orders fail.

sentences.zh: 以是驕蹇成習，目無漢法。

translations.literal: Thus arrogance became habit and they held Han law in contempt.
translations.idiomatic: "Hence arrogance flourished and they despised imperial law.

sentences.zh: 今惟改敕滇撫兼制東川。

translations.literal: Now only change the edict so the Yunnan grand coordinator also controls Dongchuan.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial asked only that the Yunnan grand coordinator be given joint authority over Dongchuan.

sentences.zh: 」因條三利以進，詔從之。

translations.literal: " He then submitted three benefits and the court approved.
translations.idiomatic: " He listed three advantages; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 先是，四川烏撒軍民府，雲南沾益州，雖滇、蜀異轄，宗派一源。

translations.literal: Earlier, Sichuan's Wusa military-civilian prefecture and Yunnan's Qiyi Prefecture, though under different jurisdictions of Yunnan and Shu, were one lineage.
translations.idiomatic: Wusa in Sichuan and Qiyi in Yunnan, though under different provinces, shared one clan.

sentences.zh: 明初大軍南下，女土官實卜與夫弟阿哥二人，率眾歸順，授實卜以烏撒土知府，授阿哥以沾益土知州。

translations.literal: When the great army went south at the beginning of Ming, the female native official Shibu and her husband's younger brother Age led their followers in submission; Shibu was appointed Wusa native prefect and Age was appointed Qiyi native prefect.
translations.idiomatic: At the Ming conquest, female chief Shibu and her brother-in-law Age submitted; Shibu became Wusa prefect and Age Qiyi prefect.

sentences.zh: 其後，彼絕此繼，通為一家。

translations.literal: Later one line died out and the other continued, and they became one family.
translations.idiomatic: Later one branch died out and the other continued until they were one house.

sentences.zh: 萬歷元年，沾益女土官安素儀無嗣，奏以土知府祿墨次子繼本州，即安紹慶也。

translations.literal: In the first year of Wanli the Qiyi female native official An Suyi had no heir and memorialized that the second son of Wusa native prefect Lu Mo should succeed in this prefecture—this was An Shaoqing.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli year 1 Qiyi chief An Suyi, childless, asked that Lu Mo's second son succeed at Qiyi—An Shaoqing.

sentences.zh: 已，祿墨及長子安雲龍與兩孫俱歿，安紹慶奏以次子安效良歸宗，襲土知府。

translations.literal: Later Lu Mo and his eldest son An Yunlong and both grandsons died; An Shaoqing memorialized that his second son An Xiaoliang should return to the clan and inherit the native prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After Lu Mo, Yunlong, and both grandsons died, Shaoqing asked that second son Xiaoliang return to inherit Wusa.

sentences.zh: 安雲龍之妻隴氏，即鎮雄女土官者氏之女也，以雲龍雖故，尚有遺孤，且挾外家兵力，與紹慶為敵。

translations.literal: Yunlong's wife was of the Long clan, daughter of the Zhenxiong female native official Zhe Shi; though Yunlong was dead she still had a posthumous orphan and relied on her mother's family's troops in enmity with Shaoqing.
translations.idiomatic: Yunlong's widow Long, daughter of Zhenxiong's female chief, claimed a surviving heir and, backed by her kin, fought Shaoqing.

sentences.zh: 紹慶則以隴氏所出，明系假子，亦倚沾益兵力，與隴氏為難。

translations.literal: Shaoqing held that Long's son was clearly a false heir and also relied on Qiyi troops in strife with the Long clan.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoqing called Long's son a pretender and, backed by Qiyi, warred with Long.

sentences.zh: 彼此仇殺，流毒一方。

translations.literal: They killed one another in feud and poisoned the whole region.
translations.idiomatic: Their mutual slaughter ravaged the region.

sentences.zh: 士民連名上奏，事行兩省會勘，歷十有四年不結。

translations.literal: The people jointly memorialized by name; the case was sent for joint investigation by the two provinces, and for fourteen years no conclusion was reached.
translations.idiomatic: Subjects petitioned jointly; two provinces investigated for fourteen years without resolution.

sentences.zh: 是年，安雲翔奏稱：「隴氏有子官保，今已長成。

translations.literal: That year An Yunxiang memorialized: "The Long clan has a son Guanbao who has now come of age.
translations.idiomatic: That year Yunxiang reported: "Long has a son Guanbao now grown.

sentences.zh: 效良倚父兵，強圖竊據，殺戮無辜。

translations.literal: Xiaoliang relies on his father's troops and forcibly seeks to seize power, killing the innocent.
translations.idiomatic: "Xiaoliang uses his father's army to seize power and kill innocents.

sentences.zh: 」因極言效良不可立者數事。

translations.literal: " He then set forth at length several reasons why Xiaoliang could not be established.
translations.idiomatic: " He listed many reasons Xiaoliang must not succeed.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，廷臣議行川、貴大吏勘報。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year court officials deliberated sending the great officials of Sichuan and Guizhou to investigate and report.
translations.idiomatic: In year 39 the court ordered Sichuan and Guizhou to investigate.

sentences.zh: 貴州撫臣以土官爭職在雲南，而為害在黔、蜀，必得三省會勘，始可定獄。

translations.literal: The Guizhou grand coordinator said the native officials' struggle for office lay in Yunnan but the harm fell on Guizhou and Shu; only a three-province joint investigation could settle the case.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou argued the feud was in Yunnan but the damage in Guizhou and Sichuan—three provinces must judge together.

sentences.zh: 帝命速勘，乃命隴鶴書承襲鎮雄土知府。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered rapid investigation and appointed Long Heshu to succeed as Zhenxiong native prefect.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered swift inquiry and named Long Heshu Zhenxiong prefect.

sentences.zh: 鶴書，原名阿卜，自其始祖隴飛沙獻土歸順，授為世職知府，五傳而為庶魯卜，別居於果利地，又四傳而為庶祿姑，別居夷良、七欠頭地，又五傳而隴氏之正支斬矣。

translations.literal: Heshu, originally named Abu, from the time his ancestor Long Feisha submitted lands and was granted hereditary prefect, passed five generations to the collateral Lubu, who settled separately at Guoli, then four more to the collateral Lugu, who settled at Yiliang and Qiqian, and after five more generations the direct Long line was cut off.
translations.idiomatic: Heshu, born Abu, descended from Long Feisha's enfeoffment; after collateral branches at Guoli and Yiliang, the main Long line ended.

sentences.zh: 水西安堯臣贅於祿，欲奄有之，眾論不平，始有驅安立隴之奏，奉旨察立隴後。

translations.literal: Shuixi's An Yaochan married into the Lu clan and wished to swallow the territory; public opinion was outraged, and memorials arose to drive An out and establish Long—an edict ordered investigation to install a Long heir.
translations.idiomatic: An Yaochan of Shuixi married in and sought to seize the domain; the court ordered a Long heir found.

sentences.zh: 女官者氏以阿固應。

translations.literal: The female official Zhe Shi nominated Agu.
translations.idiomatic: Female chief Zhe Shi proposed Agu.

sentences.zh: 阿固者，魯卜之六世孫，而易名隴正名者也。

translations.literal: Agu was the sixth-generation descendant of Lubu, who had changed his name to Long Zhengming.
translations.idiomatic: Agu was Lubu's sixth-generation descendant, renamed Long Zhengming.

sentences.zh: 於是主立阿固，而先立其父阿章。

translations.literal: Thereupon the majority favored establishing Agu, but first established his father Azhang.
translations.idiomatic: They first installed Agu's father Azhang, then Agu.

sentences.zh: 章尋病死，阿固不為夷眾所服，往復察勘。

translations.literal: Zhang soon died of illness; Agu was not accepted by the tribes and investigation was reopened.
translations.idiomatic: Azhang died; the tribes rejected Agu and inquiry resumed.

sentences.zh: 者氏及四十八目、十五火頭等共推阿卜。

translations.literal: Zhe Shi with forty-eight chiefs and fifteen fire-headmen jointly recommended Abu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhe Shi, forty-eight chiefs, and fifteen fire-heads backed Abu.

sentences.zh: 阿卜者，祿姑之五世孫，鹹以為長且賢，而者氏且以印獻，遂定立阿卜，而以阿固充管事，從巡撫喬應星之議也。

translations.literal: Abu was the fifth-generation descendant of Lugu; all considered him eldest and worthy, and Zhe Shi also presented the seal; Abu was finally established and Agu made steward, following Grand Coordinator Qiao Yingxing's proposal.
translations.idiomatic: Abu, Lugu's fifth-generation heir, was chosen as eldest and worthy; Zhe Shi offered the seal; Agu became steward per Qiao Yingxing.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，烏撒土舍安效良初與安雲翔爭立，朝廷以嫡派立效良。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year Wusa native clerk An Xiaoliang at first contended with An Yunxiang for succession; the court established Xiaoliang as the legitimate line.
