translations.idiomatic: In year 41 Xiaoliang and Yunxiang contested Wusa; the court favored Xiaoliang as legitimate.

sentences.zh: 雲翔數為亂，謀逐效良，焚劫烏撒。

translations.literal: Yunxiang repeatedly made trouble, plotting to drive out Xiaoliang and burning and plundering Wusa.
translations.idiomatic: Yunxiang rebelled repeatedly, raiding Wusa to oust Xiaoliang.

sentences.zh: 四川撫按上其事，以效良為雲龍親侄，雲翔乃其堂弟，親疏判然，效良自當立。

translations.literal: The Sichuan grand coordinator and surveillance commissioner reported that Xiaoliang was Yunlong's close nephew while Yunxiang was a younger cousin—the degree of kinship was clear and Xiaoliang should hold office.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan reported Xiaoliang was Yunlong's nephew, Yunxiang only a cousin—Xiaoliang should rule.

sentences.zh: 雲翔擾害地方，欺罔朝廷，罪原難赦，但為奸人指使，情可原，姑準復冠帶。

translations.literal: Yunxiang had harmed the region and deceived the court; his crime could hardly be pardoned, yet he was led astray by villains and sentiment could be indulged—his cap and belt were provisionally restored.
translations.idiomatic: Yunxiang's crimes were grave but blamed on others; his rank was provisionally restored.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The court approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 四十三年，雲南巡按吳應琦言：「東川土官祿壽、祿哲爭襲以來，各縱部眾，越境劫掠。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year Yunnan Surveillance Commissioner Wu Yingqi said: "Since the Dongchuan chiefs Lu Shou and Lu Zhe contended for succession, each has let his followers cross borders to raid.
translations.idiomatic: In year 43 Wu Yingqi wrote: "Since Lu Shou and Lu Zhe fought over Dongchuan, their followers have raided across borders.

sentences.zh: 擁眾千余，剽掠兩府，浹旬之間，村屯並掃，荼毒未有如此之甚者。

translations.literal: Massing more than a thousand men, they plundered both prefectures; within ten days villages were swept bare—never had poison spread so terribly.
translations.idiomatic: "Over a thousand strong, they ravaged both prefectures for ten days—unprecedented devastation.

sentences.zh: 或撫或剿，毋令養禍日滋。

translations.literal: Whether by pacification or suppression, do not let the calamity daily grow.
translations.idiomatic: "Pacify or suppress before the evil grows worse.

sentences.zh: 」下所司勘奏。

translations.literal: " The matter was sent down for investigation and memorial.
translations.idiomatic: " The case was referred for inquiry.

sentences.zh: 貴州巡按御史楊鶴言：「烏撒土官，自安雲龍物故，安咀與安效良爭官奪印，仇殺者二十年。

translations.literal: Guizhou Surveillance Commissioner Yang He said: "Since Wusa native official An Yunlong died, An Ju and An Xiaoliang have fought over office and seal in mutual killing for twenty years.
translations.idiomatic: Yang He of Guizhou wrote: "Since Yunlong's death, Ju and Xiaoliang have fought over Wusa for twenty years.

sentences.zh: 夷民無統，盜寇蜂起，堡屯焚毀，行賈梗絕者亦二十年。

translations.literal: The tribes had no leader, bandits swarmed, garrison posts burned, and merchants were blocked for twenty years.
translations.idiomatic: "Tribes were leaderless, bandits rampant, posts burned, trade halted twenty years.

sentences.zh: 是爭官奪印者蜀之土官，而蹂踐糜爛者黔之赤子。

translations.literal: Those who fought for office and seal were Shu native officials, yet those trampled and ruined were Guizhou's common people.
translations.idiomatic: "Sichuan chiefs fought, but Guizhou's people suffered.

sentences.zh: 誠改隸於黔，則彈壓既便，幹戈可戢。

translations.literal: If truly placed under Guizhou, suppression would be convenient and arms could be laid down.
translations.idiomatic: "Transfer to Guizhou would ease control and end the war.

sentences.zh: 」又言：「烏撒者，滇、蜀之咽喉要地。

translations.literal: " He also said: "Wusa is the vital throat of Yunnan and Shu.
translations.idiomatic: " He added: "Wusa is the throat between Yunnan and Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 臣由普安入滇，七日始達烏撒。

translations.literal: I entered Yunnan from Pu'an and only reached Wusa on the seventh day.
translations.idiomatic: "I traveled seven days from Pu'an to reach Wusa.

sentences.zh: 見效良之父安紹慶據沾益，當曲靖之門戶。

translations.literal: I saw Xiaoliang's father An Shaoqing holding Qiyi, blocking Qujing's gateway.
translations.idiomatic: "Shaoqing held Qiyi at Qujing's gate.

sentences.zh: 效良據烏撒，又扼滇、蜀之咽喉。

translations.literal: Xiaoliang held Wusa and again choked the throat between Yunnan and Shu.
translations.idiomatic: "Xiaoliang held Wusa and choked the route between provinces.

sentences.zh: 父子各據一方，且壤地相接，無他郡縣上司以隔絕鈐制之，將來尾大不掉，實可寒心。

translations.literal: Father and son each held a territory with adjoining lands and no intervening prefecture or county superior to separate and control them—hereafter if they grew too large to manage it would truly be chilling.
translations.idiomatic: "Father and son held adjoining realms with no superior between—future rebellion was frightening.

sentences.zh: 蓋黔有可制之勢，而無其權；

translations.literal: Guizhou had the advantage of control but not the authority;
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou could restrain them but lacked jurisdiction;

sentences.zh: 蜀有遙制之名，而無其實。

translations.literal: Shu had the name of distant control but not the reality.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan had nominal authority but no real power.

sentences.zh: 誠以為隸黔中便。

translations.literal: It is truly more convenient to place them under Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Placement under Guizhou was best.

sentences.zh: 」帝命所司速議。

translations.literal: " The Emperor ordered the relevant offices to deliberate quickly.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor ordered swift deliberation.

sentences.zh: 泰昌元年，雲南撫按沈儆炌等言：蜀之東川，業奉朝命兼制，然事權全不相關。

translations.literal: In the first year of Taichang the Yunnan grand coordinator and surveillance commissioner Shen Jingcan and others said: Sichuan's Dongchuan already follows the court's order for joint control from Yunnan, yet in fact authority is wholly unrelated.
translations.idiomatic: In Taichang year 1 Shen Jingcan wrote: Dongchuan was nominally under Yunnan joint control, yet power did not connect.

sentences.zh: 祿千鐘、祿阿伽縱賊披猖，為患不已。

translations.literal: Lu Qianzhong and Lu Ajia let bandits run wild and the harm never ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Qianzhong and Lu Ajia let raiders run rampant without end.

sentences.zh: 是東川雖隸蜀，而相去甚遠，雖不隸滇，而禍實震鄰。

translations.literal: Thus though Dongchuan is under Shu it is very far away; though not under Yunnan the calamity truly shakes the neighbor.
translations.idiomatic: Dongchuan belonged to Sichuan but lay far away; though not in Yunnan, its troubles shook the border.

sentences.zh: 宜特敕蜀撫按，凡遇襲替，務合兩省會勘。

translations.literal: It is fitting specially to instruct the Shu grand coordinator and surveillance commissioner that whenever succession occurs the two provinces must investigate jointly.
translations.idiomatic: They asked that Sichuan and Yunnan jointly investigate every succession.

sentences.zh: 蜀察其世次，滇亦按無侵犯，方許起送，亦羈縻綏靜之要術也。

translations.literal: Shu should examine the generation, Yunnan should verify no encroachment—only then permit escort to court; this too is an essential technique of loose reins and quieting.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan would check lineage, Yunnan ensure no raids—then allow investiture; a key pacification method.

sentences.zh: 」詔下所司。

translations.literal: " An edict was sent to the relevant offices.
translations.idiomatic: " The court referred the matter downward.

sentences.zh: 時諸土司皆桀驁難制，烏撒、東川、烏蒙、鎮雄諸府地界，復相錯於川、滇、黔、楚之間，統轄既分，事權不一，往往軼出為諸邊害。

translations.literal: At that time all the native chiefs were arrogant and hard to control; the territories of Wusa, Dongchuan, Wumeng, and Zhenxiong again interlocked among Sichuan, Yunnan, Guizhou, and Huguang; jurisdiction was divided and authority inconsistent, and they often broke bounds to harm the borders.
translations.idiomatic: Native chiefs were unruly; Wusa, Dongchuan, Wumeng, and Zhenxiong straddled four provinces with divided authority, harming the frontiers.

sentences.zh: 故封疆大吏紛紛陳情，冀安邊隅，而中樞之臣動諉勘報，彌年經月，卒無成畫，以致疆事日壞。

translations.literal: Therefore frontier grand coordinators repeatedly memorialized, hoping to secure the borders, while central ministers always deferred to investigation reports; years and months passed without settled plans, and frontier affairs daily worsened.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier officials pleaded for peace while the capital delayed on reports; years passed without policy and borders worsened.

sentences.zh: 播州初平，永寧又叛，水西煽起，東川、烏蒙、鎮雄皆觀望騎墻，心懷疑二。

translations.literal: When Bozhou was first pacified, Yongning rebelled again, Shuixi rose, and Dongchuan, Wumeng, and Zhenxiong all watched from the fence, hearts divided.
translations.idiomatic: After Bozhou fell, Yongning rebelled and Shuixi rose; Dongchuan, Wumeng, and Zhenxiong wavered.

sentences.zh: 於是安效良以烏撒首附逆於邦彥，並力攻陸廣，復合沾益賊圍羅平，陷沾益，為雲南巡撫閔洪學所敗。

translations.literal: Thereupon An Xiaoliang of Wusa was first among them to join the rebel Bang Yan and together attacked Luguang, then united with Qiyi bandits to besiege Luoping, took Qiyi, and was defeated by Yunnan Grand Coordinator Min Hongxue.
translations.idiomatic: An Xiaoliang of Wusa joined Bang Yan, attacked Luguang, besieged Luoping with Qiyi rebels, and was beaten by Min Hongxue.

sentences.zh: 洪學以兵力不繼，好語招之，令擒賊自贖，效良亦佯為恭順。

translations.literal: Hongxue's troops were insufficient; he coaxed Xiaoliang with fair words to capture rebels and redeem himself, and Xiaoliang also feigned submission.
translations.idiomatic: Hongxue, short of troops, promised mercy if Xiaoliang captured rebels; Xiaoliang feigned obedience.

sentences.zh: 又見黔師出陸廣，滇師出沾益，水、烏之勢已成騎虎，遂合永寧、水西諸部三十六營，直抵沾益，對壘城下五日。

translations.literal: Seeing Guizhou troops exit Luguang and Yunnan troops exit Qiyi, the Shuixi-Wusa forces were already riding a tiger; he united Yongning, Shuixi, and thirty-six camps and marched straight to Qiyi, encamping under the walls for five days.
translations.idiomatic: With Guizhou and Yunnan armies deployed, Xiaoliang joined Yongning and Shuixi in thirty-six camps and besieged Qiyi five days.

sentences.zh: 副總兵袁善、宣撫使沙源等督將士力戰，出奇兵破之，效良敗死。

translations.literal: Deputy Commander-in-Chief Yuan Shan and Pacification Commissioner Sha Yuan and others led officers and soldiers in hard fighting; with a surprise force they broke the enemy and Xiaoliang was defeated and killed.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shan and Sha Yuan broke the siege by stratagem; Xiaoliang was killed.

sentences.zh: 妻安氏無子，妾設白生其爵、其祿。

translations.literal: His wife Lady An had no son; concubine She Bai bore Qi Jue and Qi Lu.
translations.idiomatic: Widow Lady An had no son; concubine She Bai bore Qi Jue and Qi Lu.

sentences.zh: 二婦素不相能，安氏居鹽倉，設白母子居抱渡。

translations.literal: The two women had long been incompatible; Lady An dwelt at Yancang and She Bai and her sons at Baodu.
translations.idiomatic: The women feuded; Lady An held Yancang, She Bai Baodu.

sentences.zh: 安氏遂代效良為土官，然亦未絕其爵，其爵亦以安氏為安位姐，不敢抗。

translations.literal: Lady An then replaced Xiaoliang as native chief, yet did not cut off Qi Jue; Qi Jue also treated Lady An as An Weijie and dared not resist.
translations.idiomatic: Lady An ruled as chief but tolerated Qi Jue, who deferred to her as elder.

sentences.zh: 二年，總督朱燮元調集漢土兵，列營沾益，趣滇撫會兵進烏撒境。

translations.literal: In the second year Governor-General Zhu Xieyuan mobilized Han and native troops, camped at Qiyi, and urged the Yunnan grand coordinator to join forces and enter Wusa territory.
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 Zhu Xieyuan camped at Qiyi and pressed Yunnan to advance into Wusa.

sentences.zh: 安邊、安氏逃避偏橋。

translations.literal: An Bian and Lady An fled to Pianqiao.
translations.idiomatic: An Bian and Lady An fled to Pianqiao.

sentences.zh: 大兵入鹽倉，拔難民一千余人。

translations.literal: The great army entered Yancang and rescued more than a thousand suffering people.
translations.idiomatic: Troops entered Yancang and freed over a thousand refugees.

sentences.zh: 師還，安邊、安氏復還鹽倉，遣人至軍前，請俟烏城克復，束身歸命，意實緩師。

translations.literal: When the army withdrew, An Bian and Lady An returned to Yancang and sent men to the camp asking to submit once Wusa city was recovered—intent in fact to delay the army.
translations.idiomatic: After the army left they returned, promising submission after Wusa fell—stalling.

sentences.zh: 乃復發兵逐安邊、安氏，以鹽倉授其爵。

translations.literal: Troops were sent again to drive out An Bian and Lady An and Yancang was granted to Qi Jue.
translations.idiomatic: Forces expelled Bian and Lady An and gave Yancang to Qi Jue.

sentences.zh: 兵至望城坡，遇賊哨騎百余，麾兵奮擊，賊盡奔箐中，遂復烏撒城。

translations.literal: At Wangcheng Slope they met more than a hundred rebel scouts; the army charged and the rebels all fled into ravines; Wusa city was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: At Wangcheng Slope they routed rebel scouts and retook Wusa.

sentences.zh: 安邊駐三十里外，擁兵求見，諭令束身歸誠。

translations.literal: An Bian camped thirty li away with troops seeking audience; he was told to submit in person.
translations.idiomatic: An Bian, encamped nearby, was ordered to surrender in person.

sentences.zh: 邊夜遁，遂棄鹽倉，入九龍囤。

translations.literal: Bian fled by night, abandoned Yancang, and entered Jiulong Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: He fled by night to Jiulong Stockade.

sentences.zh: 烏撒陷賊八年，至是始復。

translations.literal: Wusa had been in rebel hands eight years; only now was it recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Wusa had been lost eight years; now it was restored.

sentences.zh: 乃召其爵來鹽倉，令約束九頭目以守，且令圖獻安邊、安氏。

translations.literal: Qi Jue was summoned to Yancang and ordered to restrain the nine chiefs to hold the post and to plan capture of An Bian and Lady An.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Jue was told to hold Yancang with nine chiefs and capture Bian and Lady An.

sentences.zh: 其爵以鹽倉殘毀，乞移烏撒城，從之。

translations.literal: Qi Jue, because Yancang was ruined, begged to move to Wusa city; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Jue, finding Yancang destroyed, moved to Wusa city with permission.

sentences.zh: 時其爵署烏撒知府，其祿署沾益知州，雖懦稚頗忠順，其母亦頗有主持，能得眾。

translations.literal: At that time Qi Jue acted as Wusa prefect and Qi Lu as Qiyi prefect; though young and timid they were quite loyal, and their mother also governed well and could win the people.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Jue ruled Wusa and Qi Lu Qiyi; though young they were loyal, and their mother commanded respect.

sentences.zh: 安邊屢乞降於總督朱燮元，用藉水西安位代申，以邊實紹慶嫡孫，宜襲知州，請罪其爵、其祿。

translations.literal: An Bian repeatedly begged surrender from Zhu Xieyuan, using Shuixi An Wei to intercede, claiming that as Shaoqing's legitimate grandson he should inherit the prefecture and asking punishment for Qi Jue and Qi Lu.
translations.idiomatic: An Bian sought mercy through An Wei of Shuixi, claiming Shaoqing's grandson's right and demanding punishment of the Qi brothers.

sentences.zh: 燮元曲為調護，欲予以職銜，分烏撒安置之。

translations.literal: Xieyuan mediated and wished to grant them offices and divide Wusa to settle them.
translations.idiomatic: Xieyuan wished to partition Wusa and grant offices.

sentences.zh: 雲南撫按堅執不可，以安邊令其黨勒兵於野馬川，復以千金誘其爵頭目，日為並吞沾、烏計。

translations.literal: The Yunnan grand coordinator and surveillance commissioner firmly refused; An Bian ordered his followers to mass troops at Yema River and used a thousand gold to entice Qi Jue's chiefs, daily plotting to swallow Qiyi and Wusa.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan refused; Bian massed troops at Yema River and bribed Qi Jue's chiefs to seize both prefectures.

sentences.zh: 萬一其爵被襲，則烏撒失，而前功盡棄。

translations.literal: If Qi Jue were attacked, Wusa would be lost and all prior achievement discarded.
translations.idiomatic: If Qi Jue fell, Wusa would be lost and prior victories undone.

sentences.zh: 烏撒失，沾益危，而全滇動搖，非但震鄰，實乃切膚。

translations.literal: If Wusa were lost, Qiyi would be endangered and all Yunnan shaken—not merely alarming a neighbor but cutting to the quick.
translations.idiomatic: Losing Wusa endangered Qiyi and all Yunnan—not a distant worry but mortal peril.

sentences.zh: 竟不行。

translations.literal: In the end it was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The plan was rejected.

sentences.zh: 安邊乃乞師於安位，納之沾益，而逐其祿，時安氏在也。

translations.literal: An Bian then begged troops from An Wei, received them at Qiyi, and drove out Qi Lu while Lady An was still alive.
translations.idiomatic: Bian borrowed An Wei's troops, entered Qiyi, and expelled Qi Lu while Lady An lived.

sentences.zh: 既而安氏死。

translations.literal: Later Lady An died.
translations.idiomatic: Lady An then died.

sentences.zh: 安位與之貳，其祿乃假手羅彩令者布發難，邊遄死。

translations.literal: An Wei turned against him; Qi Lu then used the Luoxiong chief Zhe Bu to raise trouble and Bian died swiftly.
translations.idiomatic: An Wei turned on him; Qi Lu used Zhe Bu of Luoxiong to kill Bian quickly.

sentences.zh: 不移日，其祿率兵至，詭言為其叔報仇，士民歸者如流，於是其祿復有沾益。

translations.literal: Within days Qi Lu led troops there, falsely claiming to avenge his uncle; subjects returned in streams, and thus Qi Lu regained Qiyi.
translations.idiomatic: Days later Qi Lu marched, claiming vengeance for his uncle; people flocked back and he held Qiyi again.

sentences.zh: 而廟堂之上方急流寇，不復能問雲。

translations.literal: Yet at court they were urgently occupied with roving bandits and could no longer attend to Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: The court, busy with internal rebels, could no longer manage Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 馬湖，漢牂牁郡內地也，有龍馬湖，因名焉。

translations.literal: Mapu was inner territory of the Han Zangke Commandery and had a Dragon Horse Lake, from which it took its name.
translations.idiomatic: Mapu lay within Han Zangke Commandery and was named for Dragon Horse Lake.

sentences.zh: 唐為羈縻州四，總名馬湖部。

translations.literal: In Tang it was four jimi prefectures collectively called the Mapu Department.
translations.idiomatic: Under Tang it was four jimi prefectures called the Mapu Department.

sentences.zh: 洪武四年冬，馬湖路總管安濟，遣其子仁來歸附，詔改馬湖路為馬湖府。

translations.literal: In the fourth winter month of Hongwu year 4, Mapu Circuit general manager An Ji sent his son Ren to submit; an edict changed Mapu Circuit to Mapu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu winter, year 4, An Ji of Mapu sent son Ren to submit; Mapu Circuit became Mapu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 領長官司四：「曰泥溪，曰平夷，曰蠻夷，曰沐川。

translations.literal: It governed four long-chief offices: Nixi, Pingyi, Manyi, and Muchuan.
translations.idiomatic: It governed four long-chief offices: Nixi, Pingyi, Manyi, and Muchuan.

sentences.zh: 以安濟為知府，世襲。

translations.literal: An Ji was made prefect with hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: An Ji was appointed hereditary prefect.

sentences.zh: 六年，安濟以病告，乞以子安仁代職，詔從之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year An Ji reported illness and begged that his son An Ren replace him; the edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 Ji, ill, asked that son An Ren succeed; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 自是，三年一入貢。

translations.literal: Thereafter tribute was presented to court once every three years.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter they paid court every three years.

sentences.zh: 七年，馬湖知府瑉德遣其弟阿穆上表貢馬，廷臣言：「洪武四年，大兵下蜀，瑉德叔安濟遣子入朝，朝廷授以世襲知府，恩至渥矣。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Mapu Prefect Mingde sent his younger brother Amu to memorialize and present horses; court officials said: "In Hongwu year 4 when the great army descended on Shu, Mingde's uncle An Ji sent his son to court and the court granted hereditary prefect—the grace was very deep.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 Prefect Mingde sent brother Amu with horses; officials noted Ji's early submission and deep imperial grace.

sentences.zh: 今瑉德既襲其職，不自來朝而遣其弟，非奉上之道。

translations.literal: Now Mingde has inherited office yet did not come himself but sent his brother—this is not the way to serve the court.
translations.idiomatic: "Mingde should have come himself, not sent his brother—improper service.

sentences.zh: 」帝卻其所貢馬。

translations.literal: " The Emperor rejected the presented horses.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor refused the horses.

sentences.zh: 十二年，瑉德貢香楠木，詔賜衣鈔。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Mingde presented fragrant nanmu; an edict granted robes and paper money.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 Mingde sent nanmu and received robes and paper money.

sentences.zh: 十六年，瑉德來朝，獻馬十八匹，賜衣一襲、米二十石、鈔三十錠。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year Mingde came to court, presented eighteen horses, and was granted one suit of clothing, twenty shi of grain, and thirty ingots of paper money.
translations.idiomatic: In year 16 Mingde came to court with eighteen horses and received clothing, grain, and paper money.

sentences.zh: 永樂十二年，泥溪、平夷、蠻夷、沐川四長官司遣人貢方物，賜鈔幣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Yongle the four long-chief offices of Nixi, Pingyi, Manyi, and Muchuan sent men to present local products and received paper money.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle year 12 the four long-chief offices sent tribute and received paper money.

sentences.zh: 宣德八年，平夷長官司奏，比者火延公廨，凡朝廷頒降榜文、倉庫稅糧錢帛及案牘皆救免，乞宥罪，並獻馬二匹。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Xuande the Pingyi long-chief office memorialized that recently fire had spread through the public offices and all court proclamations, warehouse tax grain, money and silk, and documents were lost; they begged pardon for guilt and also presented two horses.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande year 8 Pingyi reported fire destroyed offices and records; they begged pardon and sent two horses.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「遠蠻能恭謹畏法如此。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Distant tribes can be so deferential and law-abiding.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "Even distant tribes can show such respect for the law.

sentences.zh: 」置不問。

translations.literal: " The matter was set aside without further inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: " The court took no further action.

sentences.zh: 正統二年，泥溪土官醫學正科田璣盜官藏絲鈔，援永、宣時例，邊夷有犯，聽以馬贖，許之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhengtong, Tian Ji, registrar of medical studies among the Nixi native officials, stole official stores of silk and paper money; citing the Yongxuan-period precedent that border tribes guilty of offenses might redeem themselves with horses, the court permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong year 2: Nixi registrar Tian Ji stole official silk and banknotes; under the Yongxuan rule allowing border offenders to pay horses in lieu of punishment, the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 三年，免馬湖府舉人王有學棄吏。

translations.literal: In the third year, the dismissal of Wang Youxue, presented scholar of Mapu Prefecture, from clerical service was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Year 3: Mapu presented scholar Wang Youxue was restored from the clerical penalty.

sentences.zh: 先是，有學會試，過期不至，例充吏。

translations.literal: Earlier, Youxue had passed the provincial examination but failed to arrive for the metropolitan examination by the deadline and, by regulation, was made a clerical assistant.
translations.idiomatic: He had passed the provincial exam but missed the metropolitan deadline and was reduced to clerk by rule.

sentences.zh: 有學原籍長官司，因遣通事貢馬，乞宥罪，仍肄習太學，許之。

translations.literal: Youxue was originally from a long-chief office; he therefore sent an interpreter to present horses, begged pardon for his offense, and asked to resume study at the Imperial Academy—this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: A native of a long-chief domain, he sent tribute horses through an interpreter, sought pardon, and was allowed to return to the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 弘治八年，土知府安鰲有罪，伏誅。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Hongzhi, the native prefect An Ao was guilty of crime and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi year 8: native prefect An Ao was found guilty and put to death.

sentences.zh: 鰲性殘忍虐民，計口賦錢，歲入銀萬計。

translations.literal: Ao was cruel by nature and oppressed the people, levying money by head count until his annual intake reached ten thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Ao was brutal and taxed the people per capita, taking in more than ten thousand taels of silver a year.

sentences.zh: 土民有婦女，多淫之。

translations.literal: Among the native people he frequently violated women.
translations.idiomatic: He routinely raped native women.

sentences.zh: 用妖僧百足魘魅殺人。

translations.literal: He employed a sorcerer-monk who used centipede venom and spirit-curses to kill people.
translations.idiomatic: He used a sorcerer-monk who killed with centipede poison and black magic.

sentences.zh: 又令人殺平夷長官王大慶，大慶聞而逃，乃殺其弟。

translations.literal: He also had men kill Wang Daqing, long chief of Pingyi; Daqing heard of it and fled, so they killed his younger brother instead.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the murder of Pingyi long chief Wang Daqing; Daqing fled, so they killed his brother.

sentences.zh: 為橫二十年。

translations.literal: He had tyrannized the region for twenty years.
translations.idiomatic: He had ruled by terror for twenty years.

sentences.zh: 巡按御史張鸞請治之，得實，伏誅，遂改馬湖府為流官知府。

translations.literal: Touring censor Zhang Luan requested prosecution; the facts were established, Ao was executed, and Mapu Prefecture was then converted to a regular prefecture with an appointed official.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Zhang Luan investigated; Ao was executed and Mapu became a regular prefecture under a appointed magistrate.

sentences.zh: 建昌衛

translations.literal: Jianchang Guard
translations.idiomatic: Jianchang Guard

translations.literal: 〈 (opening editorial parenthesis)
translations.idiomatic: (begin parenthetical note)

sentences.zh: （寧番衛越巂衛鹽井衛會川衛）〉

translations.literal: (Ningfan Guard, Yuexi Guard, Yanjing Guard, Huichuan Guard)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Ningfan Guard, Yuexi Guard, Yanjing Guard, Huichuan Guard)〉

sentences.zh: 建昌衛，本邛都地。

translations.literal: Jianchang Guard occupied the ancient land of Qiongdu.
translations.idiomatic: Jianchang Guard lay in the old territory of Qiongdu.

sentences.zh: 漢武帝置越巂郡。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu of Han established Yuexi Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Han Emperor Wu founded Yuexi Commandery there.

sentences.zh: 隋、唐皆為巂州。

translations.literal: Under the Sui and Tang it was both called Xizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Sui and Tang both administered it as Xizhou.

sentences.zh: 至德初，沒於吐番。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Zhide era it was lost to Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Zhide era it fell to Tibet.

sentences.zh: 貞元中收復。

translations.literal: It was recovered in the Zhenyuan era.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang recovered it in the Zhenyuan period.

sentences.zh: 懿宗時，為蒙詔所據，改建昌府，以烏、白二蠻實之。

translations.literal: In the time of Emperor Yizong it was seized by the Meng regime, which refounded Jianchang Prefecture and settled it with the Black and White Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Yizong the Meng state took it, made Jianchang Prefecture, and settled it with the Black and White Yi.

sentences.zh: 元至元間，置建昌路，又立羅羅斯宣慰司以統之。

translations.literal: Between the Yuan and Yuanzhong reigns Jianchang Circuit was established, and the Luoluo Pacification Commission was also set up to govern it.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan times saw Jianchang Circuit and a Luoluo Pacification Commission to rule the region.

sentences.zh: 洪武五年，羅羅斯宣慰安定來朝，而建昌尚未歸附，十四年遣內臣賫敕諭之，乃降。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Hongwu the Luoluo Pacification Commissioner Anding came to court, but Jianchang had not yet submitted; in the fourteenth year an inner eunuch was sent bearing an imperial edict to instruct them, and they then surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu year 5: Luoluo commissioner Anding came to court while Jianchang still held out; year 14 an imperial envoy was sent and they submitted.

sentences.zh: 十五年置建昌衛指揮使司。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year the Jianchang Guard command was established.
translations.idiomatic: Year 15: the Jianchang Guard command was founded.

sentences.zh: 元平章月魯帖木兒等自雲南建昌來貢馬一百八十匹，並上元所授符印。

translations.literal: Yuan chief minister Yuelu Tiemuer and others came from Jianchang in Yunnan to present one hundred eighty horses and surrendered the seals and tallies granted by the Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan minister Yuelu Tiemuer came from Yunnan Jianchang with 180 horses and surrendered Yuan seals.

sentences.zh: 詔賜月魯帖木兒綺衣、金帶、靴襪，家人綿布一百六十疋、鈔二千四百四十錠。

translations.literal: An edict granted Yuelu Tiemuer brocade robes, a gold belt, and boots and stockings, and to his household one hundred sixty bolts of cotton cloth and two thousand four hundred forty ingots of paper money.
translations.idiomatic: He received brocade, a gold belt, boots, 160 bolts of cotton for his household, and 2,440 ingots of paper money.

sentences.zh: 以月魯帖木兒為建昌衛指揮使，月給三品俸贍其家。

translations.literal: Yuelu Tiemuer was appointed commander of Jianchang Guard, with third-rank monthly salary to support his household.
translations.idiomatic: Yuelu Tiemuer became Jianchang commander on third-rank pay.

sentences.zh: 十六年，建昌土官安配及土酋阿派先後來朝，貢馬及方物，皆賜織金文綺、衣帽、靴襪。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year the Jianchang native official An Pei and the tribal chief Apai came to court in succession, presenting horses and local products; all were granted brocaded silks, caps and robes, and boots and stockings.
translations.idiomatic: Year 16: native official An Pei and chief Apai presented horses and goods and received brocade, robes, and boots.

sentences.zh: 十八年，月魯帖木兒舉家來朝，請遣子入學，厚賜遣之。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Yuelu Tiemuer came to court with his whole family, asked that his son be sent to study, and was richly rewarded and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: Year 18: Yuelu Tiemuer brought his family, asked to enroll his son at court, and was richly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，建昌府故土官安思正妻師克等來朝，貢馬九十九匹。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year Shi Ke, widow of the former Jianchang native prefect An Sizheng, came to court and presented ninety-nine horses.
translations.idiomatic: Year 21: Shi Ke, widow of former prefect An Sizheng, came with 99 horses.

sentences.zh: 詔授師克知府，賜冠帶、襲衣、文綺、鈔錠，因命師克討東川、芒部及赤水河叛蠻。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Shi Ke prefect, granted her cap and belt, court robes, brocades, and paper-money ingots, and ordered her to campaign against the rebel tribes of Dongchuan, Mangbu, and the Chishui River.
translations.idiomatic: She was made prefect with robes and gifts and ordered to suppress rebels in Dongchuan, Mangbu, and along the Chishui.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，安配遣子僧保等四十二人入監讀書。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year An Pei sent his son Sengbao and forty-one others to study in the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: Year 23: An Pei sent son Sengbao and 41 others to the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，致仕指揮安配貢馬，詔賜配及其把事五十三人幣紗有差。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year the retired commander An Pei presented horses; an edict granted Pei and his fifty-three stewards graded gifts of cloth and silk.
translations.idiomatic: Year 25: retired commander An Pei presented horses; he and 53 stewards received graded gifts.

sentences.zh: 已而月魯帖木兒反，合德昌、會川、迷易、柏興、邛部並西番土軍萬余人，殺官軍男婦二百余口，掠屯牛，燒營屋，劫軍糧，率眾攻城。

translations.literal: Soon after, Yuelu Tiemuer rebelled, joining Dechang, Huichuan, Miyi, Boxing, Qiongbu, and western tribal armies numbering more than ten thousand; they killed over two hundred male and female government troops, seized garrison oxen, burned barracks, plundered army grain, and led their masses to assault the city.
translations.idiomatic: Then Yuelu Tiemuer rebelled with Dechang, Huichuan, Miyi, Boxing, Qiongbu, and western tribes—10,000+ men—killing 200+ troops, looting oxen and grain, burning camps, and besieging the city.

sentences.zh: 指揮使安的以所部兵出戰，敗之，斬八十余級，擒其黨十余人。

translations.literal: Commander An De led his troops out to fight, defeated them, beheaded more than eighty, and captured more than ten of their followers.
translations.idiomatic: Commander An De sallied forth, killed 80+, and captured a dozen rebels.

sentences.zh: 賊退屯阿宜河，轉攻蘇州。

translations.literal: The rebels withdrew to camp on the Ayi River and turned to attack Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fell back to the Ayi River and attacked Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 指揮僉事魯毅率精騎出西門擊之，賊眾大集，毅且戰且卻，復入城拒守。

translations.literal: Assistant commander Lu Yi led picked cavalry out the west gate to strike them; the rebel host massed, and Yi fought while retreating, then re-entered the city to hold it.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Yi led elite cavalry from the west gate; outnumbered, he fought his way back inside and held the walls.

sentences.zh: 賊圍城，毅乘間遣壯士王旱突入賊營，斫賊，賊驚遁。

translations.literal: The rebels besieged the city; Yi seized an opening and sent the stalwart Wang Han to break into the rebel camp and slash at them, and the rebels fled in alarm.
translations.idiomatic: Besieged, Yi sent Wang Han into the rebel camp by night; the rebels panicked and fled.

sentences.zh: 於是置建昌、蘇州二軍民指揮使司及會川軍民千戶所，調京衛及陜西兵萬五千余人往戍之。

translations.literal: Thereupon military-civilian command offices were established for Jianchang and Suzhou and a Huichuan military-civilian company, and more than fifteen thousand troops from the capital guards and Shaanxi were sent to garrison them.
translations.idiomatic: Jianchang and Suzhou military-civilian commands and a Huichuan company were set up; 15,000+ capital and Shaanxi troops were posted.

sentences.zh: 仍諭將士互相應援，設伏出奇，並諭擒賊首獻者賞千金。

translations.literal: The troops were also instructed to support one another, set ambushes and strike by surprise, and told that whoever captured and presented the rebel leader would receive a reward of a thousand gold.
translations.idiomatic: Troops were ordered to coordinate, ambush, and seize the rebel chief for a thousand-gold reward.

sentences.zh: 復諭總兵官涼國公藍玉，以月魯帖木兒詭詐，不可信其降，致緩師養禍。

translations.literal: They were again instructed through the commander-in-chief, Duke Lan Yu of Liang, that Yuelu Tiemuer was treacherous and his surrender could not be trusted, lest delay breed disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Lan Yu of Liang was warned that Yuelu Tiemuer was treacherous and a false surrender must not slow the campaign.

sentences.zh: 四川都指揮使瞿能率各衛兵至雙狼寨，擒偽千戶段太平等，賊眾大潰，月魯帖木兒敗遁。

translations.literal: Sichuan regional commander Qu Neng led troops from the various guards to Shuanglang Stockade, captured the false company commander Duan Taiping and others, and the rebel host collapsed in great rout as Yuelu Tiemuer was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Qu Neng took Shuanglang Stockade, captured false commander Duan Taiping, routed the rebels, and drove off Yuelu Tiemuer.

sentences.zh: 能督兵追捕，攻托落寨，拔之。

translations.literal: Neng supervised pursuit, attacked Tuoluo Stockade, and took it.
translations.idiomatic: Neng pursued, stormed Tuoluo Stockade, and took it.

sentences.zh: 轉戰而前，進至打沖河三里所，與月魯帖木兒遇，大戰，又敗之。

translations.literal: Fighting forward, he advanced to a place three li from Dachong River, met Yuelu Tiemuer, fought a great battle, and defeated him again.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing on to within three li of Dachong River he met Yuelu Tiemuer, fought, and beat him again.

sentences.zh: 俘其眾五百余人，溺死者千余，獲牛馬無算。

translations.literal: More than five hundred of their followers were captured, more than a thousand drowned, and cattle and horses were taken beyond count.
translations.idiomatic: 500+ were captured, 1,000+ drowned, and countless livestock were seized.

sentences.zh: 官軍入德昌，能遂調指揮同知徐凱分兵入普濟州搜捕。

translations.literal: When the government army entered Dechang, Neng then ordered Assistant Commander Xu Kai to divide forces and enter Puji Prefecture to search and capture.
translations.idiomatic: At Dechang, Neng sent Xu Kai into Puji Prefecture to hunt survivors.

sentences.zh: 復駕橋於打沖河，遣指揮李華引兵追托落寨余孽，進至水西，斬月魯帖木兒把事七人，其截路寨土蠻長沙、納的皆中矢死。

translations.literal: He again bridged the Dachong River and sent Commander Li Hua to pursue the remnants of Tuoluo Stockade; advancing to Shuixi, he beheaded seven of Yuelu Tiemuer's stewards, and the tribal chiefs of the road-blocking stockades, Changsha and Nade, both died of arrow wounds.
translations.idiomatic: He bridged the Dachong, sent Li Hua after Tuoluo remnants to Shuixi, killed seven of Yuelu Tiemuer's stewards, and arrowed chiefs Changsha and Nade of the road-blocking stockades.

sentences.zh: 能還攻天星、臥漂諸寨，皆克之，先後俘殺千八百余人。

translations.literal: Neng returned to attack the stockades of Tianxing and Wopiao and took them all; in all more than eighteen hundred were captured or killed.
translations.idiomatic: Neng stormed Tianxing and Wopiao stockades, capturing or killing 1,800+.

sentences.zh: 月魯帖木兒遁入柏興州。

translations.literal: Yuelu Tiemuer fled into Boxing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yuelu Tiemuer fled to Boxing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 帝遣諭藍玉曰：「月魯帖木兒信其逆黨達達、楊把事等，或遣之先降，或親來覘我，不可不密為防。

translations.literal: The Emperor sent instructions to Lan Yu: "Yuelu Tiemuer trusts his rebel followers Dada, Yang Bashishi, and the rest; they may be sent to feign surrender first, or he may come himself to spy on us—you must guard against this in secret.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor told Lan Yu: "Yuelu Tiemuer may send Dada, Yang Bashishi, or others to feign surrender or spy—guard against this closely.

sentences.zh: 其柏興州賈哈喇境內麼些等部，更須留意。

translations.literal: Within the territory of Jiahaluo in Boxing Prefecture, the Mosuo and other departments require still greater vigilance.
translations.idiomatic: Watch especially the Mosuo and other groups in Jiahaluo territory within Boxing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 」賈哈喇者，麼些洞土酋也。

translations.literal: " Jiahaluo was a Mosuo-cave tribal chief.
translations.idiomatic: " Jiahaluo was a Mosuo cave chief.

sentences.zh: 初，王師克建昌，授以指揮之職，自是從月魯帖木兒叛。

translations.literal: When the imperial army first took Jianchang he had been granted a commandership; from that time he followed Yuelu Tiemuer in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: He had received a command when Jianchang fell, then joined Yuelu Tiemuer's revolt.

sentences.zh: 玉率兵至柏興州，遣百戶毛海以計誘致月魯帖木兒並其子胖伯，遂降其眾，送月魯帖木兒京師，伏誅。

translations.literal: Yu led troops to Boxing Prefecture and sent company officer Mao Hai to lure Yuelu Tiemuer and his son Pangbo by stratagem; their followers then surrendered, and Yuelu Tiemuer was sent to the capital and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Lan Yu reached Boxing, lured Yuelu Tiemuer and son Pangbo through Mao Hai, accepted their surrender, and sent Yuelu Tiemuer to the capital for execution.

sentences.zh: 玉因奏：「四川地曠山險，控扼西番。

translations.literal: Yu then memorialized: "Sichuan's land is broad and its mountains perilous, controlling access to the western tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Lan Yu reported: "Sichuan is vast and mountainous, commanding the western tribes.

sentences.zh: 松、茂、碉、黎當吐番出入之地，馬湖、建昌、嘉定俱為要道，皆宜增屯衛。

translations.literal: Songpan, Maozhou, Diao, and Li are places where Tibetans come and go; Mapu, Jianchang, and Jiading are all vital routes and should all have added garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: Songpan, Maozhou, Diao, and Li lie on Tibetan routes; Mapu, Jianchang, and Jiading are key passes—all need more garrisons.

sentences.zh: 」報可，命玉班師。

translations.literal: " The memorial was approved and Yu was ordered to withdraw the army.
translations.idiomatic: " The court agreed and ordered Lan Yu to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，麼些洞蠻寇打沖河西守堡，都督徐凱擊敗之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year Mosuo-cave tribes raided the guard post west of Dachong River; Regional Commander Xu Kai defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Year 27: Mosuo raided west of the Dachong; Xu Kai defeated them.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，威龍土知州普習叛。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year the native prefect of Weilong, Pu Xi, rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Year 29: Weilong native prefect Pu Xi rebelled.

sentences.zh: 普習，月魯帖木兒妻兄也。

translations.literal: Pu Xi was the elder brother of Yuelu Tiemuer's wife.
translations.idiomatic: Pu Xi was Yuelu Tiemuer's brother-in-law.

sentences.zh: 官軍捕之，普習中流矢死。

translations.literal: Government troops hunted him down; Pu Xi died of an arrow wound.
translations.idiomatic: Government troops pursued him; Pu Xi died of an arrow wound.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，徐凱等平卜木瓦寨，執賈哈喇，送京師，誅之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year Xu Kai and others pacified Bumuwazhai Stockade, seized Jiahaluo, sent him to the capital, and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: Year 31: Xu Kai pacified Bumuwazhai, seized Jiahaluo, and had him executed at court.

sentences.zh: 寨地峻險，三百陡絕，下臨大江，江流悍急，不可行舟，惟一道僅可通人行。

translations.literal: The stockade terrain was precipitous: three hundred sheer cliffs dropped to the great river below, whose current was fierce and swift so boats could not pass—only one path barely allowed a man to walk.
translations.idiomatic: The stockade stood on 300 sheer cliffs above a raging river impassable to boats, with only a single footpath.

sentences.zh: 官軍至，輒自上投石，不得進。

translations.literal: When government troops arrived, the defenders hurled stones from above and the army could not advance.
translations.idiomatic: Defenders rolled stones from above and blocked the army.

sentences.zh: 凱乃斷其汲道困之，寇窮促，凱督將士抵其寨，力攻破之，遂就擒。

translations.literal: Kai then cut off their water supply to wear them down; when the bandits were desperate, Kai led officers and men to their stockade, stormed it by force, broke through, and captured them.
translations.idiomatic: Kai cut their water; when they were desperate he stormed the stockade and took Jiahaluo.

sentences.zh: 因改建昌路為建昌衛，置軍民指揮使司。

translations.literal: Jianchang Circuit was therefore converted to Jianchang Guard and a military-civilian command was established.
translations.idiomatic: Jianchang Circuit became Jianchang Guard with a military-civilian command.

sentences.zh: 安氏世襲指揮使，不給印，置其居於城東郭外里許。

translations.literal: The An clan held the commandership by hereditary succession without receiving a seal; their residence was placed a little over a li outside the eastern suburb of the city.
translations.idiomatic: The An line inherited the command without a seal and lived just east of the city.

sentences.zh: 所屬有四十八馬站，大頭土番、僰人子、白夷、麼些、作佫鹿、倮羅、韃靼、回紇諸種散居山谷間。

translations.literal: Subjects included forty-eight horse stations and the Datou Tufan, Bo renzi, Baiyi, Mosuo, Zuoluluo, Luoluo, Tartars, and Uyghurs, all scattered among the valleys.
translations.idiomatic: Forty-eight courier stations and Datou Tibetans, Bo renzi, Baiyi, Mosuo, Zuoluluo, Luoluo, Tartars, and Uyghurs lived scattered in the valleys.

sentences.zh: 北至大渡，南及金沙江，東抵烏蒙，西訖鹽井，延袤千餘里。

translations.literal: North to the Dadu River, south to the Jinsha, east to Wumeng, west to the salt wells—more than a thousand li in extent.
translations.idiomatic: Its bounds ran from the Dadu north to the Jinsha south, Wumeng east to the salt wells west—over a thousand li.

sentences.zh: 以昌州、普濟、威龍三州長官隸之，有把事四人，世轄其眾，皆節制於四川行都指揮使司。

translations.literal: The three long-chief offices of Changzhou, Puji, and Weilong were placed under it; there were four stewards who ruled their peoples by hereditary succession, all under the Sichuan Regional Military Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Changzhou, Puji, and Weilong long-chief offices and four hereditary stewards answered to the Sichuan Regional Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 西南土官，安氏殆為稱首。

translations.literal: Among southwestern native officials the An clan was nearly foremost.
translations.idiomatic: Among southwestern chiefs the An were nearly foremost.

sentences.zh: 配六世孫安忠無後，妻鳳氏管指揮使事。

translations.literal: An Zhong, sixth-generation descendant of Pei, had no heir; his wife Lady Feng administered command affairs.
translations.idiomatic: An Zhong, Pei's sixth-generation descendant, died childless; his wife Lady Feng ran the command.

sentences.zh: 鳳氏死，族人安登繼襲，復無子，妻瞿氏管事，以族人世隆嗣。

translations.literal: When Lady Feng died, clansman An Deng succeeded; he too had no son, and his wife Lady Qu managed affairs, adopting clansman Shilong as heir.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Feng's death brought An Deng, also childless; Lady Qu ruled and adopted Shilong.

sentences.zh: 世隆復無子，繼妻祿氏管事。

translations.literal: Shilong again had no son; his successor wife Lady Lu managed affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Shilong too died without heirs; Lady Lu governed.

sentences.zh: 祿死，以族侄安崇業嗣。

translations.literal: When Lu died, clansman An Chongye succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: After Lu's death clansman An Chongye succeeded.

sentences.zh: 崇業與祿氏不相能，因養那固為假子，其奴祿祈從臾構難，歲仇殺。

translations.literal: Chongye and Lady Lu were incompatible; he therefore adopted Nagu as a foster son, and his slave Lu Qi incited trouble until they feuded and killed one another year after year.
translations.idiomatic: Chongye clashed with Lady Lu, adopted Nagu, and was stirred by slave Lu Qi to yearly blood feuds.

sentences.zh: 鎮巡官讞之，殺那固而戍祿祈，事遂平。

translations.literal: Pacification officials judged the case, executed Nagu and exiled Lu Qi, and the affair was settled.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification officials killed Nagu, exiled Lu Qi, and ended the feud.

sentences.zh: 安氏所轄四驛，曰祿馬、阿用、白水、瀘沽，各百里有差。

translations.literal: The four courier stations under the An clan were named Luma, Ayong, Baishui, and Lugu, each about a hundred li apart.
translations.idiomatic: An holdings included courier stations Luma, Ayong, Baishui, and Lugu, roughly a hundred li apart.

sentences.zh: 其涼山拖郎、桐槽、熱水諸番，則以強弱為向背。

translations.literal: The Liangshan Tuolang, Tongcao, and Reshui tribes shifted allegiance according to strength.
translations.idiomatic: Liangshan tribes Tuolang, Tongcao, and Reshui sided with whichever power was stronger.

sentences.zh: 所領昌州等三長官司，皆在衛東、西、南三百里內。

translations.literal: The three long-chief offices under its rule—Changzhou and the others—were all within three hundred li east, west, and south of the guard.
translations.idiomatic: Changzhou and the other long-chief offices lay within three hundred li of the guard on three sides.

sentences.zh: 洪武十八年，土官盧尼姑、吉撒加、白氐等歸附，皆令世襲為知州。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Hongwu the native officials Lu Nigu, Jisajia, Bai Shi, and others submitted, and all were ordered to hold the prefecture by hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu year 18: chiefs Lu Nigu, Jisajia, Bai Shi, and others submitted and received hereditary prefectures.

sentences.zh: 月魯帖木兒之亂，諸州皆廢革。

translations.literal: During Yuelu Tiemuer's rebellion all these prefectures were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Yuelu Tiemuer's revolt led to their abolition.

sentences.zh: 永樂元年復置，悉改為長官司，仍隸建昌。

translations.literal: They were restored in the first year of Yongle, all changed to long-chief offices and again placed under Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle year 1 restored them as long-chief offices under Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 其千戶所之隸於衛者有三：曰禮州，曰打沖河，曰德昌。

translations.literal: Three companies under the guard were: Lizhou, Dachong River, and Dechang.
translations.idiomatic: Three subordinate companies were Lizhou, Dachong River, and Dechang.

sentences.zh: 禮州，漢蘇示縣；

translations.literal: Lizhou was the Han Sushi County;
translations.idiomatic: Lizhou was Han Sushi County;

sentences.zh: 打沖河，唐沙野城；

translations.literal: Dachong River was the Tang Shayecheng;
translations.idiomatic: Dachong River was Tang Shayecheng;

sentences.zh: 德昌，元定昌路也。

translations.literal: Dechang was the Yuan Dingchang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Dechang was Yuan Dingchang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 寧番衛，元時立於邛都之野，曰蘇州。

translations.literal: Ningfan Guard was established in Yuan times in the wilds of Qiongdu and called Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Ningfan Guard was founded in Yuan times in Qiongdu and called Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 洪武間，土官怕兀它從月魯帖木兒為亂，廢州置衛。

translations.literal: In the Hongwu period the native official Pawuta followed Yuelu Tiemuer in rebellion; the prefecture was abolished and a guard established.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu: native official Pawuta joined Yuelu Tiemuer; the prefecture became a guard.

sentences.zh: 環而居者，皆西番種，故曰寧番。

translations.literal: Those living around it were all western tribes, hence the name Ningfan—"pacifying the tribes."
translations.idiomatic: Surrounding peoples were western tribes, hence "Ningfan"—pacifying the tribes.

sentences.zh: 有冕山、鎮西、禮州中三千戶所。

translations.literal: It had the Mianshan, Zhenxi, and Lizhou Central companies.
translations.idiomatic: It had Mianshan, Zhenxi, and Lizhou Central companies.

sentences.zh: 越巂衛，漢邛都及闌二縣地。

translations.literal: Yuexi Guard occupied the Han territories of Qiongdu and Lan counties.
translations.idiomatic: Yuexi Guard lay in Han Qiongdu and Lan counties.

sentences.zh: 有奴諾城，即蜀漢時諸葛亮征蠻所築以憩軍者也。

translations.literal: There was Nunuo city, which in the Shu Han period Zhuge Liang built when campaigning against the tribes to rest his army.
translations.idiomatic: Nunuo city was where Shu Han's Zhuge Liang camped during his southern campaigns.

sentences.zh: 元置邛部安撫招討司，已，改邛部州。

translations.literal: The Yuan established the Qiongbu Pacification and Punitive Office, which was later changed to Qiongbu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan times saw a Qiongbu pacification office, later Qiongbu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 洪武中，嶺真伯以招討使來歸，因改為邛部軍民州。

translations.literal: In the Hongwu period Ling Zhenbo came in submission as pacification commissioner and it was changed to the Qiongbu Military-Civilian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu: pacification commissioner Ling Zhenbo submitted and it became Qiongbu Military-Civilian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 洪武二十五年置越巂軍民指揮使司於邛部州，命指揮僉事李質領謫戍軍士守之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year of Hongwu the Yuexi Military-Civilian Command was established at Qiongbu Prefecture, and Assistant Commander Li Zhi was ordered to lead banished garrison troops to hold it.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu year 25: Yuexi Military-Civilian Command was set at Qiongbu; Li Zhi led banished garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 二十六年置越巂衛。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year Yuexi Guard was established.
translations.idiomatic: Year 26: Yuexi Guard was founded.

sentences.zh: 永樂元年改邛部為長官司，隸越巂衛。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongle Qiongbu was changed to a long-chief office under Yuexi Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle year 1: Qiongbu became a long-chief office under Yuexi Guard.

sentences.zh: 萬歷中，土官嶺柏死，孽子應升負印去，柏妾沙氏爭之不得。

translations.literal: In the Wanli period the native official Ling Bai died; his illegitimate son Yingsheng seized the seal and fled, and Bai's concubine Lady Sha could not recover it.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli: native chief Ling Bai died; illegitimate son Yingsheng fled with the seal while concubine Lady Sha could not reclaim it.

sentences.zh: 土目阿堆等擁沙氏，焚利濟站廬舍，擁兵臨城。

translations.literal: Tribal officer Adui and others supported Lady Sha, burned the buildings of Liji Station, and massed troops before the city.
translations.idiomatic: Officer Adui backed Lady Sha, burned Liji Station, and marched on the city.

sentences.zh: 總兵劉顯率兵往撫之，沙氏悔禍，殺阿堆等自贖，顯遂以印授之。

translations.literal: Regional Commander Liu Xian led troops to pacify them; Lady Sha repented the disaster, killed Adui and others to atone, and Xian then restored the seal to her.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xian marched to pacify them; Lady Sha killed Adui to atone and received the seal back.

sentences.zh: 後沙氏淫於族人阿祭，印復為升所奪。

translations.literal: Later Lady Sha had relations with her clansman Aji, and the seal was again seized by Yingsheng.
translations.idiomatic: Later she took clansman Aji as lover and Yingsheng seized the seal again.

sentences.zh: 祭死。

translations.literal: Aji died.
translations.idiomatic: Aji died.

sentences.zh: 其子嶺鳳起嗾他番刺殺應升。

translations.literal: His son Ling Fengqi incited other tribes to assassinate Yingsheng.
translations.idiomatic: His son Ling Fengqi hired other tribes to kill Yingsheng.

sentences.zh: 鎮守官因平蠻之師，誘鳳起縶之，收其印，而誅從鳳起為亂者百余人。

translations.literal: The garrison commander, using troops from the campaign to pacify the tribes, lured Fengqi into bonds, recovered the seal, and executed more than a hundred who had followed Fengqi in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison commander, on a pacification campaign, seized Fengqi, recovered the seal, and executed 100+ followers.

sentences.zh: 印無所歸，緘於庫。

translations.literal: With no one to receive the seal, it was locked in the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: With no rightful holder, the seal was sealed in the treasury.

sentences.zh: 部眾無統，肆行為盜。

translations.literal: The tribes had no leader and plundered at will.
translations.idiomatic: Leaderless, the tribes turned to banditry.

sentences.zh: 普雄部眾姑咱等乘勢蜂起，郵傳不通，遠近震恐。

translations.literal: The Puxiong tribesmen Guzha and others rose in swarms; courier routes were cut and far and near were shaken with fear.
translations.idiomatic: Puxiong tribesmen Guzha and others rose; posts were cut and the region panicked.

sentences.zh: 十五年，鎮巡官會師討之，斬馘千數，鳳起病死，其眾爭歸附，因置平夷、歸化二堡以居之。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year pacification officials united armies to attack them, beheading thousands; Fengqi died of illness, his followers vied to submit, and the Pingyi and Guihua forts were established to settle them.
translations.idiomatic: Year 15: united forces killed thousands; Fengqi died; his people submitted; Pingyi and Guihua forts were founded.

sentences.zh: 有鎮西千戶所。

translations.literal: It had the Zhenxi company.
translations.idiomatic: It had a Zhenxi company.

sentences.zh: 鹽井衛，古定笮縣也。

translations.literal: Yanjing Guard was the ancient Dingzuo County.
translations.idiomatic: Yanjing Guard was ancient Dingzuo County.

sentences.zh: 元初為落蘭部。

translations.literal: In the early Yuan it was the Luolan department.
translations.idiomatic: Early Yuan: the Luolan department.

sentences.zh: 至元中，於黑、白鹽井置閏鹽縣，於縣置柏興府。

translations.literal: In the Zhiyuan period the Black and White Salt Wells were made Runyan County, and Boxing Prefecture was established at the county.
translations.idiomatic: Zhiyuan times: Black and White Salt Wells became Runyan County with Boxing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 洪武中，改為柏興千戶所，旋改鹽井衛，又於二井置鹽課司。

translations.literal: In the Hongwu period it was changed to the Boxing company, then soon to Yanjing Guard, and salt-tax offices were set at the two wells.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu: Boxing company, then Yanjing Guard, with salt offices at both wells.

sentences.zh: 永樂五年設馬剌長官司；

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongle the Mala long-chief office was established;
translations.idiomatic: Yongle year 5: the Mala long-chief office was founded;

sentences.zh: 其村落多白夷居之。

translations.literal: Its villages were mostly inhabited by Baiyi.
translations.idiomatic: Its villages were mostly Baiyi.

sentences.zh: 長官民阿氏，洪武時歸附，授世職。

translations.literal: Long chief Min of the A clan submitted in the Hongwu period and received a hereditary post.
translations.idiomatic: Long chief Min of the A clan submitted in Hongwu and received a hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 地接雲南北勝州，稱庶富，人亦擾馴。

translations.literal: The territory adjoined Yunnan's Beisheng Prefecture; it was called prosperous, and the people were comparatively tractable.
translations.idiomatic: Bordering Yunnan Beisheng, it was wealthy and its people comparatively tame.

sentences.zh: 打沖河守禦中左千戶所，其土千戶剌兀，於洪武二十五年征賈哈喇效順來歸。

translations.literal: The Dachong River Defense Central Left Company: its native company commander La Wu had come in submission during the twenty-fifth year of Hongwu while campaigning against Jiahaluo.
translations.idiomatic: Dachong River Central Left Company: native commander La Wu submitted in Hongwu year 25 during the Jiahaluo campaign.

sentences.zh: 其子馬剌非復貢馬赴京，授本所副千戶。

translations.literal: His son Malafei again presented horses at court and was appointed deputy company commander of this post.
translations.idiomatic: Son Malafei presented horses at court and became deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 永樂十一年升正，以別於四所。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Yongle he was promoted to full commander to distinguish him from the four companies.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle year 11: he was promoted to full commander, distinct from the four companies.

sentences.zh: 地與麗江、永寧二府鄰，麗江土官木氏侵削其地幾半。

translations.literal: The land bordered the native prefectures of Lijiang and Yongning; the Lijiang native official Mu clan had encroached on nearly half its territory.
translations.idiomatic: It bordered Lijiang and Yongning; Lijiang chief Mu had seized nearly half its land.

sentences.zh: 會川衛，越巂之會無縣也。

translations.literal: Huichuan Guard was the Han Huiwu County of Yuexi.
translations.idiomatic: Huichuan Guard was Han Huiwu County in Yuexi.

sentences.zh: 唐上元中，移邛都縣於會川鎮，以川原並會故名。

translations.literal: In the Shangyuan era of Tang, Qiongdu County was moved to Huichuan garrison, named for the meeting of river and plain.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Shangyuan: Qiongdu County moved to Huichuan garrison where river and plain met.

sentences.zh: 宋屬大理，為會川府。

translations.literal: Under the Song it belonged to Dali and was Huichuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Song times: Dali's Huichuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元置會川路，治武安州，隸羅羅斯宣慰司。

translations.literal: The Yuan established Huichuan Circuit, administering Wu'an Prefecture, under the Luoluo Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan: Huichuan Circuit at Wu'an, under Luoluo Pacification.

sentences.zh: 洪武十七年，會川土同知馬誠來朝，復立會川府，領武安、永昌、麻龍等州。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Hongwu the Huichuan native vice-prefect Ma Cheng came to court; Huichuan Prefecture was restored, governing Wu'an, Yongchang, Malong, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu year 17: vice-prefect Ma Cheng came to court; Huichuan Prefecture was restored over Wu'an, Yongchang, Malong, and others.

sentences.zh: 二十六年革會川府。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year Huichuan Prefecture was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Year 26: Huichuan Prefecture was abolished.

sentences.zh: 初，月魯帖木兒反，土知府王春陷會川，毀民居府治，至是遂墮其城。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Yuelu Tiemuer rebelled, the native prefect Wang Chun seized Huichuan, destroyed civilian homes and the prefectural offices, and the city was therefore abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuelu Tiemuer rebelled, native prefect Wang Chun took Huichuan, wrecked the city, and it was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 尋改為會川衛軍民指揮使司，領迷易千戶所。

translations.literal: Soon it was changed to the Huichuan Military-Civilian Command, governing the Miyi company.
translations.idiomatic: It then became Huichuan Military-Civilian Command with the Miyi company.

sentences.zh: 土官賢姓，其先雲南景東僰種也，徙其屬來田種。

translations.literal: The native official was of the Xian clan; his ancestors were Bo people from Yunnan's Jingdong who moved their followers to farm the fields.
translations.idiomatic: The Xian clan, Bo people from Jingdong in Yunnan, had moved followers there to farm.

sentences.zh: 洪武十六年歸附，以隨征東川、芒部勞，授世襲副千戶。

translations.literal: They submitted in the sixteenth year of Hongwu and, for merit in campaigning against Dongchuan and Mangbu, received a hereditary deputy company command.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu year 16: they submitted and earned a hereditary deputy command for campaigning in Dongchuan and Mangbu.

sentences.zh: 居所治城外，所轄僰蠻僅八百戶。

translations.literal: Their seat lay outside the city wall of the administrative center; the Bo tribes under their rule numbered only eight hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: They lived outside the walled seat; only eight hundred Bo households answered to them.

sentences.zh: 茂州，古冉龍國地。

translations.literal: Maozhou was the land of the ancient Ranrang state.
translations.idiomatic: Maozhou was ancient Ranrang territory.

sentences.zh: 漢武帝置汶山郡，宣帝為北部都尉。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu of Han established Wenshan Commandery; Emperor Xuan made it the northern frontier commandant's district.
translations.idiomatic: Han Emperor Wu made Wenshan Commandery; Emperor Xuan a northern frontier command.

sentences.zh: 隋為蜀州，尋改會州。

translations.literal: Under the Sui it was Shu Prefecture, soon changed to Hui Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Sui: Shu Prefecture, soon Hui Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 唐貞觀改茂州。

translations.literal: In the Zhenguan era of Tang it was changed to Maozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Zhenguan: Maozhou.

sentences.zh: 宋、元仍舊，治汶山縣。

translations.literal: Song and Yuan kept the old name, administering Wenshan County.
translations.idiomatic: Song and Yuan kept the name and ruled from Wenshan County.

sentences.zh: 洪武六年，茂州權知州楊者七及隴木頭、靜州、嶽希蓬諸土官來朝貢。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Hongwu the acting prefect Yang Zheqi and the native officials of Longmutou, Jingzhou, and Yuexipeng came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu year 6: acting prefect Yang Zheqi and chiefs of Longmutou, Jingzhou, and Yuexipeng presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一年置茂州衛指揮使司。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year the Maozhou Guard command was established.
translations.idiomatic: Year 11: Maozhou Guard was founded.

sentences.zh: 時四川都司遣兵修灌縣橋梁至陶關，汶川土酋孟道貴疑之，集部落阻陶關道。

translations.literal: At that time the Sichuan Regional Command sent troops to repair the bridge at Guanxian as far as Taoguan; the Wenchuan tribal chief Meng Daogui grew suspicious, gathered his tribes, and blocked the road at Taoguan.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan troops repairing the Guanxian bridge to Taoguan alarmed Wenchuan chief Meng Daogui, who blocked the road.

sentences.zh: 都司遣指揮胡淵、童勝等統兵分二道擊之，一由石泉，一由灌口。

translations.literal: The Regional Command sent Commanders Hu Yuan and Tong Sheng with troops on two routes to attack—one by Shiquan, one by Guankou.
translations.idiomatic: Commanders Hu Yuan and Tong Sheng attacked by Shiquan and Guankou.

sentences.zh: 由灌口者進次陶關，蠻眾伏兩山間，投石崖下，兵不能進。

translations.literal: The Guankou column advanced to Taoguan; the tribes lay in ambush between the two mountains and rolled stones down the cliffs so the army could not advance.
translations.idiomatic: The Guankou force reached Taoguan; tribes ambushed from both hills and rolled stones down the cliffs.

sentences.zh: 適汶川土官來降，得其間道。

translations.literal: Just then a Wenchuan native official came to surrender and revealed a hidden path.
translations.idiomatic: A Wenchuan chief then surrendered and showed a secret path.

sentences.zh: 乃選勇士卷旗甲，乘夜潛出兩山後，遲明從山頂張旗幟，發火炮，蠻驚潰。

translations.literal: They therefore chose stalwarts, rolled up banners and armor, stole out by night behind the two mountains, and at dawn unfurled banners from the summits, fired cannon, and the tribes fled in alarm.
translations.idiomatic: Elite troops crept behind the hills by night, raised banners and fired cannon at dawn, and the tribes fled.

sentences.zh: 師進雁門關，道險，蠻復據之。

translations.literal: The army advanced to Yanmen Pass; the road was perilous and the tribes again held it.
translations.idiomatic: At perilous Yanmen Pass the tribes held the road again.

sentences.zh: 乃駐平野，得小舟渡，至龍止鐵冶寨，擊破之。

translations.literal: They camped on the open plain, obtained small boats to cross, reached Longzhi Tieye Stockade, and broke it.
translations.idiomatic: They crossed by boat, reached Longzhi Tieye Stockade, and stormed it.

sentences.zh: 其由石泉者次泥池，蠻悉眾拒。

translations.literal: The Shiquan column halted at Nichi; the tribes mustered all their strength to resist.
translations.idiomatic: The Shiquan column met full tribal resistance at Nichi.

sentences.zh: 千戶薛文突陣射卻之，士卒奮擊，大敗其眾。

translations.literal: Company commander Xue Wen charged the line shooting and drove them back; the soldiers pressed the attack and routed their host.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Xue Wen charged shooting and routed them.

sentences.zh: 兩軍遂會於茂州，楊者七迎降，以者七仍領其州。

translations.literal: The two armies met at Maozhou; Yang Zheqi came out to surrender and Zheqi was left to govern his prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Both columns met at Maozhou; Yang Zheqi surrendered and kept his prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乃詔立茂州衛，留指揮楚華將兵三千守之。

translations.literal: An edict then established Maozhou Guard and left Commander Chu Hua with three thousand troops to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: Maozhou Guard was founded with Commander Chu Hua and 3,000 troops.

sentences.zh: 十五年，者七陰結生番，約日伏兵陷城。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Zheqi secretly joined the raw tribes and agreed on a day to ambush troops and seize the city.
translations.idiomatic: Year 15: Zheqi secretly allied with raw tribes to ambush the city.

sentences.zh: 有小校密告於官，遂發兵捕斬者七。

translations.literal: A junior officer secretly reported to the officials; troops were therefore sent to capture and behead Zheqi.
translations.idiomatic: A junior officer informed the garrison; Zheqi was captured and beheaded.

sentences.zh: 生番不之覺，如期入寇，官軍掩擊敗之，於是盡徙羌民於城外。

translations.literal: The raw tribes were unaware; they entered on schedule to raid, and government troops ambushed and defeated them, whereupon all Qiang people were moved outside the walls.
translations.idiomatic: The raw tribes attacked on schedule and were ambushed; the Qiang were then moved outside the walls.

sentences.zh: 正德二年，太監羅籥奏，茂州所轄卜南村、曲山等寨，乞為白人，願納糧差。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhengde Supervisor Eunuch Luo Yu memorialized that the stockades of Bunan Village, Qushan, and others under Maozhou asked to be registered as Bai people and were willing to pay grain levies and corvée.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde year 2: eunuch Luo Yu reported Maozhou stockades Bunan, Qushan, and others sought Bai status and tax obligations.

sentences.zh: 其俗以白為善，以黑為惡。

translations.literal: Their custom held white good and black evil.
translations.idiomatic: They regarded white as good and black as evil.

sentences.zh: 禮部覆，番人向化，宜令入貢給賞。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites replied that as the tribes had turned toward civilization, they should be allowed to present tribute and receive rewards.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites said civilized tribes should present tribute and receive rewards.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 十四年，巡撫馬昊調松潘兵，攻小東路番寨，而茂州核桃溝上、下關番蠻懼，遂糾白石、羅打鼓諸寨生番，攻圍城堡，遊擊張傑敗績。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year Grand Coordinator Ma Hao mobilized Songpan troops to attack the Xiaodong Road tribal stockades; the Maozhou Walnut Gorge upper and lower pass tribes grew afraid and therefore rallied the raw tribes of Baishi, Luodagu, and other stockades to besiege the forts; Mobile Corps Commander Zhang Jie was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Year 14: Ma Hao attacked Xiaodong Road; frightened Maozhou Walnut Gorge tribes rallied Baishi and Luodagu raw tribes to besiege forts; Zhang Jie was beaten.

sentences.zh: 十五年，巡撫盛應期奏，綽頭番犯松州，總兵張傑克之，復犯雄溪屯，指揮杜欽敗之，煙崇等寨皆降。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Grand Coordinator Sheng Yingqi memorialized that the Chuohead tribes raided Songzhou; Regional Commander Zhang Jie overcame them, but they again raided Xiongxi garrison; Commander Du Qin defeated them and the Yanchong stockades all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Year 15: Sheng Yingqi reported Chuohead raids on Songzhou; Zhang Jie beat them, they struck Xiongxi, Du Qin defeated them, and Yanchong stockades surrendered.

sentences.zh: 萬歷十九年，威、茂諸番作亂，攻破新橋，乘勢圍普安等堡。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Wanli the Wei and Mao tribes rebelled, broke through Xinqiao, and took advantage of the moment to besiege Pu'an and other forts.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli year 19: Wei and Mao tribes rebelled, broke Xinqiao, and besieged Pu'an forts.

sentences.zh: 四川巡撫李尚忠檄諸路兵追剿過河，普安諸堡得以保全。

translations.literal: Sichuan Grand Coordinator Li Shangzhong ordered troops from all routes to pursue and cross the river; the Pu'an forts were thereby preserved.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shangzhong sent all routes in pursuit across the river and saved Pu'an.

sentences.zh: 茂州地方數千里，自唐武德改郡會州，領羈縻州九，前後皆蠻族，向無城郭。

translations.literal: Maozhou's territory extends several thousand li; since Tang Wude, when the commandery was changed to Hui Prefecture with nine jimi prefectures, it had always been tribal land and never had walls or towns.
translations.idiomatic: Maozhou spans thousands of li; since Tang Wude's nine jimi prefectures it had been tribal land without walled towns.

sentences.zh: 宋熙寧中，範百常知茂州，民請築城，而蠻人來爭。

translations.literal: In the Xining era of Song, Fan Baichang was prefect of Maozhou; the people asked to build a wall and the tribes came to contest it.
translations.idiomatic: Song Xining: prefect Fan Baichang; locals asked to build walls and tribes contested it.

sentences.zh: 百常與之拒，且戰且築，城乃得立。

translations.literal: Baichang resisted them, building while fighting, and the wall was finally raised.
translations.idiomatic: Baichang fought while building until the wall stood.

sentences.zh: 自宋迄元，皆為羌人所據，不置州縣者幾二百年。

translations.literal: From Song through Yuan it was held by Qiang people; for nearly two hundred years no prefecture or county was established.
translations.idiomatic: Song through Yuan it was Qiang-held; for nearly 200 years no civil administration existed.

sentences.zh: 洪武十一年平蜀，置疊溪右千戶所，隸茂州衛。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Hongwu Shu was pacified and the Diexi Right Company was established under Maozhou Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu year 11: after Shu was pacified, the Diexi Right Company was placed under Maozhou Guard.

sentences.zh: 而置威茂道，開府茂州，分遊擊以駐疊溪，規防始立。

translations.literal: The Weimao Circuit was also established, opening an office at Maozhou and posting mobile corps commanders at Diexi—only then did defensive planning begin.
translations.idiomatic: The Weimao Circuit opened at Maozhou with mobile corps at Diexi—defense began then.

sentences.zh: 然東路生羌，白草最強，又與松潘黃毛韃相通，出沒為寇，相沿不絕雲。

translations.literal: Yet the eastern raw Qiang, of whom Baicao was strongest, also communicated with the Songpan Yellow-Hair Tartars and raided without cease.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern raw Qiang, especially Baicao, linked with Songpan Yellow-Hair Tartars and raided endlessly.

sentences.zh: 其通西域要路，為桃坪，即古桃關也，有繩橋渡江。

translations.literal: The vital route to the Western Regions was Taoping, the ancient Taoguan, with a rope bridge across the river.
translations.idiomatic: The western route ran through Taoping, ancient Taoguan, crossed by rope bridge.

sentences.zh: 守桃坪者，為隴木司。

translations.literal: Taoping was held by the Longmu department.
translations.idiomatic: Taoping was held by the Longmu department.

sentences.zh: 茂州長官司三：曰隴木，曰靜州，曰疊溪。

translations.literal: Maozhou had three long-chief offices: Longmu, Jingzhou, and Diexi.
translations.idiomatic: Three Maozhou long-chief offices: Longmu, Jingzhou, and Diexi.

sentences.zh: 隴木長官司，其長官即隴木裏人也。

translations.literal: The Longmu long-chief office: its chief was a man of Longmu li.
translations.idiomatic: Longmu long-chief office: its chief was of Longmu li.

sentences.zh: 洪武時歸附，授承直郎，世襲長官，歲貢馬二匹。

translations.literal: He submitted in the Hongwu period, was granted Registrar of the Direct Transmission, held the long-chief post by hereditary succession, and presented two horses annually in tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu submission brought Registrar rank, hereditary office, and two tribute horses yearly.

sentences.zh: 所屬玉亭、神溪十二寨，俱為編氓，有保長統之。

translations.literal: The twelve stockades of Yuting and Shenxi under his rule were all registered subjects, with baozhang to govern them.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve stockades—Yuting and Shenxi—were registered subjects under baozhang.

sentences.zh: 靜州長官司，其地即唐之悉唐縣，其長官亦靜州裏人也。

translations.literal: The Jingzhou long-chief office: its land was Tang Xitang County; its chief was also a man of Jingzhou li.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhou long-chief office: Tang Xitang County; its chief was of Jingzhou li.

sentences.zh: 襲官貢馬，與隴木同。

translations.literal: Hereditary office and tribute horses were the same as Longmu.
translations.idiomatic: Hereditary office and tribute matched Longmu.

sentences.zh: 正德間，與嶽希蓬、節孝為亂，攻茂城，斷水道七日。

translations.literal: In the Zhengde period they joined Yuexipeng and Jiexiao in rebellion, attacked Maozhou city, and cut the water supply for seven days.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde: they joined Yuexipeng and Jiexiao, attacked Maozhou, and cut water for seven days.

sentences.zh: 節孝弟車勺潛引水以濟我軍。

translations.literal: Jiexiao's younger brother Che Shao secretly led water to supply our army.
translations.idiomatic: Jiexiao's brother Che Shao secretly restored our water.

sentences.zh: 事平，使車勺襲職，轄法虎、核桃溝八寨，俱編戶為氓，亦有保長統之。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, Che Shao was made to inherit office; he governed the eight stockades of Fahu and Walnut Gorge, all registered households with baozhang over them.
translations.idiomatic: After peace Che Shao inherited office over eight stockades—Fahu and Walnut Gorge—with registered households under baozhang.

sentences.zh: 疊溪千戶所，永樂四年置。

translations.literal: The Diexi company was established in the fourth year of Yongle.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle year 4: the Diexi company was founded.

sentences.zh: 領長官司二：曰疊溪，在治北一里；

translations.literal: It governed two long-chief offices: Diexi, one li north of the seat;
translations.idiomatic: Two long-chief offices: Diexi, one li north;

sentences.zh: 曰郁即，在治西十五里。

translations.literal: and Yuji, fifteen li west of the seat.
translations.idiomatic: and Yuji, fifteen li west.

sentences.zh: 疊溪郁氏，洪武十五年歸附，給印世襲，凡三年貢馬四匹。

translations.literal: The Diexi Yu clan submitted in the fifteenth year of Hongwu, received a seal by hereditary succession, and presented four horses in tribute every three years.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu year 15: the Diexi Yu clan submitted, received a hereditary seal, and sent four horses every three years.

sentences.zh: 長官所轄河東熟番八寨，皆大姓，及馬路、小關七族。

translations.literal: The long chief governed eight settled tribes east of the river, all great clans, plus the Malu and Xiaoguan seven families.
translations.idiomatic: The long chief ruled eight settled eastern tribes of great clans plus Malu and Xiaoguan seven families.

sentences.zh: 其土舍轄河西小姓六寨。

translations.literal: His native steward governed six small clans west of the river.
translations.idiomatic: A native steward ruled six small western clans.

sentences.zh: 地土廣遠。

translations.literal: The land was broad and far.
translations.idiomatic: The territory was vast.

sentences.zh: 饒畜產，稞麥路積。

translations.literal: Livestock were abundant and highland barley lay in heaps along the roads.
translations.idiomatic: Livestock flourished and barley piled along the roads.

sentences.zh: 人皆梟黠，名雖熟番，與生番等。

translations.literal: The people were all crafty; though called settled tribes, they were the equal of raw tribes.
translations.idiomatic: They were crafty; though "settled," they matched raw tribes in fierceness.

sentences.zh: 郁即長官啖保，萬歷十八年與黑水、松坪稱兵，攻新橋，明年伏誅。

translations.literal: The Yuji long chief Danbao, in the eighteenth year of Wanli, took up arms with Heishui and Songping, attacked Xinqiao, and was executed the following year.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli year 18: Yuji long chief Danbao joined Heishui and Songping, attacked Xinqiao, and was executed next year.

sentences.zh: 漢關墩附近諸小姓，舊屬郁即，至是改屬疊溪。

translations.literal: The small clans near the Han frontier passes, formerly under Yuji, were then transferred to Diexi.
translations.idiomatic: Small clans near Han passes, once Yuji's, were reassigned to Diexi.

sentences.zh: 初，都督方政平歷日諸寨，設長寧安撫司，隸松潘。

translations.literal: Earlier, Regional Commander Fang Zheng had pacified the Liri stockades and established the Changning Pacification Office under Songpan.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Fang Zheng pacified Liri stockades and set up Changning Pacification under Songpan.

sentences.zh: 至正統元年，總兵蔣貴言其遼闊，亦改隸於疊溪守禦千戶。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhengtong Regional Commander Jiang Gui said its territory was too vast and it too was placed under the Diexi Defense Company.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong year 1: Jiang Gui said Changning was too vast and placed it under Diexi Defense Company.

sentences.zh: 松潘，古氐羌地。

translations.literal: Songpan was the ancient Di and Qiang land.
translations.idiomatic: Songpan was ancient Di and Qiang territory.

sentences.zh: 西漢置護羌校尉於此。

translations.literal: The Western Han established the Protector of the Qiang here.
translations.idiomatic: Western Han placed the Protector of the Qiang here.

sentences.zh: 唐初置松州都督，廣德初，陷於吐蕃。

translations.literal: In early Tang Songzhou Commandery was established; in early Guangde it fell to Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: Early Tang: Songzhou; early Guangde: lost to Tibet.

sentences.zh: 宋時，吐蕃將潘羅支領之，名潘州。

translations.literal: In Song times the Tibetan general Pan Luozhi held it and it was called Pan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Song: Tibetan Pan Luozhi held it as Pan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元置吐蕃宣慰司。

translations.literal: The Yuan established a Tibetan Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan: a Tibetan Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 洪武十二年，命平羌將軍御史大夫丁玉定其地，敕之曰：「松潘僻在萬山，接西戎之境，朕豈欲窮兵遠討，但羌戎屢寇邊，征之不獲已也。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Hongwu the Pacification-General of the Qiang, Censor-in-Chief Ding Yu, was ordered to fix its territory; the edict said: "Songpan lies remote among ten thousand mountains, adjoining the western Rong frontier. I do not wish to exhaust the army in distant campaigns, but the Qiang and Rong have repeatedly raided the border, and to campaign against them is unavoidable.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu year 12: Pacification-General Ding Yu was ordered to fix Songpan; the edict read: "Songpan lies remote in the mountains on the western Rong frontier. I do not wish distant campaigns, but Qiang and Rong raids leave no choice."

sentences.zh: 今捷至，知松州已克，徐將資糧於容州，進取潘州。

translations.literal: Now the victory report has arrived; I know Songzhou has been taken. Move supplies gradually to Rongzhou and advance to take Panzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Your victory report has arrived, and I learn that Songzhou has been taken. Move supplies by stages to Rongzhou and advance against Panzhou.

sentences.zh: 若盡三州之地，則疊州不須窮兵，自當來服。

translations.literal: If you secure all the territory of the three prefectures, then Diezhou need not be pursued with exhausted armies—it will submit of itself.
translations.idiomatic: If you hold all three prefectures, Diezhou will submit without need for a grinding campaign.

sentences.zh: 須擇士勇者守納都、疊溪路，其驛道無阻遏者，不可守也。

translations.literal: You must select brave officers to guard the Nadou and Diexi routes; any post road that is not obstructed must not be left unguarded.
translations.idiomatic: Choose brave officers to hold the Nadou and Diexi passes, and do not leave any open courier route undefended.

sentences.zh: 來降諸戎長，必遣入朝，朕親撫諭之。

translations.literal: All tribal chieftains who come to submit must be sent to court; I shall personally comfort and instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: Send every submitting tribal chief to court, where I shall receive and instruct them in person.

sentences.zh: 」遂並潘州於松州，置松州衛指揮使司。

translations.literal: " Thereupon Panzhou was merged into Songzhou, and the Songzhou Guard command was established.
translations.idiomatic: " Panzhou was then annexed to Songzhou, and the Songzhou Guard command was set up.

sentences.zh: 丁玉遣寧州衛指揮高顯城其地。

translations.literal: Ding Yu dispatched Gao Xian, commander of the Ningzhou Guard, to build a fort in that territory.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Yu sent Gao Xian, commander of the Ningzhou Guard, to build a walled post there.

sentences.zh: 十三年，帝以松州衛遠在山谷，屯種不給，饋餉為難，命罷之。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, because the Songzhou Guard lay far in the mountain valleys, garrison farming could not supply its needs, and transport of provisions was difficult, the emperor ordered it abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13, the emperor ordered the Songzhou Guard disbanded, since it lay deep in the mountains, its garrison farms could not sustain it, and supplying it was impracticable.

sentences.zh: 未幾，指揮耿忠經略其地，奏言松州為番蜀要害地，不可罷，命復置。
