translations.literal: Before long, Commander Geng Zhong surveyed the region and memorialized that Songzhou was a strategic point between the tribes and Shu, and could not be abandoned; the emperor ordered it restored.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Commander Geng Zhong surveyed the area and reported that Songzhou was a vital choke point between the frontier tribes and Shu; the guard was ordered re-established.

sentences.zh: 十四年置松潘等處安撫司，以龍州知州薛文勝為安撫使，秩從五品。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year a Songpan and adjacent regions Pacification Commission was established, with Xue Wensheng, prefect of Longzhou, as pacification commissioner at the fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14 a Pacification Commission for Songpan and neighboring regions was created, with Longzhou prefect Xue Wensheng as pacification commissioner of the fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 又置十三族長官司，秩正七品：曰勒都，曰阿昔洞，曰北定，曰牟力結，曰蛒匝，曰祈命，曰山洞，曰麥匝，曰者多，曰占藏先結，曰包藏先結，曰班班，曰白馬路。

translations.literal: Thirteen tribal chieftaincies of the seventh rank were also established, namely Ledu, Axidong, Beiding, Moulijie, Geza, Qiming, Shandong, Maiza, Zhiduo, Zhancangxianjie, Baocangxianjie, Banban, and Baimalu.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen seventh-rank tribal chieftaincies were also set up: Ledu, Axidong, Beiding, Moulijie, Geza, Qiming, Shandong, Maiza, Zhiduo, Zhancangxianjie, Baocangxianjie, Banban, and Baimalu.

sentences.zh: 其後復隸松潘者，長官司四，曰阿思，曰思囊兒，曰阿用，曰潘斡寨；

translations.literal: Later, four chieftaincies re-subordinated to Songpan were named: Asi, Sinang'er, Ayong, and Panwozhai;
translations.idiomatic: Later, four chieftaincies were again placed under Songpan: Asi, Sinang'er, Ayong, and Panwozhai;

sentences.zh: 安撫司四，曰八郎，曰阿角寨，曰麻兒匝，曰芒兒者。

translations.literal: and four pacification commissions: Balang, Ajiaozhai, Ma'erza, and Mang'erzhe.
translations.idiomatic: and four pacification commissions: Balang, Ajiaozhai, Ma'erza, and Mang'erzhe.

sentences.zh: 後又以思曩日安撫司附焉。

translations.literal: Later the Sinangri Pacification Commission was also attached.
translations.idiomatic: The Sinangri Pacification Commission was later attached as well.

sentences.zh: 諸長官司每三年入貢，賞賜如例。

translations.literal: All the chieftaincies presented tribute every three years and received rewards according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Each chieftaincy sent tribute every three years and was rewarded according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 十五年，占藏先結等土酋來朝，貢馬一百三匹，詔賜綺鈔有差。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year the native chiefs Zhancangxianjie and others came to court and presented one hundred thirty horses; an edict granted them brocade and paper money in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In year 15 the native chiefs Zhancangxianjie and others came to court with one hundred thirty horses; the court granted brocade and paper money in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 十六年，耿忠言：「臣所轄松潘等處安撫司屬各長官司，宜以其戶口之數，量其民力，歲令納馬置驛，而籍其民充驛夫，供徭役。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year Geng Zhong said: "The various chieftaincies under the Songpan Pacification Commission in my jurisdiction should, according to the number of their households and in measure of their people's strength, be required each year to supply horses for post stations, and their people registered to serve as post couriers and perform corvée."
translations.idiomatic: In year 16 Geng Zhong memorialized: "The chieftaincies under the Songpan Pacification Commission should, according to household numbers and in proportion to local capacity, supply horses yearly for courier stations, with their people registered as post runners for corvée service."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The court approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 既而松潘羌民作亂，官兵討平之。

translations.literal: Before long the Songpan Qiang rose in revolt, and government troops suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the Songpan Qiang rebelled, and government troops put down the disturbance.

sentences.zh: 甃松州及疊溪城。

translations.literal: The walls of Songzhou and Diexi were repaired with brick facing.
translations.idiomatic: The walls of Songzhou and Diexi were faced with brick.

sentences.zh: 十七年，松潘八積族老虎等寨蠻亂。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year the Laohu and other stockaded tribes of the Bajizhu clan in Songpan rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In year 17 the Laohu stockade and other Bajizhu tribes of Songpan rose in revolt.

sentences.zh: 官兵擊破之，獲馬一百二十，犏牛三百，牦牛五百九十。

translations.literal: Government troops routed them and captured one hundred twenty horses, three hundred draft cattle, and five hundred ninety yaks.
translations.idiomatic: Government troops defeated them, taking one hundred twenty horses, three hundred draft cattle, and five hundred ninety yaks.

sentences.zh: 景川侯曹震請擇良馬貢京師，余給軍，其犏牛、牦牛非中國所畜，令易糧餉犒軍，從之。

translations.literal: Marquis Cao Zhen of Jingchuan asked that choice horses be sent as tribute to the capital and the rest given to the army; as draft cattle and yaks were not animals China customarily raised, he asked that they be exchanged for grain to reward the troops—the court agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis Cao Zhen of Jingchuan requested that the best horses be sent to the capital as tribute and the remainder issued to the troops; since draft cattle and yaks were not animals commonly kept in China, he asked that they be exchanged for grain to reward the army, and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 十八年，松州羌反。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the Songzhou Qiang rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 the Songzhou Qiang rose in revolt.

sentences.zh: 成都衛指揮成信等率兵攻其牟力等寨，破之。

translations.literal: Cheng Xin of the Chengdu Guard and others led troops to attack their Mouli and other stockades and broke them.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Xin of the Chengdu Guard and others led troops against the Mouli stockade and others and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 兵還，又遇賊三千人於道，復擊敗之，追至乞剌河乃還。

translations.literal: On the march back they again met three thousand bandits on the road, defeated them once more, and pursued them to the Qila River before returning.
translations.idiomatic: On the return march they met three thousand rebels on the road, defeated them again, and pursued them to the Qila River before withdrawing.

sentences.zh: 二十年改松州衛為松潘等處軍民指揮使司，改松潘安撫司為龍州。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year the Songzhou Guard was changed to the Songpan and Adjacent Regions Military-Civilian Command, and the Songpan Pacification Commission was changed back to Longzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In year 20 the Songzhou Guard was redesignated the Songpan and Adjacent Regions Military-Civilian Command, and the Songpan Pacification Commission was restored as Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，朵貢生番則路、南向等引草地生番千余人寇潘州阿昔洞長官司，殺傷人口。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year the raw tribesmen Duolu of Duogong and Nanxiang and others led more than a thousand grassland tribesmen to raid the Axidong chieftaincy in Panzhou, killing and wounding people.
translations.idiomatic: In year 21 the raw tribesmen Duolu of Duogong and Nanxiang and others led more than a thousand grassland tribesmen to raid the Axidong chieftaincy in Panzhou, killing and wounding inhabitants.

sentences.zh: 指揮周助率馬步軍同松潘衛軍討之，番寇率眾迎戰，千戶劉德破之，斬首三十四級，獲馬三十余匹。

translations.literal: Commander Zhou Zhu led horse and foot together with Songpan Guard troops to attack them; the tribes met battle in force, and Thousand-Commander Liu De broke them, taking thirty-four heads and more than thirty horses.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Zhou Zhu led horse and foot with Songpan Guard troops against them; the tribes met battle in strength, but Thousand-Commander Liu De routed them, taking thirty-four heads and more than thirty horses.

sentences.zh: 賊潰，渡河四十餘里，復收敗卒屯聚。

translations.literal: The bandits fled, crossed the river for more than forty li, and gathered their scattered troops again.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled across the river for more than forty li and reassembled their broken forces.

sentences.zh: 指揮周能追擊之，斬首一百三十余級，獲馬六十余匹，溺死甚眾，群番遠遁。

translations.literal: Commander Zhou Neng pursued and struck them, taking more than one hundred thirty heads and more than sixty horses; very many drowned, and the tribes fled far away.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Zhou Neng pursued them, taking more than one hundred thirty heads and more than sixty horses; many drowned, and the tribes fled deep into the mountains.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，西番思曩日等族來歸，進馬百三十匹，命給金銅信符並賜文綺襲衣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year the Sinangri and other western tribes came to submit and presented one hundred thirty horses; they were granted gold-bronze tallies of authority and brocade robes.
translations.idiomatic: In year 26 the Sinangri and other western tribes submitted and presented one hundred thirty horses; the court granted them gold-bronze tallies of authority and brocade robes.

sentences.zh: 宣德二年，麻兒匝順化，喇嘛著八讓卜來歸。

translations.literal: In the second year of the Xuande reign Ma'erza submitted to transformation, and the lama Zhuobarangbo came to allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande year 2 Ma'erza submitted, and the lama Zhuobarangbo came to allegiance.

sentences.zh: 置麻兒匝安撫司，以喇嘛著八讓卜為安撫。

translations.literal: The Ma'erza Pacification Commission was established, with the lama Zhuobarangbo as pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: A Ma'erza Pacification Commission was set up with the lama Zhuobarangbo as pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 麻兒匝在阿樂地，去松潘七百餘里。

translations.literal: Ma'erza lay in Ale territory, more than seven hundred li from Songpan.
translations.idiomatic: Ma'erza lay in Ale territory, over seven hundred li from Songpan.

sentences.zh: 初，著八讓卜時侵掠邊民及遮八郎安撫司朝貢路。

translations.literal: At first Zhuobarangbo had raided border populations and blocked the tribute route of the Balang Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: At first Zhuobarangbo had raided border villagers and obstructed the Balang Pacification Commission's tribute route.

sentences.zh: 松潘衛指揮吳瑋遣人招之，因遣其侄完卜來貢獻，言其地廣民眾，過於八郎，請置宣撫司以轄之。

translations.literal: Commander Wu Wei of the Songpan Guard sent men to summon him; he then sent his nephew Wanbo to present tribute, saying his territory was broad and his people numerous, exceeding Balang, and asking that a Pacification-General Commission be established to govern them.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Wu Wei of the Songpan Guard sent envoys to summon him; Zhuobarangbo then sent his nephew Wanbo with tribute, claiming a territory broader and more populous than Balang's, and requesting a Pacification-General Commission to govern it.

sentences.zh: 帝命置安撫，遣敕諭之。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered a pacification commission established and sent an edict to instruct him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered a pacification commission established and sent an edict of instruction.

sentences.zh: 四川巡按等奏松潘衛所轄阿用等寨蠻寇，擁眾萬余，傷敗官軍，請討之。

translations.literal: The Sichuan touring censor and others memorialized that the Ayong and other stockades under the Songpan Guard had rebelled, mustering more than ten thousand men, wounding and defeating government troops, and asking that they be attacked.
translations.idiomatic: The Sichuan touring censor and others reported that the Ayong and other stockades under the Songpan Guard had rebelled with more than ten thousand men, defeating government troops, and requested a punitive expedition.

sentences.zh: 帝意邊將必有激之者。

translations.literal: The emperor suspected that border generals must have provoked them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor suspected that frontier commanders had provoked the outbreak.

sentences.zh: 既四川都司奏至，言並非番寇。

translations.literal: When the memorial of the Sichuan regional command arrived, it said they were not tribal bandits at all.
translations.idiomatic: When the Sichuan regional command's report arrived, it said they were not tribal raiders at all.

sentences.zh: 實由千戶錢宏因調發松潘官軍往征交址，眾憚行，宏詭言番寇至，當追捕，冀免調。

translations.literal: In fact Thousand-Commander Qian Hong, because Songpan troops had been mobilized for the campaign in Jiaozhi, feared the assignment; he falsely reported that tribal bandits had come and must be pursued, hoping to escape the draft.
translations.idiomatic: In fact Thousand-Commander Qian Hong, fearing deployment when Songpan troops were mobilized for the Jiaozhi campaign, falsely reported tribal raiders requiring pursuit, hoping to avoid the draft.

sentences.zh: 又領軍突入麥匝諸族，逼取牛馬，致番人忿怨。

translations.literal: He also led troops in a sudden raid into the Maiza and other tribes, seizing cattle and horses by force and arousing tribal resentment.
translations.idiomatic: He also led troops in a surprise raid on the Maiza and other tribes, seizing cattle and horses by force and provoking their anger.

sentences.zh: 復以大軍將致討懾之，番眾驚潰，約黑水生番為亂。

translations.literal: When a large army was again about to march against them in intimidation, the tribes panicked and fled, and made plans with the Black Water raw tribes to rebel.
translations.idiomatic: When a large punitive force was again about to march against them, the tribes panicked and fled, and plotted rebellion with the Black Water raw tribes.

sentences.zh: 帝命逮宏等，而責諸司怠玩邊務，亟捕諸傷官軍者。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Hong and others arrested and rebuked the various offices for neglecting frontier affairs, ordering them urgently to capture those who had wounded government troops.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Hong and others arrested and rebuked the relevant offices for neglecting the frontier, commanding them to capture at once those who had wounded government troops.

sentences.zh: 遣都指揮僉事蔣貴往，同松潘衛指揮吳瑋招撫番寇，令調附近諸衛軍二萬人以行。

translations.literal: Regional Commander-in-Chief Jiang Gui was sent, together with Commander Wu Wei of the Songpan Guard, to summon and pacify the tribal bandits, with orders to mobilize twenty thousand troops from nearby guards for the expedition.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander-in-Chief Jiang Gui was dispatched with Songpan Commander Wu Wei to summon and pacify the tribes, with twenty thousand troops from nearby guards ordered mobilized for the campaign.

sentences.zh: 時賊圍松潘、疊溪、茂州，斷索橋，官軍與戰皆敗，出掠綿竹諸縣，官署民居皆被焚毀，鎮撫侯璉死之。

translations.literal: At that time the bandits besieged Songpan, Diexi, and Maozhou, cut the rope bridges, and defeated government troops in every engagement; they raided Mianzhu and other counties, burning government offices and private homes alike, and Pacification Commissioner Hou Lian was killed.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the rebels besieged Songpan, Diexi, and Maozhou, severed the rope bridges, and defeated government troops in every battle; they raided Mianzhu and other counties, burning offices and homes alike, and Pacification Commissioner Hou Lian was killed.

sentences.zh: 蜀王遣護衛官校七千人來援，命都督陳懷與指揮蔣貴等合師亟討之，而梟宏於松潘以徇，並竄諸將之貪淫玩寇者。

translations.literal: The Prince of Shu sent seven thousand bodyguard troops as reinforcements; Regional Commander Chen Huai and Commander Jiang Gui and others were ordered to combine forces and attack urgently, while Hong was executed at Songpan as a warning and corrupt and negligent commanders were demoted.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Shu sent seven thousand bodyguard troops to reinforce them; Regional Commander Chen Huai and Commander Jiang Gui were ordered to unite their forces for an urgent campaign, Hong was executed at Songpan as a warning, and corrupt and negligent commanders were demoted.

sentences.zh: 三年，陳懷等率諸軍屢敗賊於圪答壩、葉棠關，奪永鎮等橋，復疊溪，撫定祁命等十族，又招降渴卓等二十余寨，松潘平。

translations.literal: In the third year Chen Huai and others repeatedly defeated the bandits at Gedaba and Yetang Pass, recovered the Yongzhen and other bridges, restored Diexi, pacified ten tribes including Qiming, and also induced more than twenty stockades including Kezhuo to submit; Songpan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 Chen Huai and others repeatedly defeated the rebels at Gedaba and Yetang Pass, recovered the Yongzhen and other bridges, restored Diexi, pacified ten tribes including Qiming, and induced more than twenty stockades including Kezhuo to submit; Songpan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 八年，八部安撫司及思囊兒十四族朝貢之使陛辭，令賫敕還諭其土官，俾約束所轄蠻民，安分循理，毋作過以取罪戾。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, when tribute envoys from the eight pacification commissions and the fourteen Sinang'er tribes took leave of the throne, they were charged with edicts to return and instruct their native officials to restrain the tribes under their rule, keep to their places and observe reason, and not commit offenses to bring punishment upon themselves.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8, when tribute envoys from the eight pacification commissions and the fourteen Sinang'er tribes took leave of the throne, they were entrusted with edicts instructing their native officials to restrain the tribes under their jurisdiction, remain in their places, and not commit offenses inviting punishment.

sentences.zh: 九年，敕指揮僉事方政、蔣貴等撫剿松潘。

translations.literal: In the ninth year an edict charged Regional Commander Fang Zheng, Jiang Gui, and others to pacify and suppress Songpan.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 an edict charged Regional Commander Fang Zheng, Jiang Gui, and others to pacify and suppress Songpan.

sentences.zh: 政等至，榜諭禍福，威、茂諸衛俱聽命，惟松潘、疊溪所轄任昌、巴豬、黑虎等寨梗化。

translations.literal: When Zheng and the others arrived, they posted notices of reward and punishment; the guards of Wei and Mao all obeyed, but only the Renchang, Bazhu, Heihu, and other stockades under Songpan and Diexi remained recalcitrant.
translations.idiomatic: When Zheng and his officers arrived, they posted proclamations of reward and punishment; the Wei and Mao guards all submitted, but only the Renchang, Bazhu, Heihu, and other stockades under Songpan and Diexi still resisted.

sentences.zh: 政令指揮趙得、宮聚等以次進兵，平龍溪等三十七寨，班師還。

translations.literal: Zheng ordered Commanders Zhao De, Gong Ju, and others to advance in sequence and pacified thirty-seven stockades including Longxi, then withdrew the army.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng ordered Commanders Zhao De, Gong Ju, and others to advance in turn and pacified thirty-seven stockades including Longxi, then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 命蔣貴佩平蠻將軍印，鎮守松潘。

translations.literal: Jiang Gui was ordered to wear the seal of Pacifier of the Barbarians and garrison Songpan.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Gui was appointed Pacifier of the Barbarians and stationed at Songpan.

sentences.zh: 十年，貴奏，比因番人不靖，松潘、疊溪諸處倉糧，支銷殆盡，別無儲積。

translations.literal: In the tenth year Gui memorialized that, because the tribes had lately been unsettled, the granaries of Songpan, Diexi, and other places had been nearly exhausted in disbursement and there were no other reserves.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 Gui reported that recent tribal unrest had nearly exhausted the granaries of Songpan, Diexi, and neighboring posts, with no reserves remaining.

sentences.zh: 帝命戶部於四川歲運之數，量益二分給之。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the Ministry of Revenue to increase by two-tenths the annual transport quota from Sichuan for their supply.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the Ministry of Revenue to increase by two-tenths the annual grain transport from Sichuan allotted to them.

sentences.zh: 正統三年，巖州長官司讓達作亂，侵雜道諸邊，雜道長官安白訴於朝。

translations.literal: In the third year of the Zhengtong reign Pacification Commissioner Rangda of the Yanzhou chieftaincy rebelled and raided the borders of Zadao and other districts; Pacification Commissioner An Bai of Zadao appealed to the court.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong year 3 Yanzhou Pacification Commissioner Rangda rebelled and raided the Zadao frontier; Zadao Pacification Commissioner An Bai appealed to the court.

sentences.zh: 帝命四川三司往諭之，皆歸服。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the three offices of Sichuan to go and instruct them; all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the three Sichuan commissions to go and instruct them; all submitted.

sentences.zh: 四年，松潘指揮趙得奏：「祁命族番寇商巴作亂，官軍捕擒之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Commander Zhao De of Songpan memorialized: "The Qiming tribesman Shangba has rebelled; government troops have captured him."
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 Songpan Commander Zhao De reported: "The Qiming tribesman Shangba has rebelled; government troops have captured him."

sentences.zh: 其弟小商巴復聚浦江、新塘等關，據險劫掠，乞發大軍剿除。

translations.literal: His younger brother Xiaoshangba again gathered at Pujiang, Xintang, and other passes, seized the terrain, and plundered; he asked that a large army be sent to exterminate them.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Xiaoshangba again gathered at Pujiang, Xintang, and other passes, seized strong positions, and plundered; he requested a large army to exterminate them.

sentences.zh: 」帝命李安棄總兵官，王翺參贊軍務，調成都左衛官軍及松潘土兵，合二萬人征之。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Li Anqi relieved of the post of commander-in-chief, with Wang Ao as coordinator of military affairs, and mobilized troops of the Left Chengdu Guard and Songpan native soldiers, twenty thousand in all, for the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Li Anqi relieved as commander-in-chief, with Wang Ao coordinating military affairs, and mobilized twenty thousand troops from the Left Chengdu Guard and Songpan native forces for the expedition.

sentences.zh: 已，翺知商巴為都指揮趙諒所陷，乃按誅諒而釋商巴等，事遂已。

translations.literal: Before long Ao learned that Shangba had been framed by Regional Commander Zhao Liang; he investigated, executed Liang, and released Shangba and the others, and the affair was closed.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Ao learned that Shangba had been framed by Regional Commander Zhao Liang; he investigated, executed Liang, released Shangba and the others, and the matter was closed.

sentences.zh: 九年，松潘指揮僉事王杲奏：「比者，黑虎等寨番蠻攻圍椒園、松溪等關堡，殺傷官民。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Regional Commander Wang Gao of Songpan memorialized: "Lately the Heihu and other stockaded tribes have attacked and besieged the passes and forts of Jiaoyuan and Songxi, killing and wounding officials and people."
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 Songpan Regional Commander Wang Gao reported: "Lately the Heihu and other stockaded tribes have attacked and besieged the passes and forts of Jiaoyuan and Songxi, killing officials and civilians."

sentences.zh: 欲行擒剿，恐各寨驚疑，應諭能擒賊者重賞之。

translations.literal: "If we move to capture and suppress them, I fear the various stockades will take alarm; it would be better to proclaim heavy rewards for whoever can seize the bandits."
translations.idiomatic: "If we move to suppress them by force, the other stockades may panic; it would be better to proclaim heavy rewards for whoever captures the rebels."

sentences.zh: 」報可。

translations.literal: The reply approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 十年，黑虎寨賊首多兒太伏誅。

translations.literal: In the tenth year Du'ertai, bandit chief of the Heihu stockade, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 Du'ertai, rebel chief of the Heihu stockade, was executed.

sentences.zh: 初，多兒太掠茂州境，為官軍所獲，誠而釋之。

translations.literal: At first Du'ertai had raided the Maozhou border and was captured by government troops, who released him on pledge of good behavior.
translations.idiomatic: At first Du'ertai had raided the Maozhou frontier and was captured by government troops, who released him after he pledged reform.

sentences.zh: 未幾，復糾諸寨入掠。

translations.literal: Before long he again rallied the stockades to raid.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he again rallied the stockades in raids.

sentences.zh: 帝命序班祁全往諭諸寨，擒多兒太至京，梟其首。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Court Usher Qi Quan to go and instruct the stockades; Du'ertai was seized and sent to the capital, where his head was displayed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Court Usher Qi Quan to instruct the stockades; Du'ertai was seized, sent to the capital, and executed.

sentences.zh: 十一年以寇深為僉都御史，提督松潘兵備。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Kou Shen was appointed Censor-in-Chief and charged with Songpan military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 Kou Shen was appointed Censor-in-Chief with charge of Songpan military affairs.

sentences.zh: 時松潘皆已向化，惟歪地骨鹿族二十寨不服，命督高廣、王杲等剿之。

translations.literal: At that time all Songpan tribes had submitted except the twenty stockades of the Waidigulu clan, who refused obedience; he was ordered to supervise Gao Guang, Wang Gao, and others in suppressing them.
translations.idiomatic: At that time all Songpan tribes had submitted except the twenty stockades of the Waidigulu clan; he was ordered to supervise Gao Guang, Wang Gao, and others in suppressing them.

sentences.zh: 設思曩日安撫司，以阿思觀為之使，隸松潘衛。

translations.literal: The Sinangri Pacification Commission was established, with Asiguan as commissioner, subordinate to the Songpan Guard.
translations.idiomatic: The Sinangri Pacification Commission was established with Asiguan as commissioner, subordinate to the Songpan Guard.

sentences.zh: 先是，阿思觀父端葛，洪武中歸順，給金牌撫番，至阿思觀又能招撫，故有是命。

translations.literal: Earlier, Asiguan's father Duange had submitted in the Hongwu reign and been given a gold tablet to pacify the tribes; Asiguan too could summon and pacify them, hence this appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Asiguan's father Duange had submitted in the Hongwu reign and received a gold tablet to pacify the tribes; Asiguan too proved able to summon and pacify them, hence this appointment.

sentences.zh: 景泰三年，鎮守松潘刑部左侍郎羅綺等奏：「雪兒卜寨賊首卓時芳等，煙崇寨賊首阿兒結等，累年糾合於安化關劫掠。

translations.literal: In the third year of the Jingtai reign Left Vice Minister of Justice Luo Qi and others, garrisoning Songpan, memorialized: "Zhuo Shifang, bandit chief of the Xue'erbu stockade, and A'erjie, bandit chief of the Yanchong stockade, have for years joined forces to plunder at Anhua Pass."
translations.idiomatic: In Jingtai year 3 Left Vice Minister of Justice Luo Qi and others, garrisoning Songpan, reported: "Zhuo Shifang of the Xue'erbu stockade and A'erjie of the Yanchong stockade have for years joined in raiding Anhua Pass."

sentences.zh: 臣會師抵其巢穴，斬首不計其數，生擒卓時芳、阿兒結等，梟斬於市。

translations.literal: "I combined forces and reached their lairs, taking heads beyond count; Zhuo Shifang, A'erjie, and others were captured alive and executed in the marketplace."
translations.idiomatic: "I combined forces and reached their lairs, taking countless heads; Zhuo Shifang, A'erjie, and others were captured alive and executed in the marketplace."

sentences.zh: 」七年，提督松潘羅綺復奏：「松潘土番王永習性兒獷，嘗殺其土官高茂林男婦五百余口，及故土官董敏子伯浩等二十余人。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Luo Qi, supervising Songpan, again memorialized: "The Songpan tribesman Wang Yong is by nature fierce; he once killed more than five hundred men and women of the native official Gao Maolin and more than twenty others including the former native official Dong Min's son Bohao."
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 Luo Qi, supervising Songpan, again reported: "The Songpan tribesman Wang Yong is fierce by nature; he once killed more than five hundred men and women of native official Gao Maolin and more than twenty others including the former native official Dong Min's son Bohao."

sentences.zh: 今又糾合番蠻，攻劫地方。

translations.literal: "Now he has again rallied tribal bandits to attack and plunder the region."
translations.idiomatic: "Now he has again rallied tribal raiders to attack and plunder the region."

sentences.zh: 臣與指揮周貴等統領官軍，直抵桑坪，已將永等誅滅，邊境肅清。

translations.literal: "I and Commander Zhou Gui and others led government troops straight to Sangping; Yong and his followers have already been exterminated and the border is quiet."
translations.idiomatic: "I and Commander Zhou Gui and others led government troops straight to Sangping; Yong and his followers have been exterminated and the border is quiet."

sentences.zh: 」降敕褒賞。

translations.literal: An edict of commendation and reward was issued.
translations.idiomatic: An edict of commendation and reward was issued.

sentences.zh: 天順五年，番眾入龍安、石泉等處，擾糧道。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of the Tianshun reign tribal forces entered Long'an, Shiquan, and other places and harassed the grain routes.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianshun year 5 tribal forces entered Long'an, Shiquan, and other places and harassed the grain routes.

sentences.zh: 六年敕松潘總兵許貴曰：「敘州蠻賊出沒為患，比松潘尤甚，其馳往會剿。

translations.literal: In the sixth year an edict to Commander-in-Chief Xu Gui of Songpan said: "The Yizhou tribal bandits appear and vanish as a worse plague than Songpan; ride at once to join the campaign there."
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 an edict to Songpan Commander-in-Chief Xu Gui said: "The Yizhou tribal rebels are a worse plague than Songpan; ride at once to join the campaign there."

sentences.zh: 」貴聞命，會兵敘州，追討昔乖件、莫洞、都夜三寨，分兵兩哨，克硬寨四十余，斬首一千一百余級。

translations.literal: On receiving the order, Gui combined forces at Yizhou and pursued the Xiguaijian, Modong, and Duye stockades, dividing his army in two columns and taking more than forty strong stockades, with more than eleven hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: On receiving the order, Gui combined forces at Yizhou and pursued the Xiguaijian, Modong, and Duye stockades in two columns, taking more than forty strong stockades and more than eleven hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 成化二年，鎮守太監閻禮奏：「松、茂、疊溪所轄白草壩等寨，番羌聚眾五百人，越龍州境剽掠。

translations.literal: In the second year of the Chenghua reign Garrison Eunuch Yan Li memorialized: "In the Baicao Dam and other stockades under Song, Mao, and Diexi, five hundred tribal Qiang have crossed the Longzhou border to plunder."
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua year 2 Garrison Eunuch Yan Li reported: "In the Baicao Dam and other stockades under Song, Mao, and Diexi, five hundred tribal Qiang have crossed the Longzhou border to plunder."

sentences.zh: 白草番者，唐吐蕃贊普遺種，上下凡十八寨。

translations.literal: The Baicao tribes are descendants of the Tang Tibetan emperor, eighteen stockades in all from top to bottom.
translations.idiomatic: The Baicao tribes are descendants of the Tang Tibetan emperor's line, eighteen stockades in all from top to bottom.

sentences.zh: 部曲素強，恃其險阻，往往剽奪為患。

translations.literal: Their followers have always been strong, and relying on their rugged terrain they often raid and become a scourge.
translations.idiomatic: Their clans have always been strong; relying on rugged terrain, they often raid and become a scourge.

sentences.zh: 」四年，禮復奏：「白草諸番擁眾寇安縣、石泉諸處，因各軍俱調征山都掌蠻，致指揮王璟備禦不謹。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Li again memorialized: "The Baicao tribes have mustered forces to raid An county, Shiquan, and other places; because all troops had been mobilized against the Shanduzhang barbarians, Commander Wang Jing's defense was negligent."
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 Li again reported: "The Baicao tribes have mustered forces to raid An county, Shiquan, and other places; because all troops had been mobilized against the Shanduzhang barbarians, Commander Wang Jing's defense was negligent."

sentences.zh: 命副總兵盧能剿之。

translations.literal: The Vice Commander-in-Chief Lu Neng was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Commander-in-Chief Lu Neng was ordered to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 能遣指揮閻斌巡邊至廟子溝，番賊三百突至，殺傷相當。

translations.literal: Neng sent Commander Yan Bin to patrol the border; at Miaozigou three hundred tribal bandits suddenly attacked, and casualties were about equal on both sides.
translations.idiomatic: Neng sent Commander Yan Bin to patrol the border; at Miaozigou three hundred tribal raiders suddenly attacked, with roughly equal casualties on both sides.

sentences.zh: 斌以失機逮治。

translations.literal: Bin was arrested and punished for losing the opportunity.
translations.idiomatic: Bin was arrested and punished for missing his chance.

sentences.zh: 九年，巡撫夏塤奏：「黑虎寨賊首夜合等劫攻關堡，左參將宰用、兵備副使沈琮督兵馳詣松溪堡敗之，斬獲夜合等三十六級。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Grand Coordinator Xia Kan memorialized: "Yehe and other bandit chiefs of the Heihu stockade raided passes and forts; Left Regional Commander Zai Yong and Vice Commissioner for Military Affairs Shen Cong led troops in haste to Songxi Fort and defeated them, taking thirty-six heads including Yehe."
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 Grand Coordinator Xia Kan reported: "Yehe and other rebel chiefs of the Heihu stockade raided passes and forts; Left Regional Commander Zai Yong and Vice Commissioner Shen Cong led troops to Songxi Fort and defeated them, taking thirty-six heads including Yehe."

sentences.zh: 」松潘指揮僉事堯彧奏：「臣與兵備沈琮分剿白馬路水土、茹兒等番寨，大克之。

translations.literal: Songpan Regional Commander Yao Yu memorialized: "I and Military Affairs Commissioner Shen Cong divided forces to suppress the Baimalu Shuiguo, Ru'er, and other tribal stockades and achieved a great victory."
translations.idiomatic: Songpan Regional Commander Yao Yu reported: "I and Military Affairs Commissioner Shen Cong divided forces to suppress the Baimalu Shuiguo, Ru'er, and other tribal stockades and won a great victory."

sentences.zh: 弘治二年，松潘番寇殺傷平夷堡官軍，命逮指揮以下各官治之。

translations.literal: In the second year of the Hongzhi reign Songpan tribal bandits killed and wounded troops at Pingyi Fort; an order was issued to arrest and punish every officer from commander downward.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongzhi year 2 Songpan tribal raiders killed and wounded troops at Pingyi Fort; an order was issued to arrest and punish every officer from commander downward.

sentences.zh: 三年免思曩日安撫等十六族明年朝覲，以守臣言其地方災傷也。

translations.literal: In the third year the sixteen tribes including Sinangri were exempted from court audience the following year, because frontier officials reported disaster and injury in their territories.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 the sixteen tribes including Sinangri were exempted from the next year's court audience because frontier officials reported disaster in their territories.

sentences.zh: 七年，松潘空心寨番賊犯邊，都指揮僉事李鎬敗之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year tribal bandits of the Kongxin stockade violated the border; Regional Commander Li Hao defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 tribal raiders of the Kongxin stockade violated the border; Regional Commander Li Hao defeated them.

sentences.zh: 十三年，番賊入犯松潘壩州坡抵關，勢益獗。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year tribal bandits invaded and attacked Podi Pass at Songpan Bazhou; their force grew fiercer.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 tribal raiders invaded and attacked Podi Pass at Songpan Bazhou; their force grew fiercer.

sentences.zh: 」命逮指揮湯綱等，而敕巡撫張瓚調漢、土官兵五萬，由東南二路分剿，破白羊嶺、鵝飲溪等三十一寨，斬四百余級。

translations.literal: " An order was issued to arrest Commander Tang Gang and others, and an edict charged Grand Coordinator Zhang Zan to mobilize fifty thousand Han and native troops, divide them on southeast routes, and suppress them; they broke thirty-one stockades including Baiyang Ridge and E'yin Stream, taking more than four hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: " An order was issued to arrest Commander Tang Gang and others, and Grand Coordinator Zhang Zan was charged to mobilize fifty thousand Han and native troops on two southeast routes; they broke thirty-one stockades including Baiyang Ridge and E'yin Stream, taking more than four hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 商巴等二十六族皆納款。

translations.literal: Twenty-six tribes including Shangba all tendered submission.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-six tribes including Shangba all tendered submission.

sentences.zh: 十四年復攻黃頭、青水諸寨，前後殺獲男婦七百余人，赭其碉房九百，墜崖死者不可勝計，諸番稍靖。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year they again attacked the Huangtou, Qingshui, and other stockades; before and after, more than seven hundred men and women were killed or captured, nine hundred blockhouses were reddened with lime, and those who fell from cliffs died beyond counting; the tribes grew somewhat quiet.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14 they again attacked the Huangtou, Qingshui, and other stockades; in all more than seven hundred men and women were killed or captured, nine hundred blockhouses were marked with lime, and cliff deaths were beyond count; the tribes grew somewhat quiet.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖五年命都督僉事何卿鎮守松潘。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of the Jiajing reign Regional Commander He Qing was ordered to garrison Songpan.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing year 5 Regional Commander He Qing was ordered to garrison Songpan.

sentences.zh: 時黑虎五寨及烏都、鵓鴿諸番叛，卿次第平之，降者日至。

translations.literal: At that time the five Heihu stockades and the Wudu, Boge, and other tribes rebelled; Qing pacified them in sequence, and submitters arrived daily.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the five Heihu stockades and the Wudu, Boge, and other tribes rebelled; Qing pacified them one after another, and submitters arrived daily.

sentences.zh: 卿有威望，在鎮十七年，松潘以寧。

translations.literal: Qing had prestige; during seventeen years in command Songpan was at peace.
translations.idiomatic: Qing enjoyed great prestige; during seventeen years in command Songpan remained at peace.

sentences.zh: 二十三年以北警召卿入衛，繼之者李爵、高岡鳳，未幾皆為巡撫劾罷。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, because of northern alarms, Qing was summoned to guard the capital; his successors Li Jue and Gao Gangfeng were soon impeached and removed by the grand coordinator.
translations.idiomatic: In year 23, because of northern alarms, Qing was summoned to guard the capital; his successors Li Jue and Gao Gangfeng were soon impeached and removed by the grand coordinator.

sentences.zh: 二十六年復命卿往鎮。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year Qing was again ordered to take command.
translations.idiomatic: In year 26 Qing was again ordered to take command.

sentences.zh: 時白草番亂，卿會巡撫張時徹討擒渠惡數人，俘斬九百七十余級，克營寨四十七，毀碉房四千八百，獲馬牛器械儲積無算。

translations.literal: At that time the Baicao tribes rebelled; Qing joined Grand Coordinator Zhang Shiche in a campaign that captured several ringleaders, taking more than nine hundred seventy heads, storming forty-seven camps, destroying four thousand eight hundred blockhouses, and seizing horses, cattle, weapons, and stores beyond reckoning.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Baicao tribes rebelled; Qing joined Grand Coordinator Zhang Shiche in a campaign that captured several ringleaders, taking more than nine hundred seventy heads, storming forty-seven camps, destroying four thousand eight hundred blockhouses, and seizing horses, cattle, weapons, and stores beyond reckoning.

sentences.zh: 終嘉靖世，松潘鎮號得人，邊境安堵焉。

translations.literal: Through the entire Jiajing reign Songpan's garrison had capable men, and the border remained secure.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the Jiajing reign Songpan's garrison had capable commanders, and the border remained secure.

sentences.zh: 初，龍州薛文勝於洪武六年來降，命仍知龍州。

translations.literal: Earlier, Xue Wensheng of Longzhou had come to submit in the sixth year of Hongwu and was ordered to remain prefect of Longzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Xue Wensheng of Longzhou had submitted in Hongwu year 6 and was ordered to remain prefect of Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 既置松潘安撫司，命文勝為安撫使。

translations.literal: When the Songpan Pacification Commission was established, Wensheng was made pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When the Songpan Pacification Commission was established, Wensheng was made pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 既置松州衛，仍以松潘為龍州。

translations.literal: When the Songzhou Guard was established, Songpan was again made Longzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the Songzhou Guard was established, the region was again designated Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 宣德七年升龍州為宣撫司，以土知州薛忠義為宣撫使。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Xuande Longzhou was promoted to a Pacification-General Commission, with the native prefect Xue Zhongyi as pacification-general.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande year 7 Longzhou was promoted to a Pacification-General Commission, with native prefect Xue Zhongyi as pacification-general.

sentences.zh: 龍州者，漢陰平道也。

translations.literal: Longzhou was the Yinping route of Han.
translations.idiomatic: Longzhou was the Yinping route of Han times.

sentences.zh: 宋景定間，臨邛進士薛嚴來守是州，捍衛有功，得世襲。

translations.literal: In the Jingding reign of Song, the Linqiong graduate Xue Yan came to govern this prefecture; for defending it with merit he obtained hereditary tenure.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jingding reign of Song, the Linqiong graduate Xue Yan came to govern this prefecture; for meritorious defense he obtained hereditary tenure.

sentences.zh: 自文勝歸附，其部長李仁廣、王祥皆輸糧餉有功，亦得世襲。

translations.literal: From the time Wensheng submitted, his subordinate chiefs Li Renguang and Wang Xiang, who had both contributed grain supplies with merit, also obtained hereditary posts.
translations.idiomatic: From the time Wensheng submitted, his subordinate chiefs Li Renguang and Wang Xiang, who had both contributed grain supplies with merit, also obtained hereditary posts.

sentences.zh: 及宣德中，以征松潘功，升州為宣撫使，仁廣為副使，祥為僉事，各統兵五百世守白馬、白草、木瓜番地。

translations.literal: In the Xuande period, for merit in the Songpan campaign the prefecture was raised to a pacification-general commission; Renguang became deputy commissioner and Xiang assistant commissioner, each commanding five hundred men in perpetual guard of the Baima, Baicao, and Mugua tribal lands.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xuande period, for merit in the Songpan campaign the prefecture was raised to a pacification-general commission; Renguang became deputy commissioner and Xiang assistant commissioner, each commanding five hundred men in perpetual guard of the Baima, Baicao, and Mugua tribal lands.

sentences.zh: 至嘉靖四十四年，宣撫薛兆乾與副使李蕃相仇訐，兆乾率眾圍執蕃父子，毆殺之。

translations.literal: By the forty-fourth year of Jiajing Pacification-General Xue Zhaogan and Deputy Commissioner Li Fan were locked in mutual accusations; Zhaogan led his followers to surround and seize Fan and his sons and beat them to death.
translations.idiomatic: By Jiajing year 44 Pacification-General Xue Zhaogan and Deputy Commissioner Li Fan were locked in mutual accusations; Zhaogan led his followers to surround and seize Fan and his sons and beat them to death.

sentences.zh: 撫按檄兵備僉事趙教勘其事。

translations.literal: The grand coordinator and surveillance commissioner ordered Military Affairs Commissioner Zhao Jiao to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: The grand coordinator and surveillance commissioner ordered Military Affairs Commissioner Zhao Jiao to investigate.

sentences.zh: 兆乾懼，與母陳氏及諸左右糾白草番眾數千人，分據各關隘拒命，絕松潘餉道。

translations.literal: Zhaogan feared the outcome; with his mother Lady Chen and his close followers he rallied several thousand Baicao tribesmen, seized the various passes, and defied orders, cutting off Songpan's supply route.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaogan feared the outcome; with his mother Lady Chen and his close followers he rallied several thousand Baicao tribesmen, seized the various passes, defied orders, and cut off Songpan's supply route.

sentences.zh: 脅僉事王華，不從，屠其家。

translations.literal: He threatened Assistant Commissioner Wang Hua; when Hua refused, Zhaogan slaughtered his household.
translations.idiomatic: He threatened Assistant Commissioner Wang Hua; when Hua refused, Zhaogan slaughtered his household.

sentences.zh: 居民被焚掠者無算。

translations.literal: Countless residents were burned and plundered.
translations.idiomatic: Countless residents were burned and plundered.

sentences.zh: 是年春，與官軍戰，不利，求救於上下十八族番蠻，皆不應。

translations.literal: That spring he fought government troops without success and asked the eighteen tribes above and below for help; none responded.
translations.idiomatic: That spring he fought government troops without success and asked the eighteen tribes above and below for help; none responded.

sentences.zh: 兆乾率其家屬奔至石壩，官軍追及之，就擒。

translations.literal: Zhaogan fled with his family to Shiba; government troops overtook him there and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaogan fled with his family to Shiba; government troops overtook him there and captured him.

sentences.zh: 四十五年，兆乾伏誅，籍其家，母及其黨二十二人皆以同謀論斬，余黨悉平。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year Zhaogan was executed; his property was confiscated, and his mother and twenty-two accomplices were sentenced to death for conspiracy; the remaining followers were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In year 45 Zhaogan was executed; his property was confiscated, and his mother and twenty-two accomplices were sentenced to death for conspiracy; the remaining followers were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 遂改龍州宣撫司為龍安府，設立流官如馬湖，而割保寧之江油、成都之石泉二縣分隸之。

translations.literal: The Longzhou Pacification-General Commission was then changed to Long'an Prefecture, with regular officials appointed as at Mahu, while Jiangyou county of Baoning and Shiquan county of Chengdu were detached and placed under it.
translations.idiomatic: The Longzhou Pacification-General Commission was then changed to Long'an Prefecture, with regular officials appointed as at Mahu, while Jiangyou county of Baoning and Shiquan county of Chengdu were detached and placed under it.

sentences.zh: 萬歷八年，雪山國師喇嘛等四十八寨，勾北邊部落為寇，圍漳臘，守備張良賢破之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Wanli the lama of the forty-eight stockades of Xueshan and other Snow Mountain states joined northern tribes in raiding and besieged Zhangla; Garrison Defender Zhang Liangxian defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli year 8 the lama of the forty-eight Snow Mountain stockades joined northern tribes in raiding and besieged Zhangla; Garrison Defender Zhang Liangxian defeated them.

sentences.zh: 犯鎮虜，百戶杜世仁力戰，城得全，世仁死焉。

translations.literal: They then attacked Zhenlu; Centurion Du Shiren fought fiercely, the city was preserved, and Shiren died in the battle.
translations.idiomatic: They then attacked Zhenlu; Centurion Du Shiren fought fiercely, the city was preserved, and Shiren died in the battle.

sentences.zh: 又犯制臺，良賢復擊之，追至思答弄，連戰大破之，火落赤之侄小王子死焉。

translations.literal: They attacked again at Zhitan; Liangxian struck them again, pursued them to Sidalong, and won successive great victories; the Little Prince, nephew of Huoluochi, was killed.
translations.idiomatic: They attacked again at Zhitan; Liangxian struck them again, pursued them to Sidalong, and won successive great victories; the Little Prince, nephew of Huoluochi, was killed.

sentences.zh: 十九年，巡按李化龍言：「松潘為四川屏蔽，疊、茂為松潘咽喉。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year Touring Censor Li Hualong said: "Songpan is the shield of Sichuan; Die and Mao are the throat of Songpan."
translations.idiomatic: In year 19 Touring Censor Li Hualong said: "Songpan is the shield of Sichuan; Die and Mao are the throat of Songpan."

sentences.zh: 番戎作梗，松潘力不能支，宜移四川總兵於松潘以備防禦。

translations.literal: "When the tribes cause trouble Songpan cannot bear the strain alone; the Sichuan commander-in-chief should be moved to Songpan for defense."
translations.idiomatic: "When the tribes cause trouble Songpan cannot bear the strain alone; the Sichuan commander-in-chief should be moved to Songpan for defense."

sentences.zh: 」是時疊、茂諸番眾糾結為亂，鎮巡官率兵剿之，俘馘八百余級，番寇亦斬其部長黑卜、白什等，獻功贖罪。

translations.literal: At that time the tribes of Die, Mao, and other regions had joined in rebellion; the frontier officials led troops to suppress them, taking more than eight hundred captives and heads; the tribal bandits also executed their chiefs Heibu and Baishi and presented merit to redeem their guilt.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the tribes of Die, Mao, and other regions had joined in rebellion; frontier officials led troops to suppress them, taking more than eight hundred captives and heads; the tribal raiders also executed their chiefs Heibu and Baishi and presented merit to redeem their guilt.

sentences.zh: 而松坪諸惡屯據大雪山頂，諸將卒搜討，亦有斬獲。

translations.literal: The evildoers of Songping still held the summit of Great Snow Mountain; generals and soldiers searched them out and also took heads and captives.
translations.idiomatic: The evildoers of Songping still held the summit of Great Snow Mountain; generals and soldiers searched them out and also took heads and captives.

sentences.zh: 以捷聞，遂設平武縣於龍安府。

translations.literal: When victory was reported, Pingwu county was established in Long'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When victory was reported, Pingwu county was established in Long'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 松潘以孤城介絕域，寄一線饋運路於龍州，制守為難。

translations.literal: Songpan, a lone city amid remote lands, depended on a single thread of supply through Longzhou; holding and governing it was difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Songpan, a lone city amid remote lands, depended on a single thread of supply through Longzhou; holding and governing it was difficult.

sentences.zh: 洪武時欲棄者數，以形勝扼險，不可罷，乃內修屯務，外輯羌戎，因俗拊循，擇人為理，番眾相安者垂四十余年。

translations.literal: In the Hongwu reign the court several times wished to abandon it, but because its terrain commanded the passes it could not be given up; garrison farming was developed within and the Qiang pacified without, the people governed according to custom and able men chosen to rule, and the tribes lived in peace for nearly forty years.
translations.idiomatic: In the Hongwu reign the court several times wished to abandon it, but because its terrain commanded the passes it could not be given up; garrison farming was developed within and the Qiang pacified without, able men were chosen to govern according to custom, and the tribes lived in peace for nearly forty years.

sentences.zh: 及宣德初，調兵啟釁，致動幹戈，自是置鎮建牙，宿重兵以資彈壓，亦時服時叛。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xuande mobilization of troops provoked conflict and set arms in motion; thereafter a garrison was established with heavy troops for intimidation, and the tribes submitted at times and rebelled at times.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xuande mobilization of troops provoked conflict and set arms in motion; thereafter a garrison was established with heavy troops for intimidation, and the tribes submitted at times and rebelled at times.

sentences.zh: 自漳臘以北即為大荒，斯籌邊者之所亟圖也。

translations.literal: North of Zhangla lay the great wilderness—what frontier planners must urgently consider.
translations.idiomatic: North of Zhangla lay the great wilderness—what frontier planners must urgently consider.

sentences.zh: 天全六番招討司

translations.literal: Tianquan Liufan Pacification Commissioner
translations.idiomatic: Tianquan Liufan Pacification Commissioner

sentences.zh: 天全，古氐羌地。

translations.literal: Tianquan was ancient Di and Qiang territory.
translations.idiomatic: Tianquan was ancient Di and Qiang territory.

sentences.zh: 五代孟蜀時，置碉門、黎、雅、長河西、魚通、寧遠六軍安撫司。

translations.literal: In the Five Dynasties under Later Shu, the six pacification commands of Diaomen, Li, Ya, Changxihe, Yutong, and Ningyuan were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the Five Dynasties under Later Shu, the six pacification commands of Diaomen, Li, Ya, Changxihe, Yutong, and Ningyuan were established.

sentences.zh: 宋因之，隸雅州。

translations.literal: The Song continued them, subordinate to Yazhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Song continued them, subordinate to Yazhou.

sentences.zh: 元置六安撫司，屬土番等處宣慰司，後改六番招討，又分置天全招討司。

translations.literal: The Yuan established the six pacification commands, subordinate to the Xuanwei Commission of the Tribal Regions and elsewhere; later they were changed to the Liufan Pacification Commission, and the Tianquan Pacification Commission was separately established.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan established the six pacification commands, subordinate to the Xuanwei Commission of the Tribal Regions and elsewhere; later they were changed to the Liufan Pacification Commission, and the Tianquan Pacification Commission was separately established.

sentences.zh: 明初並為天全六番招討司，隸四川都司。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Ming they were combined as the Tianquan Liufan Pacification Commissioner, subordinate to the Sichuan regional command.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Ming they were combined as the Tianquan Liufan Pacification Commissioner, subordinate to the Sichuan regional command.

sentences.zh: 洪武六年，天全六番招討使高英遣子敬嚴等來朝，貢方物。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Hongwu the Tianquan Liufan Pacification Commissioner Gao Ying sent his son Jingyan and others to court with local products as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 6 the Tianquan Liufan Pacification Commissioner Gao Ying sent his son Jingyan and others to court with local products as tribute.

sentences.zh: 帝賜以文綺龍衣。

translations.literal: The emperor granted them brocade dragon robes.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor granted them brocade dragon robes.

sentences.zh: 以英為正招討，楊藏卜為副招討，秩從五品，每三歲入貢，賜予甚厚。

translations.literal: Ying was made chief pacification commissioner and Yang Cangbu deputy commissioner, both of the fifth rank; every three years they presented tribute and received very generous rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Ying was made chief pacification commissioner and Yang Cangbu deputy commissioner, both of the fifth rank; every three years they presented tribute and received very generous rewards.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，楊藏卜來朝，言茶戶向與西番貿易，歲收其課。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year Yang Cangbu came to court and said that tea households had formerly traded with the western tribes and the tax was collected yearly.
translations.idiomatic: In year 21 Yang Cangbu came to court and said that tea households had formerly traded with the western tribes and the tax was collected yearly.

sentences.zh: 近在官收買，額遂虧，乞從民便，許之。

translations.literal: Lately the government had purchased tea directly, so the quota fell short; he asked that the people be allowed their convenience, and permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Lately the government had purchased tea directly, so the quota fell short; he asked that the people be allowed their convenience, and permission was granted.

sentences.zh: 先是，高敬嚴襲招討使，偕楊藏卜奏請簡土民為兵，以守邊境，詔許之。

translations.literal: Earlier, Gao Jingyan had succeeded as pacification commissioner and, together with Yang Cangbu, memorialized asking to select native people as soldiers to guard the border; an edict permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Gao Jingyan had succeeded as pacification commissioner and, together with Yang Cangbu, memorialized asking to select native people as soldiers to guard the border; an edict permitted it.

sentences.zh: 敬嚴等遂招選土民，教以戰陣，得馬步卒千余人。

translations.literal: Jingyan and the others then recruited native people, trained them in battle formation, and obtained more than a thousand horse and foot soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Jingyan and the others then recruited native people, trained them in battle formation, and obtained more than a thousand horse and foot soldiers.

sentences.zh: 至是藏卜來朝，奏其事，詔更天全六番招討司為武職，令戍守邊界，控制西番。

translations.literal: When Cangbu came to court on this occasion he memorialized the matter; an edict changed the Tianquan Liufan Pacification Commissioner to a military post, ordering garrison of the border and control of the western tribes.
translations.idiomatic: When Cangbu came to court on this occasion he memorialized the matter; an edict changed the Tianquan Liufan Pacification Commissioner to a military post, ordering garrison of the border and control of the western tribes.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，帝諭左都督徐增壽曰：「曩因碉門拒長河西口，道路險隘，以致往來跋涉艱難，市馬數少。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year the emperor instructed Left Regional Commander Xu Zengshou: "Formerly, because Diaomen blocked the Changxihe mouth, the road was perilous and travel arduous, so few horses came to market."
translations.idiomatic: In year 31 the emperor instructed Left Regional Commander Xu Zengshou: "Formerly, because Diaomen blocked the Changxihe mouth, the road was perilous and travel arduous, so few horses came to market."

sentences.zh: 今聞有路自碉門出枯木任場徑抵長河西口，通雜道長官司，道路平坦，往來徑直，可即檄所司開拓，以便往來。」

translations.literal: "Now I hear there is a route from Diaomen through the Kumuren field straight to the Changxihe mouth, reaching the Zadao chieftaincy; the road is level and travel direct. Order the relevant offices at once to open and improve it for convenience of passage."
translations.idiomatic: "Now I hear there is a route from Diaomen through the Kumuren field straight to the Changxihe mouth, reaching the Zadao chieftaincy; the road is level and travel direct. Order the relevant offices at once to open and improve it for convenience of passage."

sentences.zh: 永樂二年，高敬讓來朝，並賀立皇太子，且遣其子虎入國子學，賜虎衣衾等物。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongle Gao Jingrang came to court, congratulated the establishment of the heir apparent, and sent his son Hu to enter the Imperial College; Hu was granted clothing, bedding, and other goods.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle year 2 Gao Jingrang came to court, congratulated the establishment of the heir apparent, and sent his son Hu to enter the Imperial College; Hu was granted clothing, bedding, and other goods.

sentences.zh: 十年，敬讓遣子虎貢馬。

translations.literal: In the tenth year Jingrang sent his son Hu to present horses as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 Jingrang sent his son Hu to present horses as tribute.

sentences.zh: 初，虎入國學讀書，以丁母憂去，至是服闋還監，皇太子命禮部賜予如例。

translations.literal: At first Hu had entered the college to study; he left on mourning for his mother, and when his mourning ended he returned to the college; the heir apparent ordered the Ministry of Rites to grant rewards according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: At first Hu had entered the college to study; he left on mourning for his mother, and when his mourning ended he returned to the college; the heir apparent ordered the Ministry of Rites to grant rewards according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 宣德五年，六番招討司奏：「舊額歲辦烏茶五萬斤，二年一次，運付碉門茶馬司易馬。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xuande the Liufan Pacification Commissioner memorialized: "The old quota required fifty thousand jin of brick tea every two years, delivered to the Diaomen Tea-and-Horse Office to exchange for horses."
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande year 5 the Liufan Pacification Commissioner memorialized: "The old quota required fifty thousand jin of brick tea every two years, delivered to the Diaomen Tea-and-Horse Office to exchange for horses."

sentences.zh: 今戶部令再辦芽茶二千二百斤，山深地瘠，艱於采辦，乞減其數。

translations.literal: "Now the Ministry of Revenue orders an additional two thousand two hundred jin of bud tea; the mountains are deep and the land poor, making collection difficult; we ask that the amount be reduced."
translations.idiomatic: "Now the Ministry of Revenue orders an additional two thousand two hundred jin of bud tea; the mountains are deep and the land poor, making collection difficult; we ask that the amount be reduced."

sentences.zh: 」帝令免烏茶只辦芽茶。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered brick tea exempted and only bud tea supplied.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered brick tea exempted and only bud tea supplied.

sentences.zh: 十年命高鳳署天全六番招討司事。

translations.literal: In the tenth year Gao Feng was ordered to administer the affairs of the Tianquan Liufan Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 Gao Feng was ordered to administer the affairs of the Tianquan Liufan Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 先是，敬讓以罪下獄死。

translations.literal: Earlier Jingrang had been imprisoned and died for a crime.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Jingrang had been imprisoned and died for a crime.

sentences.zh: 至是，其子鳳乞襲父職。

translations.literal: Now his son Feng asked to succeed his father's post.
translations.idiomatic: Now his son Feng asked to succeed his father's post.

sentences.zh: 帝念其祖有撫綏功，命暫理招討事。

translations.literal: The emperor, mindful of his grandfather's merit in pacifying the tribes, ordered him temporarily to manage pacification affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, mindful of his grandfather's merit in pacifying the tribes, ordered him temporarily to manage pacification affairs.

sentences.zh: 正統四年命鳳襲。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhengtong Feng was ordered to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong year 4 Feng was ordered to succeed.

sentences.zh: 正德十五年，招討高文林父子稱兵亂，副招討楊世仁亦助惡。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Zhengde Pacification Commissioner Gao Wenlin and his son raised troops in rebellion, and Deputy Commissioner Yang Shiren also aided the evildoers.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengde year 15 Pacification Commissioner Gao Wenlin and his son raised troops in rebellion, and Deputy Commissioner Yang Shiren also aided the evildoers.

sentences.zh: 命四川撫按官討之。

translations.literal: The Sichuan grand coordinator and surveillance commissioner were ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: The Sichuan grand coordinator and surveillance commissioner were ordered to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 初，文林等與蘆山縣民爭田構釁，知縣處置失宜，致叛亂。

translations.literal: At first Wenlin and the others had quarreled with the people of Lushan county over fields and provoked conflict; the magistrate's handling was improper and rebellion followed.
translations.idiomatic: At first Wenlin and the others had quarreled with the people of Lushan county over fields and provoked conflict; the magistrate's handling was improper and rebellion followed.

sentences.zh: 逾年，討斬文林，擒其子繼恩，擇其宗人承襲。

translations.literal: After more than a year Wenlin was executed in the campaign and his son Jien was captured; a clansman was chosen to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year Wenlin was executed in the campaign and his son Jien was captured; a clansman was chosen to succeed.

sentences.zh: 初，天全招討司治碉門城，元之碉門安撫司也，在雅州境。

translations.literal: Earlier the Tianquan Pacification Commissioner had governed at Diaomen city, the Yuan Diaomen Pacification Commission, within Yazhou territory.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Tianquan Pacification Commissioner had governed at Diaomen city, the Yuan Diaomen Pacification Commission, within Yazhou territory.

sentences.zh: 明初，宣慰余思聰、王德貴歸附，始降司為州，設雅州千戶所，而設碉門百戶，近天全六番之界。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Ming the xuanwei commissioners Yu Sicong and Wang Degui submitted; the commission was first reduced to a prefecture and the Yazhou Guard established, while a Diaomen centurioncy was set near the border of the Tianquan Liufan.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Ming the xuanwei commissioners Yu Sicong and Wang Degui submitted; the commission was first reduced to a prefecture and the Yazhou Guard established, while a Diaomen centurioncy was set near the border of the Tianquan Liufan.

sentences.zh: 又置茶課司以平互市。

translations.literal: A Tea Tax Office was also established to regulate mutual trade.
translations.idiomatic: A Tea Tax Office was also established to regulate mutual trade.

sentences.zh: 蓋其地為南詔咽喉，三十六番朝貢出入之路。

translations.literal: That region was the throat of Nanzhao and the route by which the thirty-six tribes entered court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That region was the throat of Nanzhao and the route by which the thirty-six tribes entered court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 三十六番者，皆西南諸部落，洪武初，先後至京，授職賜印。

translations.literal: The thirty-six tribes were all southwestern tribal peoples who, at the beginning of Hongwu, came in succession to the capital and received offices and seals.
translations.idiomatic: The thirty-six tribes were all southwestern tribal peoples who, at the beginning of Hongwu, came in succession to the capital and received offices and seals.

sentences.zh: 立都指揮使二：曰烏斯藏，曰朵甘。

translations.literal: Two regional commands were established: Wusizang and Duogan.
translations.idiomatic: Two regional commands were established: Wusizang and Duogan.

sentences.zh: 為宣慰司者三：曰朵甘，曰董卜韓胡，曰長河西魚通寧遠。

translations.literal: Three xuanwei commissions: Duogan, Dongbohanhu, and Changxihe Yutong Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Three xuanwei commissions: Duogan, Dongbohanhu, and Changxihe Yutong Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 為招討司者六，為萬戶府者四，為千戶所者十七，是為三十六種。

translations.literal: Six pacification commissions, four wanhu offices, and seventeen qianhu offices—these were the thirty-six kinds.
translations.idiomatic: Six pacification commissions, four wanhu offices, and seventeen qianhu offices—these were the thirty-six kinds.

sentences.zh: 或三年，或五年一朝貢，其道皆由雅州入，詳《西番傳》。

translations.literal: Some presented tribute every three years, some every five; all routes entered through Yazhou, as detailed in the "Western Tribes Biography."
translations.idiomatic: Some presented tribute every three years, some every five; all routes entered through Yazhou, as detailed in the "Western Tribes Biography."

sentences.zh: 黎州，漢沈黎郡地。

translations.literal: Lizhou was the territory of the Shenli commandery of Han.
translations.idiomatic: Lizhou was the territory of the Shenli commandery of Han.

sentences.zh: 《史記》稱越巂以東北，君長以十數，筰都最大。

translations.literal: The "Records of the Historian" says that northeast of Yuexi there were several dozen chieftains, of whom Zuodu was the greatest.
translations.idiomatic: The "Records of the Historian" says that northeast of Yuexi there were several dozen chieftains, of whom Zuodu was the greatest.

sentences.zh: 自唐蒙通夜郎，邛、筰之君請為內臣，因置筰都縣，復曰旄牛縣。

translations.literal: After Tang Meng opened the route to Yelang, the lords of Qiong and Zuodu asked to become inner subjects, and the Zuodu county was established, later renamed Maoniu county.
translations.idiomatic: After Tang Meng opened the route to Yelang, the lords of Qiong and Zuodu asked to become inner subjects, and the Zuodu county was established, later renamed Maoniu county.

sentences.zh: 元鼎中，以為沈黎郡。

translations.literal: In the Yuanding period it became the Shenli commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuanding period it became the Shenli commandery.

sentences.zh: 唐割雅、巂二州置黎州。

translations.literal: In Tang, Ya and Xi prefectures were split off to establish Lizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Tang, Ya and Xi prefectures were split off to establish Lizhou.

sentences.zh: 天寶初，改為洪源郡，尋改漢源。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianbao it was changed to Hongyuan commandery, then soon renamed Hanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianbao it was changed to Hongyuan commandery, then soon renamed Hanyuan.

sentences.zh: 宋屬成都路。

translations.literal: Under Song it belonged to the Chengdu circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Under Song it belonged to the Chengdu circuit.

sentences.zh: 元屬土番等處宣慰司。

translations.literal: Under Yuan it belonged to the Xuanwei Commission of the Tribal Regions and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yuan it belonged to the Xuanwei Commission of the Tribal Regions and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 洪武八年省漢源縣，置黎州長官司，以芍德為長官。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Hongwu Hanyuan county was abolished and the Lizhou chieftaincy established, with Shaode as chieftain.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 8 Hanyuan county was abolished and the Lizhou chieftaincy established, with Shaode as chieftain.

sentences.zh: 德，雲南人，馬姓。

translations.literal: Shaode was a Yunnan man of the Ma surname.
translations.idiomatic: Shaode was a Yunnan man of the Ma surname.

sentences.zh: 祖仕元，世襲邛部州六番招討使。

translations.literal: His ancestors had served the Yuan and inherited the post of Lizhou Liufan Pacification Commissioner of the Qiongbu.
translations.idiomatic: His ancestors had served the Yuan and inherited the post of Lizhou Liufan Pacification Commissioner of the Qiongbu.

sentences.zh: 明氏據蜀，德兄安復為黎州招討使。

translations.literal: When the Ming held Shu, Shaode's elder brother Anfu became Lizhou pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When the Ming held Shu, Shaode's elder brother Anfu became Lizhou pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 明氏亡，蠻民潰散，德奉母還居邛部。

translations.literal: When the Ming fell, the barbarian peoples scattered; Shaode brought his mother back to dwell at Qiongbu.
translations.idiomatic: When the Ming fell, the barbarian peoples scattered; Shaode brought his mother back to dwell at Qiongbu.

sentences.zh: 至是，四川布政司招之，德遂來朝貢馬，請置長官司。

translations.literal: At this time the Sichuan Provincial Administration Commission summoned him; Shaode came to court with horses and asked that a chieftaincy be established.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the Sichuan Provincial Administration Commission summoned him; Shaode came to court with horses and asked that a chieftaincy be established.

sentences.zh: 詔以德為黎州長官，賜印及衣服綺帛，十一年升為黎州安撫司，即以德為使。

translations.literal: An edict made Shaode Lizhou chieftain, granting a seal, clothing, and brocade; in the eleventh year it was raised to the Lizhou Pacification Commission with Shaode as commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Shaode Lizhou chieftain, granting a seal, clothing, and brocade; in year 11 it was raised to the Lizhou Pacification Commission with Shaode as commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十四年，德遣使貢馬。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year Shaode sent envoys to present horses as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14 Shaode sent envoys to present horses as tribute.

sentences.zh: 詔賜德鈔五十四錠、文綺七疋。

translations.literal: An edict granted Shaode fifty-four ingots of paper money and seven lengths of brocade.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted Shaode fifty-four ingots of paper money and seven lengths of brocade.

sentences.zh: 自是，三年一入貢。

translations.literal: From then on tribute was presented every three years.
translations.idiomatic: From then on tribute was presented every three years.

sentences.zh: 弘治十四年命黎州安撫隸四川都司。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Hongzhi the Lizhou Pacification Commission was placed under the Sichuan regional command.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongzhi year 14 the Lizhou Pacification Commission was placed under the Sichuan regional command.

sentences.zh: 萬歷十九年，安撫馬祥無後，妻瞿氏掌司事，取瞿姓子撫之，將有他誌。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Wanli Pacification Commissioner Ma Xiang had no heir; his wife Lady Qu governed the commission, took a Qu clansman to rear, and was about to change the succession.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli year 19 Pacification Commissioner Ma Xiang had no heir; his wife Lady Qu governed the commission, took a Qu clansman to rear, and was about to change the succession.

sentences.zh: 祥侄上舍居松坪者，遂興兵攻城，奪印，番眾乘機剽掠。

translations.literal: Xiang's nephew, a senior native officer dwelling at Songping, then raised troops to attack the city, seized the seal, and the tribes took the opportunity to plunder.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang's nephew, a senior native officer dwelling at Songping, then raised troops to attack the city, seized the seal, and the tribes took the opportunity to plunder.

sentences.zh: 時參將吳文傑方有征東之役，移師剿平之。

translations.literal: At that time Regional Commander Wu Wenjie was on an eastern campaign; he shifted his army and suppressed the disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Regional Commander Wu Wenjie was on an eastern campaign; he shifted his army and suppressed the disturbance.

sentences.zh: 二十四年降黎州安撫司為千戶所，立所治於司南三十里大田山壩。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year the Lizhou Pacification Commission was reduced to a qianhu office, with the office seat established thirty li south of the commission at Datian mountain dam.
translations.idiomatic: In year 24 the Lizhou Pacification Commission was reduced to a qianhu office, with the office seat established thirty li south of the commission at Datian mountain dam.

sentences.zh: 分上七枝編戶，屬大渡河千戶所，下七枝仍屬松坪馬氏約束。

translations.literal: The upper seven branches of registered households were placed under the Dadu River qianhu office; the lower seven branches remained under the Ma clan of Songping.
translations.idiomatic: The upper seven branches of registered households were placed under the Dadu River qianhu office; the lower seven branches remained under the Ma clan of Songping.

sentences.zh: 松坪在司之東南，自炒米城直接峨眉，高山峻阪三百餘里，皆安撫族人居之。

translations.literal: Songping lay southeast of the commission; from Chaomicheng it ran straight to Emei for more than three hundred li of high mountains and steep slopes, all inhabited by the pacification commissioner's clansmen.
translations.idiomatic: Songping lay southeast of the commission; from Chaomicheng it ran straight to Emei for more than three hundred li of high mountains and steep slopes, all inhabited by the pacification commissioner's clansmen.

sentences.zh: 黎、雅諸蠻，宋時屢為邊患。

translations.literal: The tribes of Li and Ya had repeatedly been a frontier scourge under Song.
translations.idiomatic: The tribes of Li and Ya had repeatedly been a frontier scourge under Song.

sentences.zh: 明興，以諸蠻皆天全六番諸部，散居於二州之境，遂於黎州設安撫，於天全六番設招討，以示羈縻。

translations.literal: At the founding of Ming, because the various tribes were all departments of the Tianquan Liufan scattered between the two prefectures, a pacification commission was established at Lizhou and a pacification commissioner at the Tianquan Liufan to display loose reins.
translations.idiomatic: At the founding of Ming, because the various tribes were all departments of the Tianquan Liufan scattered between the two prefectures, a pacification commission was established at Lizhou and a pacification commissioner at the Tianquan Liufan to display loose reins.

sentences.zh: 而雅州所屬，與招討所轄之蠻民，境土相連，時有爭訟。

translations.literal: But the territories under Ya Prefecture and the tribal peoples under the Pacification Commissioner's jurisdiction had contiguous borders, and disputes arose from time to time.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the lands subject to Ya Prefecture and the tribal peoples under the Pacification Commissioner's rule lay side by side, and quarrels between them were frequent.

sentences.zh: 僥外大、小木瓜種分三枝，膩乃卜最強，世居西河。

translations.literal: Beyond the frontier, the large and small Muguwa tribes divided into three branches; Nainai Bo was the strongest and had long dwelt at Xihe.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the borderlands, the great and lesser Muguwa clans split into three branches. Nainai Bo was the most powerful and had held Xihe for generations.

sentences.zh: 初屬馬湖土官安氏鈐轄，自馬湖改流，諸瓜叛入邛部，歸嶺氏。

translations.literal: At first they were under the jurisdiction of the An clan, native officials of Ma-hu; after Ma-hu was converted to direct administration, the various Gua tribes rebelled, entered Qiong Department, and submitted to the Ling clan.
translations.idiomatic: They had originally been subject to the An family, native headmen of Ma-hu. Once Ma-hu was brought under regular administration, the Gua tribes rose in revolt, fled into Qiong Department, and placed themselves under the Ling clan.

sentences.zh: 其地自西河至涼山、雪山諸處，周圍蟠據。

translations.literal: Their territory extended from Xihe to Liangshan, Xueshan, and other places, coiling around the whole region.
translations.idiomatic: Their lands ran from Xihe to Liangshan, Xueshan, and beyond, winding around and holding the entire area.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖末，諸瓜畜牧蕃盛，時窺邊，邛部長官嶺柏不能制，嘉、峨、犍為諸邊皆為侵擾。

translations.literal: Toward the end of the Jiajing era, the herds of the various Gua tribes flourished; they frequently eyed the border. Qiong Department headman Ling Bai could not control them, and the borders of Jiazhou, Emei, and Qianwei were all harassed.
translations.idiomatic: By the late Jiajing reign, the Gua tribes' herds had grown abundant and they repeatedly probed the frontier. Ling Bai, headman of Qiong Department, could not restrain them, and the border districts of Jia, Emei, and Qianwei all suffered raids.

sentences.zh: 鎮巡官督邛部兵捕之，瓜兵益熾，乃議大征，分建昌、越巂、馬湖三路兵進討。

translations.literal: The border-pacification officer led Qiong Department troops to capture them, but the Gua forces grew only fiercer. A major expedition was then proposed, and troops from the three routes of Jianchang, Yuexi, and Ma-hu were dispatched in concert to attack.
translations.idiomatic: The frontier commissioner sent Qiong Department soldiers to hunt them down, yet the Gua warriors only grew bolder. Officials then resolved on a full-scale campaign, dividing forces from Jianchang, Yuexi, and Ma-hu into three columns for a joint punitive advance.

sentences.zh: 瓜部始惶駭請降，願歲貢馬方物，乃定。

translations.literal: The Gua tribes at last panicked and sued for surrender, offering to pay annual tribute of horses and local products; matters were then settled.
translations.idiomatic: At last the Gua tribes were seized with fear and begged to submit, pledging yearly tribute of horses and local goods. An arrangement was then fixed.

sentences.zh: 其地四千八百四十余畝，徵糧四百四十余石，輸峨眉縣。

translations.literal: Their land amounted to more than 4,840 mu, with a grain levy of more than 440 shi, paid to Emei County.
translations.idiomatic: Their registered fields totaled more than 4,840 mu, yielding a grain tax of over 440 shi remitted to Emei County.

sentences.zh: 明初與安撫司同置者，有大渡河守禦千戶所。

translations.literal: Established at the beginning of the Ming together with the Pacification Commission was the Dadu River Garrison Thousand Household Office.
translations.idiomatic: At the dynasty's founding, the Dadu River Garrison Thousand Household Office was set up alongside the Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 唐時，河平廣可通漕，戍將一不守，則黎、雅、邛、嘉、成都皆動搖。

translations.literal: In Tang times the river was broad and level, navigable for grain transport; if the garrison commander failed to hold it for a single day, Lizhou, Yazhou, Qiong, Jiazhou, and Chengdu would all be shaken.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang the river ran wide and smooth, open to grain transport by boat. Let the frontier garrison slip for even a day, and Lizhou, Yazhou, Qiong, Jiazhou, and Chengdu would all tremble.

sentences.zh: 宋建隆三年，王全斌平蜀，以圖來上。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jianlong under the Song, Wang Quanbin pacified Shu and presented a map to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In Song Jianlong 3, Wang Quanbin conquered Shu and submitted a map to the throne.

sentences.zh: 議者欲因兵威復越巂，藝祖以玉斧畫圖曰：「外此，吾不有也。

translations.literal: Councillors wished to use military might to recover Yuexi; the Founding Emperor drew on the map with a jade axe and said, "Beyond this, I shall not possess it.
translations.idiomatic: Some at court urged that the army's momentum be used to retake Yuexi. The Founding Emperor traced the map with a jade axe and declared, "Beyond this line I will hold nothing.

sentences.zh: 」自是之後，河中流忽陷下五六十丈，水至此，洶湧如空中落，船筏不通，名為噎口，殆天設險以限內外雲。

translations.literal: " From that time onward, the midstream of the river suddenly sank fifty or sixty zhang; where the water reached this point it surged and roared as if falling from the sky, and boats and rafts could not pass. The place was called Yekou—perhaps Heaven had set this barrier to divide inner from outer lands.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereafter the river's mid-channel abruptly dropped fifty or sixty zhang. Where the current struck this point it thundered down as though plunging from the heavens; neither boat nor raft could get through. The spot was named Yekou—the Choking Pass— as if Heaven itself had carved a barrier between the inner realm and the outer world.
